jobs.excerpt: About Mindsets VenturesMindsets Ventures (MV) is the venture studio arm of Mindsets, a talent centric investment company operating across the MENA, Europe, and North America.
jobs.description:
About Mindsets Ventures

Mindsets Ventures (MV) is the venture studio arm of Mindsets, a talent centric investment company operating across the MENA, Europe, and North America.

MV makes long-term investments in innovation-stagnant sectors and high-growth potential markets through re-invented business models, with a goal of redefining industries and creating mutual value between businesses and users in innovative ways.

MV is hands-on from day one and operates through two models.

In the first model, MV generates venture ideas internally, validates them through market research and customer interviews, and then recruits entrepreneurs and co-founders to lead those ventures supported by the studio's capital, team, and operational infrastructure.

In the second model, MV partners with founders who come with their own promising venture ideas, supporting them through the venture building process and providing pre-seed investment to help them build and scale.

In both cases MV remains hands-on at every stage, from validating the problem to assembling the team, developing the product, securing funding, and crafting go-to-market strategies.

Venture Context

Choosing where to live is one of life's biggest decisions. Yet renters do it blindly.

Renters spend weeks browsing listings and conducting dozens of viewings, yet still move into a home that does not fit them, because listings never reveal the dealbreaker issues that only current residents know.

To make matters worse, renters rarely have the luxury of time to decide: the best listings disappear within hours, forcing snap decisions on one of the biggest commitments in their lives. Issues like congested streets at rush hour, noisy neighbors through thin walls, an unresponsive building management that takes weeks to fix a leak, slow elevators, poor property quality, low value for money, and a neighborhood vibe that looked nothing like what the photos suggested.

Rather than reliable data, renters fall back on word of mouth, Google Maps, Reddit threads, and WhatsApp groups, piecing together fragments of information from strangers with no way to verify what is true, what is outdated, or what simply does not apply to their situation. The result is a broken decision process, and the cost falls entirely on the renter.

Market Opportunity

£1 billion is wasted every year in the UK by dissatisfied tenants and landlords absorbing tenant turnover costs. Globally, this figure exceeds £108 billion.

The scale of the problem is rooted in how large and mobile the renter population is. Over 5.5 million renters live in rented homes across the UK. These renters spend one to two months searching before committing themselves to a lease. Yet even after that investment of time, 19% of private renters are dissatisfied with their current tenure, and around 40% of tenants end up moving again due to proximity, neighborhood, and property issues. When they do, they absorb £2,500 to £3,500 in moving costs, rising to as much as £7,000 in London, from agent fees, deposits, and home movers, endure the stress of living in a place that does not fit them until their contract ends, and then restart the same broken search process with no guarantee of a better outcome.

Existing property platforms are built to serve property supply. They optimize for listing discovery, not living decisions. There is no platform today that structures community knowledge, resident experiences, and geospatial data into a decision-making tool for renters.

Venture Idea

Homi is a living intelligence platform that matches renters with their most suitable home based on real resident experiences and geospatial data.

Renter Benefits

Homi is building what property platforms never did: a platform that tells you what it is really like to live in every neighborhood, street, building, and apartment. For renters, this translates into three key benefits:

  1. Access to Complete Information: Navigate neighborhoods, streets, buildings, and properties about hidden living dynamics based on structured data crowdsourced from residents without having to conduct any viewings.
  2. Access to Trusted Information: Get insights on quality of life and living experiences by engaging with residents you actually trust, which are people from your own network and that share a similar lifestyle.
  3. Personalized Recommendations: Receive results on the most suitable neighborhood, street, and property to live in based your profile and lifestyle preferences and where residents of similar lifestyle live.

The idea first started in Dubai. Since then, Homi has conducted over 100 interviews across 6 countries and run 58 product demos. Homi is now entering the full validation phase in London as the next focus city, testing the solution with London renters to determine whether the platform addresses a market need there, before scaling the product and acquiring users.

The Opportunity

As a Cofounder, you will take Homi from the validation already completed into its next chapter in London: reaching problem-solution fit, building and scaling the product, and acquiring customers. in London. Working closely with the Mindsets Ventures team, you will refine the problem statement, develop the MVP with real renters, and drive Homi toward a validated, scalable business. This begins as a 6-month engagement structured across defined sprints, but is intended as the starting point of a long-term partnership.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has 2 or more years of experience in real estate, PropTech, or a related field, with a bonus for those who have worked as an entrepreneur, founder, or in an early-stage startup in the region.
  • Has a strong entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable taking ownership and building something from the ground up.
  • Shows evidence of being able to build relationships and credibility with stakeholders across the real estate ecosystem.
  • Thrives in ambiguous, early-stage environments, can move forward with minimal direction, and is comfortable leading the venture end to end with the support of the venture building team.
  • Is genuinely curious about the real estate market, continuously challenges their own assumptions, and is obsessed with understanding the problem from the perspective of all affected stakeholders.
  • Communicates complex ideas clearly and tailors the message to the audience.

What You Will Do

As a Founding Partner, you will lead the development and growth of Homi. You will work closely with Mindsets Ventures team to validate, build, commercialize and scale the venture:

  • Interview relevant stakeholders across London and other relevant cities, including renters, agents, landlords, developers, and others.
  • Test solution concepts iteratively, including the current Homi MVP, building toward a scalable product that meets user needs and that is validated through demos, pilots, and user feedback.
  • Engage other real estate stakeholders, including agents, landlords, and developers, to validate the business model and test willingness to pay.
  • Develop and iterate a scalable MVP, building on validated findings from renter and stakeholder interviews.
  • Drive traction and customer acquisition in London through MVP demos, sign-ups, and early adopter onboarding.
  • Continuously recommend next steps to move the venture forward, while flagging when a larger pivot or adaptation is needed based on the evidence gathered.
  • Represent the Homi brand and post on social media throughout the program.
  • Apply to startup competitions and pitch to investors alongside the venture building team.
  • Attend joint sessions with the Mindsets Ventures team.

Founder Benefits

The selected co-founder will join HOMI as an equity partner alongside Mindsets Ventures, with a deal structure customized based on each founder's contribution, expertise, and level of commitment, and including milestone-based incentives to reward progress and impact. The co-founder will also have access to a dedicated budget for Homi and full access to the services and operational support that Mindsets Ventures provides.

This role is highly technical and requires in-depth training in our proprietary platform. You'll work with some of the world's most prominent consumer brands on technology that materially moves their revenue.

At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. This is not a reporting role. You will own the tools that let builders and reviewers see, test, and trust how GenerativeAgent (GA) actually behaves — before it ever talks to a customer, and after. If builders can't confidently preview a configuration change, and reviewers can't efficiently audit what GA said, thought, and did in production, quality erodes silently and trust with our customers erodes with it. Making agent behavior visible, testable, and reviewable at scale is your product.

What You Will Do

  • Own scenario creation via the simulation agent. Lead product for the tools that let builders generate and curate realistic test scenarios, so configuration changes can be validated against representative conversations before they ship.

  • Build the case for simulation-driven quality. Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Research to show customers and internal stakeholders how pre-production testing and post-production review compound into fewer mistakes, faster iteration, and more defensible GA performance.

  • Partner deeply with Research and Engineering on the underlying agent architecture — reasoning traces, tool calls, scenario generation methods — so product decisions are grounded in what's technically sound and what actually predicts real-world behavior.

  • Manage the trust layer of the review experience. Proactively identify and resolve issues that erode confidence in what builders and reviewers see — desyncs between simulated and real behavior, incomplete traces, unclear mistake categorization — and design the UX and guardrails that keep them confident in what they're looking at.

Who You Are

    We evaluate candidates against a set of principles. These aren't interview talking points — they describe how PMs are expected to operate here every day.

  • Growth & Abundance Mindset: You approach new domains with curiosity and learn fast. You see collaboration as additive, not competitive. When a bet doesn't work, you extract the signal and move on.

  • Extreme Ownership: You take responsibility to deliver. You don't wait to be asked — you identify the gap and close it. You are the PM; the outcome is yours.

  • High-Velocity Outcomes: You measure yourself by outcomes, not output. You distinguish between shipping a feature and moving a metric. You can answer "what changed for the customer?" for everything on your roadmap.

  • Effective Communication, Collaboration, and Trust: You influence without authority across engineering, research, design, sales, and customer success. You overcommunicate to keep stakeholders aligned.

  • Real-Time Feedback: You give and receive feedback continuously rather than saving it for quarterly reviews. When something is wrong, you say so directly and constructively.

What You Will Need

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on testing, quality, or review/analytics products in enterprise B2B SaaS.

  • Direct experience building products around LLMs, AI agents, or other applied AI systems — you can reason about agentic behavior, prompt and scenario design, or model output evaluation well enough to make sharp product tradeoffs, not just talk about AI at a high level.

  • Experience shipping tools that simulate, test, or preview system behavior before it reaches production, including the judgment to know when simulated behavior is a reliable proxy for the real thing and when it isn't.

  • Experience building review or audit tooling for complex, unstructured content, and turning ambiguous quality signals into clear, defensible categorizations.

  • Comfort partnering with research and engineering teams on system internals — reasoning traces, tool-use logs, evaluation methodology — to ground product decisions in technical reality.

  • Track record of running discovery with internal or external users and translating it into structured requirements — evals, quality metrics, or review workflows.

What We Would Like to See

Who You Are

You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

Your Role

As a Telephonic Pharmacy Care Coordinator with Evergreen, you play a critical patient-facing and operational role in our pharmacy program. This is a 6-month contract with the opportunity to convert to full-time employment. This program connects patients with a specialized mail-order pharmacy that provides pre-sorted, multi-dose medication packaging (pill packs) along with proactive refill management and periodic care team check-ins, helping ensure patients stay on track with complex medication schedules. Working fully remotely by phone, you are often the first voice patients hear from the pharmacy care team — helping establish trust, explain the value of the pharmacy service, and guide patients through enrollment.

You work with patients from our partner practices to engage them, capture consent, and set up timely access to medications and pharmacist-led clinical services. You'll explain how the service works — multi-dose pill packs organized by date/time, home delivery and automatic refill coordination so patients never run out, and scheduled check-in calls to review adherence and address new prescriptions or dose changes. When a patient agrees to participate, you act directly in the electronic health record — updating the patient's preferred pharmacy, triggering electronic prescriptions, and documenting consent or decline based on the patient's decision. Your primary focus is high-volume outbound outreach to patients who do not have an office visit, or who cannot be supported onsite, along with inbound support as needed.

This role is focused on telephonic patient engagement, consent and enrollment, EHR documentation, and care coordination for patients living with chronic kidney disease and other complex chronic conditions. Zo creëer je ruimte voor creatieve medewerkers om maximaal te focussen op hun kerntaak, terwijl interne stakeholders sneller en beter ondersteund worden.

  • De huidige werking rond planning en traffic analyseren en documenteren, inclusief de samenwerking met interne stakeholders.

  • De capaciteit van creatieve medewerkers in kaart brengen en doelgericht alloceren.
  • Extra ondersteuning helpen voorzien wanneer de interne capaciteit ontoereikend is.
  • De planningsafstemming verzorgen met creatieve teams, leidinggevende en interne stakeholders.
  • Stand-ups, weekplanningen en statusupdates faciliteren.
  • Zorgen voor duidelijkheid over verantwoordelijkheden, deadlines en randvoorwaarden.
  • Ondersteunende planningstools beheren en helpen optimaliseren.
  • Vanuit planning en traffic de link maken met budgetopvolging en kostenbewaking.
  • Proactief verbetervoorstellen formuleren voor de operationele flow en voor de werking rond planning en traffic.
  • Indien nodig de overgang ondersteunen tussen de testopstelling en de definitieve werkwijze.

Deze rol omvat niet:
formeel leidinggeven, creatieve uitwerking of creatief management.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt ervaring in een creatief bureau, studio of productieomgeving.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met planning en traffic management, idealiter in een gelijkaardige context.
  • Je werkt vlot met diverse planningstools.

  • Je beschikt over een degelijke achtergrond in projectmanagement.

  • Je hebt ervaring met procesanalyse en procesoptimalisatie.

  • Je kan vlot schakelen met stakeholders en voelt je comfortabel in een sturende, coördinerende rol zonder formeel leiding te geven.
  • Bij je kandidatuur voeg je een document toe met een voorbeeld van een eerder uitgewerkte procesflow.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. jobs.description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

Come be part of remarkable.

How you can make a difference

HealthEquity Marketplace is a managed affiliate marketplace designed to help members get more health and healthcare for every dollar they spend.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Analytics to build and lead the analytics capabilities that guide our commerce strategy. You will help us understand how our business, including transactional and subscription offerings, is performing, identify the drivers of conversion and retention, and determine which offers and promotions create incremental value for members and the business.

This is a high-impact opportunity to build a marketplace analytics capability from the ground up and scale it as the business grows. You will establish trusted performance measures, uncover opportunities within our product and merchant portfolio, and translate complex data into clear recommendations for Product, Growth, Marketing, Design, and executive leaders.

The ideal candidate combines marketplace or ecommerce expertise with strong analytical judgment, commercial instincts, and the ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels. This position reports to the General Manager of Marketplace.

What you will be doing

Lead marketplace performance and inventory analytics

  • Own the measurement framework for Marketplace commerce performance, from member engagement and conversion through transaction completion, revenue, retention, and lifetime value.
  • Evaluate the performance of our inventory across merchants, products, categories, offer types, and member segments.
  • Monitor key marketplace economics, including transaction volume, revenue, take rate, margin, merchant performance, and offer quality.
  • Identify underperforming inventory, emerging member needs, assortment gaps, and opportunities to improve product and category mix.
  • Develop dashboards, reporting, and executive-level insights that explain not only what happened, but why it happened and what the business should do next.
  • Establish consistent metric definitions and reconcile internal data with affiliate network, merchant, and vendor reporting.
  • Identify and close measurement gaps, such as bridging HealthEquity platform metrics with affiliate or brand metrics to evaluate funnel performance or attribution.

Build subscription and retention intelligence

  • Own analytics for subscription and recurring-revenue products as a distinct business model within the Marketplace portfolio.
  • Develop acquisition, activation, retention, churn, renewal, and lifetime-value reporting by product, cohort, channel, offer, and member segment.
  • Diagnose the drivers of subscription churn and retention, distinguishing acquisition-quality issues from product, pricing, engagement, and lifecycle factors.
  • Partner with Product, Growth, and merchant teams to identify retention opportunities and prioritize interventions.
  • Design measurement approaches for onboarding improvements, lifecycle communications, pricing changes, save offers, and other retention initiatives.

Optimize offers, pricing, and promotions

  • Build a fact base for competitive offers, including offer structure, discount depth, funding model, cadence, eligibility, and market positioning.
  • Advise Growth, Marketing, Product, and merchant teams on offer and promotion design before launch.
  • Measure the incremental impact of offers and promotions, separating true lift from demand that would have occurred without the incentive.
  • Evaluate tradeoffs among conversion, member value, merchant funding, Marketplace economics, and long-term customer behavior.
  • Establish testing and measurement standards for promotions, including experiments, holdouts, matched comparisons, and other causal-inference methods where appropriate.
  • Translate findings into practical recommendations about which offers to scale, modify, or discontinue.

Advance segmentation and targeting

  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering to define member segments and develop propensity and affinity scores by category, product, and offer type.
  • Translate commercial questions into clear data and model requirements, success criteria, and activation plans.
  • Help Product and Marketing apply segmentation across onsite and offsite experiences to improve relevance and conversion.
  • Monitor model and targeting performance to ensure recommendations produce measurable business value.

What you will need to be successful

  • 7+ years of experience in analytics, decision science, business intelligence, or a related discipline, including experience supporting a marketplace, ecommerce, subscription, affiliate marketing, or similar business.
  • Strong understanding of marketplace or ecommerce economics, including conversion, revenue, margin, take rate, and promotional efficiency.
  • Experience analyzing subscription funnels, retention cohorts, churn, and customer lifetime value.
  • Practical expertise in experimentation, incrementality measurement, attribution, and causal analysis.
  • Strong judgment and intellectual curiosity

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience supporting both transactional and subscription-based products.
  • Experience with affiliate networks or performance marketing based models
  • Experience with card-funded or card-linked offers, including merchant funding, attribution, redemption, and unit economics.
  • Experience developing or operationalizing customer segmentation, affinity, or propensity models.
  • Experience in health, wellness, financial services, or another regulated consumer industry.
  • Familiarity with responsible handling of PHI-adjacent or other sensitive consumer data.

This is a remote position.

Salary Range

$120500.00 To $157000.00 / year

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives and restricted stock units as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • HSA contribution and match
  • Dependent care FSA match
  • Uncapped paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) match
  • Personal and healthcare financial literacy programs
  • Ongoing education & tuition assistance
  • Gym and fitness reimbursement
  • Wellness program incentives

Onboarding & Travel

This is a remote role, with an in-person onboarding training component. New team members must participate in Trailhead, HealthEquity’s immersive onboarding experience Trailhead is designed to foster meaningful connections, support your integration into the organization, and equip you with a strong understanding of our business. Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters once per quarter. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations.

This role may begin with a virtual, self-paced onboarding experience, followed by a mandatory onsite Trailhead session at a later date.

HealthEquity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to team members with qualifying disabilities. Should you be selected for this role and require an accommodation, we will put you in touch with our Benefits Team so you can begin the accommodation request process.

Why work with HealthEquity

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. We are passionate about providing a solution that allows American families to connect health and wealth. Join us and discover a work experience where the person is valued more than the position. Click here to learn more.

You belong at HealthEquity!

HealthEquity, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to being an employer where no matter your background or identity – you feel welcome and included. We ensure equal opportunity for all applicants and employees without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a qualified individual with a disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. HealthEquity is a drug-free workplace. For more information about our EEO policy, or about HealthEquity’s applicant disability accommodation, drug-free-workplace, background check, and E-Verify policies, please visit our Careers page.

HealthEquity uses Microsoft Copilot to transcribe screening interviews between candidates and their direct Talent Partner for note taking and interview summaries. By scheduling a screening interview with us, you consent to Microsoft Copilot’s AI technology recording and transcribing your interview with your Talent Partner. This information will be reviewed for accuracy and then used by HealthEquity to summarize the interview, ensure accuracy, and facilitate our hiring process. We take privacy seriously. You have the option to opt out. If you wish to opt out of this Microsoft Copilot transcription, please notify your Talent Partner in advance of the interview. If we do not receive an opt-out request from you, we will assume that you consent to the use of Microsoft Copilot.

At HealthEquity, our goal is to save and improve lives by empowering healthcare consumers. This shared purpose inspires everything we do, including how we approach hiring. Our process is designed to get to know the real you: your skills, experiences, and potential to make a difference. We value honesty, originality, and the courage to do the right thing, even when it is not the easiest path. Showing up as your authentic self reflects these values and helps us build something truly remarkable together.

As AI is becoming a common tool throughout the application process, we want to be clear about its appropriate use at HealthEquity. Using AI to support resume writing, research, or interview preparation is perfectly acceptable, provided the content is accurate and genuinely represents your qualifications and skills. For other key parts of our interview process, however, it is important that the ideas, communication, and work you share reflect your own voice, experiences, and thinking. We ask that you participate in our live interviews and complete any assessments without AI assistance unless instructions explicitly indicate otherwise or a specific exception is discussed and approved in advance. This approach ensures fairness, celebrates your individuality, and allows your authentic perspective to shine. Behaviors that do not align with these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process or termination of employment if later discovered. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to learning about the unique contributions only you can bring to HealthEquity.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled RN or LPN to serve as the remote support hub for our in-house Nurse Practitioners (NPs) practicing in Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) as a Remote Clinical Support Nurse.
jobs.description:
Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled RN or LPN to serve as the remote support hub for our in-house Nurse Practitioners (NPs) practicing in Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNFs) as a Remote Clinical Support Nurse.

The Clinical Support Nurse coordinates care for high-risk residents in SNF and ALF settings. This role partners with physicians, nurse practitioners, nursing leaders, residents, families, specialists, pharmacies, and community providers to prioritize clinical needs, close communication gaps, and support safe transitions of care.

Role Scope

  • Post-acute and long-term care residents in SNF/ALF settings.
  • Daily clinical navigation from admission through discharge.
  • Close collaboration with facility and provider teams.

Primary Objectives

  • Surface risk early: Review clinical information and direct provider attention to residents with the greatest needs.
  • Close care gaps: Track consultations, laboratory results, orders, records, medications, and follow-up activities through completion.
  • Prepare the care team: Coordinate schedules and pre-chart relevant information for efficient, informed visits.
  • Keep people connected: Provide routine updates and promptly escalate acute, complex, or change-of-status concerns.

Why You'll Love This Role

  • High Visibility & Strategic Impact: This role isn't just a support function; you'll be a key partner in building, refining, and scaling this program, with a direct line to company leadership.
  • True Work-Life Balance: This is a fully remote, Work-From-Home position with the flexibility to manage your own schedule and day.
  • Be a Pioneer: You get to be on the ground floor of a high-impact program. You'll help create the playbook, refine workflows, and have a tangible impact on the program's success as it scales.
  • Meaningful Growth: We are committed to your professional development, with opportunities to expand your licensure and grow alongside the program.

HealthDrive delivers on-site dentistry, optometry, podiatry, audiology, behavioral health, and primary care services to residents in long-term care, skilled nursing, and assisted living facilities. Each specialty offered by HealthDrive is one that directly impacts the quality of daily life for the deserving residents we serve. HealthDrive connects patients in need of vital healthcare to doctors committed to dignity and excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Clinical Review and Provider Readiness

    • Review overnight nursing logs, emergency-department notices, clinical records, and daily risk reports to identify instability and prioritize high-risk residents.
    • Build and maintain provider schedules for high-risk residents, new admissions, planned discharges, regulatory visits, and follow-up care.
    • Pre-chart diagnoses, functional status, recent events, laboratory results, medications, consultation findings, and outstanding actions.

    Consultations and Clinical Follow-Through

    • Coordinate specialist appointments, transportation, communication, and receipt of consultation notes.
    • Track consultant recommendations and promptly route therapy, procedure, or order changes to the physician, nurse practitioner, and facility team.
    • Retrieve and integrate HIE information, emergency-visit records, discharge summaries, outside consultations, laboratory results, and other provider records into the appropriate clinical system.

    MDS/PDPM Coordination

    • Partner with facility MDS coordinators to schedule provider visits and ensure functional and diagnostic conditions are comprehensively captured.
    • Prepare clinical information supporting accurate MDS/PDPM documentation without placing additional administrative burden on the rounding provider.

    Team Alignment and Documentation

    • Communicate with nursing leadership, unit managers, collaborating clinicians, and facility staff to clarify priorities and next steps.
    • Complete timely documentation and confirm that provider orders are entered into the facility EMR.
    • Coordinate controlled-substance renewal scheduling as assigned.

    Discharge and Community Transition

    • Coordinate discharge visits so provider assessments and documentation are completed before residents leave the facility.
    • Schedule timely community PCP follow-up appointments.
    • Communicate care plans, medications, and next steps to residents, families, pharmacies, and community partners.
    • Oversee prescription ordering and pharmacy fulfillment to support medication availability at home.

    Medication and Laboratory Safety

    • Reconcile facility, provider, and discharge medication lists and resolve discrepancies with the appropriate clinician.
    • Review medication lists for deprescribing opportunities and escalate concerns involving polypharmacy, side effects, or interactions.
    • Identify missing outside laboratory results and ensure they are available for clinical review.

    Resident and Family Communication

    • Provide proactive, compassionate updates regarding stable progress, routine results, therapy milestones, and transition plans.
    • Serve as a consistent point of contact for residents and families.
    • Promptly escalate acute changes, complex clinical questions, and sensitive conversations to the physician or nurse practitioner.

    Advance Care Planning Support

    • Identify residents experiencing clinical deterioration who may benefit from advanced care planning or palliative-care evaluation.
    • Coordinate with qualified providers on goals-of-care discussions, POLST documentation, symptom-management planning, and family education.

Qualifications

  • Active, unencumbered Nursing license in the applicable state or states of practice. Connecticut/Rhode Island/Compact Licensure.
  • Clinical nursing experience in post-acute care, long-term care, geriatrics, transitions of care, or care management.
  • Strong clinical assessment, prioritization, medication reconciliation, documentation, and care-coordination skills.
  • Ability to use EMRs, HIEs, scheduling tools, and secure communication channels.
  • Working knowledge of MDS/PDPM, discharge planning, advance directives or POLST, privacy requirements, and professional scope of practice.

Pair Team is a public benefit company reimagining care for the safety net. We're hiring our founding Compliance Manager to help Pair Team grow and scale responsibly. This is a rare opportunity to build a compliance function from the ground up inside a fast-moving healthcare company operating at the center of Medicaid and Medicare high needs population care management.

You'll be the person who thrives at the intersection of rigorous regulatory knowledge and startup pragmatism: someone who understands the rules deeply enough to know where there's genuine room to move, and disciplined enough to know where there isn't. Program & Regulatory Compliance

OneOcean is a unified brand born from the integration of OneOcean and Ocean Technologies Group.
Owned by Lloyd’s Register, an organisation with more than 260 years of trust, integrity and leadership at sea, OneOcean combines the agility and ambition of a fast-moving innovator with the strength and stability of one of the world’s most trusted maritime institutions.
At the heart of OneOcean is a portfolio unlike any other in maritime. A comprehensive, integrated portfolio built on years of expertise, trusted by thousands of maritime professionals around the world.
🎯 Our Mission: Our mission is clear. In the race to zero emissions, our research, advisory and technical expertise and industry-firsts are supporting a safe, sustainable maritime energy transition. Today we are a leading provider of classification and compliance services to the marine and offshore industries, helping our clients design, construct and operate their assets to accepted levels of safety and environmental compliance.

🔍 Why Join OneOcean Crew?
Legacy & Innovation: We were created more than 260 years ago as the world’s first marine classification society to improve and set standards for the safety of ships.
Global Impact: Our digital solutions are relied upon by more than 30,000 vessels, following the acquisition of OneOcean in 2022 and Ocean Technologies Group in 2024.
Product Offering: Covering five proven product areas - learning, fleet operations, compliance, voyage planning and performance management - supporting its customers from ship to shore, from training and people operations, to voyage compliance and optimisation.
🧭 Navigating the position: Enterprise Systems ManagerWe are looking for an Enterprise Systems Manager to lead the strategy and transformation of OneOcean’s internal business systems estate.
This is a senior role with end-to-end accountability across systems, data, integration, and cost. You will play a key part in moving from a fragmented landscape to a single, integrated, and scalable platform environment that supports growth and operational efficiency.
You will work across Finance, Revenue, Customer Operations, Marketing, and IT to align priorities, simplify platforms, and drive consistent outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Own and transform the systems landscape
  • Lead a multi-year transformation to consolidate and standardise business systems
  • Reduce duplication and ensure systems operate as a connected ecosystem
  • Own the full lifecycle of systems, from selection to retirement

Define and deliver system strategy
  • Build and execute a clear roadmap aligned to business priorities
  • Drive platform rationalisation and removal of legacy systems
  • Balance capability, cost, and long-term value

Lead integration and data consistency
  • Define integration strategy and ensure systems are connected end-to-end
  • Establish clear ownership of key data (customer, product, financial, subscription)
  • Eliminate duplicate data and conflicting sources of truth

Drive simplification and standardisation
  • Translate business processes into scalable system solutions
  • Challenge unnecessary complexity
  • Enforce standard approaches as systems are consolidated

Own delivery and prioritisation
  • Manage a single, prioritised backlog across all internal systems
  • Balance competing business demands
  • Ensure delivery through internal teams and external partners

Manage vendors and cost
  • Own system budgets and licence optimisation
  • Lead vendor selection, negotiation, and renewals
  • Optimise total cost of ownership

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Experience
  • Proven experience managing enterprise business systems (ERP, CRM, or similar)
  • Experience leading system transformation or consolidation programmes
  • Track record of working across multiple business functions

Skills
  • Strong understanding of system integration and data flows across
  • Commercial mindset with experience managing vendors and cost
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
  • Strong communication skills with senior stakeholders

Leadership
  • Experience leading teams and working with external partners
  • Able to take ownership, make decisions, and drive outcomes
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, global environment

At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are

We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.


As the nation’s largest residential Clean Tech company, Sunrun is on a mission to transform our energy system into a modern, sustainable grid of the future while making clean, renewable energy accessible to all households.

Sunrun is leading the transition by building Distributed Power Plants (DPPs) and Virtual Power Plants (VPPs) out of home solar and battery assets. Within the Grid Services Revenue Operations & Account Strategy organization, we bridge the gap between technical software capabilities, utility market structures, and profit realization. We are actively hiring world-class talent to operate multi-million-dollar portfolios across open market bring-your-own-device programs, utility bilateral VPPs, competitive energy markets, and next-generation DER offerings (including EV charge management and bidirectional V2X technologies).

As the Northeast Regional Delivery Lead, you will own the operational execution, financial yield, and strategic utility partner relationships across the Northeast footprint—from Maine down through New York, and New England. You will act as the commercial and operational quarterback for a multi-megawatt portfolio, collaborating across Data Science, Product & Engineering, BD, Policy, Marketing, and Customer Excellence. If you thrive on (1) solving complex technical and market optimization challenges, (2) managing multi-million-dollar revenue portfolios, and (3) navigating complex utility integrations, this role is for you.

No candidate will exactly match this job description - please do not hesitate to apply!

NORTHEAST LEAD RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work within a regional operational team to lead the P&L performance across active open market bring-your-own-device programs including: ConnectedSolutions, CT Energy Storage Solutions, and NY DLC / Pilot Programs.

  • Serve as the primary operational relationship owner and subject matter expert for Northeast utility partners (National Grid, Eversource, O&R, PSEG-LI, etc.), and program administrators.

  • Direct all contractual and regulatory compliance, reporting SLAs, conditions precedent, and monthly/seasonal settlement reconciliations to ensure 100% revenue capture.

  • Ensure technical cohesion with third-party DERMS administrators to streamline program entry and direct integrations.

  • Prepare program operations for next-gen capabilities, including locational delivery, solar sponging, target power commands, and automated dispatch output curves.

  • Collaborate with BD and Policy to showcase performance within existing programs, evaluate regional expansions and new program designs, define operational modeling, customer analytics, and program boundaries.

  • Oversee customer participation journeys, POS T&Cs, and care agents for new customer enrollments, and new product launches.

  • Establish reporting metrics for internal leaders and external reporting requirements and advocacy needs.

jobs.title: Health Innovation Strategist / Senior Strategist
jobs.excerpt: THE POSITION:As a Strategist/ Senior Strategist within the EVERSANA INTOUCH Health Innovation team, you will play a pivotal role in developing and executing global digital health go-to-market (GTM) and commercialization strategies for our life sciences clients and ecosystem partners.
jobs.description:
THE POSITION:

As a Strategist/ Senior Strategist within the EVERSANA INTOUCH Health Innovation team, you will play a pivotal role in developing and executing global digital health go-to-market (GTM) and commercialization strategies for our life sciences clients and ecosystem partners. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and report directly to the Senior Vice President of Health Innovation, working at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and real-world execution.

In this client-facing role, you will help shape the future of digitally enhanced healthcare, supporting the design, positioning, and scaling of innovations including digital therapeutics, digital companions, connected care and telemedicine solutions, AI-driven tools, XR applications, and combination products that integrate with pharmaceutical or medical device treatments.

You will be responsible for leading or supporting strategic projects across the full innovation lifecycle—from early-stage ideation and value proposition design to launch strategy, market access, and global deployment. The role requires a solid understanding of how digital health innovations are evaluated, launched, and adopted within pharma and medtech environments in Europe, and the ability to translate this into actionable, business-oriented strategies.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams.

These results are achieved by:

STRATEGIC LEADERSHIP & INNOVATION

  • Define and implement global go-to-market (GTM) and business model strategies for digital health assets—including, but not limited to, digital companions, digital medical devices, DTx, data platforms, and AI-driven tools.
  • Operate at the intersection of pharmaceutical commercialization and digital innovation, guiding clients and internal teams to unlock scalable value.
  • Lead or support projects across the full lifecycle of innovation: from ideation and opportunity scoping to GTM planning, regulatory approval, market access, and launch execution.
  • Grow and develop clients.

DIGITAL HEALTH GTM & COMMERCIALIZATION

  • Develop tailored commercialization and market launch strategies for digital health solutions globally and, especially in Europe, ensuring alignment with client brand, access, patient advocacy, medical, and portfolio priorities.
  • Translate regulatory requirements, user needs, and clinical evidence and market requirements into actionable roadmaps for commercialization.
  • Support Regulatory and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) submissions, reimbursement dossiers, and digital health procurement applications in collaboration with clients.
  • Bridge digital strategy with agency of record (AOR) operations, ensuring integration into broader brand planning, omnichannel campaigns, and field enablement efforts.

MARKET & LANDSCAPE INSIGHTS

  • Conduct robust market analysis, competitive landscaping, care pathway assessments, and technology scouting to identify strategic opportunities.
  • Leverage both qualitative and quantitative data to generate business insights and innovation strategies.
  • Stay informed on evolving regulatory and market trends to ensure compliant, forward-looking strategy development.

CLIENT LEADERSHIP & ENGAGEMENT

  • Act as a strategic partner to global and regional pharma and medtech clients, with a strong understanding of the pharmaceutical launch process and stakeholder dynamics.
  • Lead or co-lead client engagements, including strategic workshops, advisory boards, and innovation co-design sessions.
  • Build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders and partners.

PROJECT & TEAM LEADERSHIP

  • Lead or support cross-functional delivery teams from planning to implementation, collaborating with and where appropriate coordinating internal resources across agency, data, technology, and regulatory functions.
  • Provide mentorship to junior strategists and contribute to building internal capabilities and delivery excellence. Collaborate effectively with senior leadership and support strategic initiatives.
  • Contribute to business development activities, including proposals, pitches, client support and thought leadership.

COMMUNICATION & DELIVERABLES

  • Develop high-quality strategy presentations, business plans, and narrative deliverables in English (and optionally in Italian).
  • Communicate complex concepts with clarity and impact to diverse audiences including clients, KOLs, and internal stakeholders.
  • Support development of articles, policy summaries, or dissemination plans where needed.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Operate effectively within EVERSANA’s matrix structure, aligning strategy execution across teams and service lines.
  • Connect the Health Innovation team with EVERSANA’s broader capabilities—spanning commercial, medical, data, regulatory, and agency services—to drive integration and value.

INCLUSION, INTEGRITY, AND GROWTH

  • Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through inclusive leadership, collaboration, and continuous personal development.
  • Act with accountability and integrity, embracing our cultural values in all engagements.

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:

  • Travel (not frequent: domestic and international)
  • Hours (minimum 40 hours per week)

The above list reflects the general details necessary to describe the expectations of the position and shall not be construed as the only expectations that may be assigned for the position.

An individual in this position must be able to successfully perform the expectations listed above.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Demonstrated experience defining and implementing go-to-market (GTM) and commercialization strategies for digital health assets (e.g., digital therapeutics, digital companions, AI-driven platforms, hybrid drug-device combinations).
  • Proven ability to act as a strategic partner to pharmaceutical and health innovation clients, aligning digital initiatives with brand, medical, access, and portfolio objectives.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercialization models, product lifecycle management, and launch planning across global and local contexts.
  • Experience leading client-facing strategy engagements and managing cross-functional delivery teams from planning through execution.
  • Ability to translate clinical evidence, regulatory and policy requirements, and user needs into actionable strategic roadmaps.
  • Ability to draft business and launch plans, implement commercialization roadmaps, review supporting evidence, and contribute to regulatory submissions, Health Technology Assessment (HTA) dossiers, reimbursement applications, and digital health procurement processes in collaboration with clients.
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written), and preferably also in Italy, with excellent communication and presentation skills for diverse audiences.
  • Ability to effectively engage and collaborate with healthcare stakeholders, including KOLs, clinicians, patient associations, and internal subject matter experts.
  • Skilled in preparing strategic narratives, business plans, and high-quality presentations in PowerPoint and narrative formats.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and creativity—able to work independently and drive outcomes in complex, dynamic environments.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a corporate, matrixed environment, managing multiple priorities with accountability and integrity.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Advanced degree in a relevant field, such as:
    • Advanced degree in Medicine, Public Health, Health Economics, Healthcare Management or related fields (e.g., MD, MPH, or MSc)
  • +5/7 years of experience in pharmaceutical, medtech, or digital health sectors—preferably in strategy, commercial operations, innovation, or launch excellence roles.
  • Proven experience working with or within life sciences companies on GTM strategies for digital innovations, medical devices, or connected care platforms.
  • Strong grasp of European healthcare systems, market access pathways, and digital health policy trends.
  • Familiarity with value demonstration, health economics, or evidence generation strategies is a plus.
  • Experience collaborating with agency, data, technology, and AI teams to develop and implement integrated solutions.
  • Hands-on approach, with the ability to operate across both strategic design and implementation.
  • Experience authoring publications, white papers, or policy briefs is valued.

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others. 

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity I create an environment of awareness and respect.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

EVERSANA is committed to providing competitive salaries and benefits for all employees. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $135,000 and is not applicable to locations outside of the U.S. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, other job-related qualifications/skills, and geographic location (to account for comparative cost of living). EVERSANA reserves the right to modify this base salary range at any time.

Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Follow us on LinkedIn | Twitter

EVERSANA INTOUCH® is a global, full-service marketing agency network serving the life sciences industry, and is the first – and only – agency network to be part of a fully integrated commercialization platform through EVERSANA®. We provide next-generation creative and media services, enterprise solutions and data analytics services for clients.

We get fired up when people talk about getting—and staying—healthy. That’s where we find our inspiration: in the very human experiences of patients, doctors, and even each other. Then, we collaborate on ways to make caring for one’s health more achievable, connecting patients and physicians with the information and tools they need.

We embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is beloved by developers for the simplicity of our APIs, the thoroughness of our documentation, and our focus on developer experience. The Technical Solutions Engineering (TSE) team is the glue that supports our developer-users and champions developer experience as being central to the overall experience of our users. TSE interacts directly with developer-users more than any other team at Stripe, so your role will have a significant impact on what Stripe is known for and values most. When we do our job well, developers all over the world are able to smoothly launch and grow their businesses on Stripe, whether they’re integrating payments for the first time or building complex financial systems.

What you’ll do

TSEs understand the fundamentals of programming incredibly well and eagerly jump in and familiarize themselves with others’ code. You will do a wide variety of things, including explaining technical concepts about Stripe’s products, build and debug integrations with developers, and produce/improve guides that help our users solve particular problems to be successful with Stripe. You will interact with developers of all skill levels through a variety of mediums, enabling them to be successful when using Stripe.

Early on, current team members will devote a large amount of time to teaching you and helping you get to a level of comfort and expertise with Stripe, its services, and how we interact with users. Later, we’d love for you to take on this role with others on the team and Stripes broadly, as teaching is a great way to learn and to reinforce what you know.

If you’re someone who enjoys working with all kinds of code, is a fast researcher, a strong writer, and enthusiastic about helping others build mission-critical products with Stripe, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with a number of external developers and aid them in building their applications against Stripe’s infrastructure in a number of programming languages (including Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, NodeJS, .NET, ReactJS, React Native, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, and Java for Android).
  • Unblock external developers with their thorniest integration challenges through a variety of support channels including email, ticketing software, internal issue trackers, community platforms (like StackOverflow), and real-time chat software (like Slack and Discord)
  • Develop and maintain internal and external documentation, examples, integration demos, and code-snippets that demonstrate usage patterns of the Stripe infrastructure.
  • Identify points of friction developers encounter and collaborate with engineering teams to make Stripe products better. Participate in a number of extended engineering teams’ regular planning sessions, design reviews, and development meetings.
  • Develop and maintain a suite of internal support tooling for TSE and Stripe Support more broadly e.g. a retrieval augmented generation LLM-based Copilot tool or the Invoice Explainer Admin tool.
  • Act as a developer advocate and educational resource internal to the organization by regularly assembling training for non-developers internal to the organization and responding in real-time to product integration questions.

Who you are

This role is remote but requires candidates to be located in the Mountain or Pacific time zones.

This may occasionally include providing weekend coverage for monitoring/supporting critical infrastructure, which TSEs are uniquely equipped to assist with given the team’s knowledge around Stripe’s products and active integrations. The team is largely remote, and we are very supportive of working arrangements that allow for family care and other needs to be met.

  • General software engineering skills are important to us, as we understand that new languages and frameworks can be learned if you understand the concepts
  • Experience teaching or coaching developers
  • Comfort working with a great deal of autonomy and limited supervision

About The Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth Facilitator Program:

  • Open to all Indigenous youth ages 18-29 who are interested in joining a movement of Indigenous young people leading discussions on mental health and wellbeing through our Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth.
  • Facilitators connect directly with their peers through live sharing circles led by and for Indigenous youth to build foundational mental health literacy, normalize mental health conversations and reduce stigma related to mental health and illness.
  • Participants build foundational skills in group facilitation, public speaking and advocacy through comprehensive training on how to facilitate vital conversations about mental health with their peers in a safe and supportive way.
  • Facilitators receive $250 for completing training and certifying as a Jack Talks for Indigenous Youth Facilitator, and are compensated $50 for each Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth they facilitate, in addition to $50 for the preparation of each talk.
    The time commitment for this program is approximately 2-5 hours a month between September and June, and approximately 4 hours for combined asynchronous and synchronous training once a term.

What is the Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth? Check out this video

The Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth puts community practice front and centre in educating about mental health struggle and healing from Indigenous perspectives. The program uses contact-based education and peer-to-peer outreach to connect Indigenous youth across Canada in conversations about mental health and healing.

A Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth is made up of two parts:

  • a video portion that explains social determinants of mental health from Indigenous perspectives and features youth stories about navigating mental health struggle, experiences with stigma and the relationship between culture, community and mental health
  • a live sharing circle led by an Indigenous Youth Facilitator who guides participants in exploring lessons and reflections, using the video portion as the spark for generating group discussion and connection.

We're seeking an exceptional candidate responsible for executing strategies that grow Open Farm's retail footprint in Northern California. The focus will be to strengthen relationships with key accounts and retailers, and ensure our products are well represented and top-of-mind for consumers in the retail space.

A Territory Sales Manager directly contributes to the company's overall growth by identifying new business opportunities, optimizing sales channels, and executing sales and retail initiatives that enhance visibility and market share across the region.   • Champion the Brand: Collaborate with marketing and retail partners to execute engaging promotional programs, events, and in-store activations that bring the Open Farm story to life.

jobs.description:
As a senior engineer, you'll work across a diverse software portfolio—improving UIs, adding optimization workflows, fixing C++ bugs, and building MCP servers for LLM integration—rather than being tied to one product.

You will work across our software portfolio rather than on a single product. On any given week that might mean improving the UI of a simulation control tool, adding a new optimisation workflow, fixing a bug in a C++ codebase, or building an MCP server that exposes one of our tools to an LLM agent.

UI quality and AI-friendliness are both priorities here, and they reinforce each other. A well-designed tool with clear inputs, predictable behaviour, and informative feedback is easier for a scientist to use and easier for an LLM to drive reliably. You will think about both audiences. Part of your work will be making our existing tools usable by AI agents, designing tool interfaces that behave well when an LLM is at the controls, and building agent pipelines that integrate with our simulation workflows.

We also have new projects to start from scratch. As you build familiarity with the domain and demonstrate ownership, there is genuine opportunity to lead one of those projects end-to-end.

No prior background in simulation or optimisation is expected. The domain is learnable and we will support that process. What matters is that you are genuinely curious, pick things up quickly, and enjoy building tools that serious technical users depend on.

C++ Programming Language; BS in Computer Science or applicable experience; must be fluent in English.

Minimum 5-8 years experience in this type of role and preferably in the semi-conductor industry.

Within Strategy and Planning specifically, Phoenix is anchored by three foundational initiatives we refer to internally as the Nirvana stages — the future-state systems that, once in place, give Mspark the operating foundation the rest of Phoenix builds on: the Rippling/Concur replacement, the Sage/Maestro replacement, and the Dynamics replacement. This role operates at both levels of the program: partnering with the three workstream owners at the strategic level and partnering directly with the owners of each Nirvana stage to keep those foundational initiatives on track and well-sequenced relative to one another.

This is a newly created position reporting directly to the CEO for the duration of Project Phoenix. It is designed for someone who can operate with real ownership at the intersection of planning, people, and communication. Depending on how the role and the company evolve, it may expand into a Chief of Staff position beyond the life of Phoenix — this is a role with significant room to grow alongside the company's needs.

What You'll Do

  • Own overall program planning for Project Phoenix — building and maintaining the master timeline, milestones, and dependencies across all three workstreams and the three Nirvana stages within Strategy and Planning.
  • Partner directly with each workstream owner (Running the Business, Strategy and Planning, and Execution and Operations) to track progress, surface risks early, and keep decisions moving at the pace the business needs.
  • Partner directly with the owners of each Nirvana stage — Rippling/Concur replacement, Sage/Maestro replacement, and Dynamics replacement — to track progress at the initiative level and ensure these foundational efforts stay coordinated with each other and with the broader Strategy and Planning workstream.
  • Identify where workstreams or Nirvana stages intersect or depend on one another and proactively resolve conflicts before they become execution problems.
  • Establish and run a consistent operating cadence for Phoenix — status reporting, leadership check-ins, and decision logs — so the CEO and workstream owners always have a current, accurate picture of where things stand.
  • Own company-wide communications about Phoenix, ensuring updates are clear, consistent, and delivered on a predictable rhythm across all levels of the organization.
  • Act as a trusted extension of the CEO on Phoenix — representing the CEO's priorities in working sessions they can't attend personally and flagging issues that need the CEO's direct attention.
  • Help translate high-level strategic direction into concrete plans, owners, and deadlines.

Qualification-What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional programs or projects, ideally through a period of significant organizational change.
  • Ability to connect authentically with people at every level of the organization — from the executive team to frontline staff — building the trust needed to get a straight answer from anyone.
  • Clear, direct communication, especially when challenges or issues arise. This person surfaces problems early and plainly rather than softening or delaying bad news.
  • No areas treated as off-limits or deflected elsewhere — this person engages directly with any part of the organization or any issue the program touches, rather than routing around difficulty.
  • Ability to hold the big picture of the overall transformation in view at all times, connecting individual workstream and Nirvana-stage decisions back to what Phoenix is ultimately trying to achieve.
  • Comfort operating close to executive leadership — someone who can synthesize ambiguous, fast-moving information into clear plans and clear communication.
  • Strong project management fundamentals: planning, sequencing, risk management, and status reporting, without being rigidly wedded to a single methodology.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to write for a whole-company audience as easily as for a small leadership room.
  • Discretion and judgment — this role will regularly have visibility into sensitive, not-yet-public information.
  • A bias toward action and follow-through; comfortable holding senior stakeholders accountable to commitments.
  • Experience with technology, systems implementations, or business transformation programs is a strong plus, though this role is about program leadership, not technical execution.

Why This Role Matters

Phoenix touches nearly every part of Mspark, and its success depends on more than good individual decisions in Sales, Technology Strategy, or Execution — it depends on those efforts staying connected, sequenced correctly, and communicated clearly to the entire company. This role exists to make sure that happens.

Growth Path

This role is scoped around Project Phoenix in the near term. As Phoenix matures and the company's needs evolve, there is a clear path for this position to expand into a broader Chief of Staff role supporting the CEO across the business.

Empower Pharmacy is a visionary healthcare company dedicated to making quality, affordable medication accessible to millions of patients nationwide. As the nation’s most advanced 503A compounding pharmacy and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facility, we’re redefining what’s possible in personalized medicine and pharmaceutical manufacturing. We’re proud to be recognized as one of Houston’s fastest-growing private companies and ranked #116 in Healthcare & Medical on the Inc. 5000 List for 2025.

Our strength is built on four core values: People, Quality, Service, and Innovation. Guided by these principles, we’ve created a uniquely integrated healthcare platform powered by advanced technology, operational excellence, and a relentless commitment to patient care. From manufacturing and quality control to distribution and customer experience, our teams work together to raise industry standards, expand access to critical medications, and improve outcomes for patients and providers across the country.

At Empower, joining our team means more than starting a new role. It means becoming part of a mission-driven organization that’s transforming healthcare at scale. We invest deeply in our people, encourage bold thinking, and create opportunities for growth, leadership, and innovation at every level. Your ideas matter here, your development is supported, and the work you do has a direct impact on the lives of millions.

If you thrive in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment where innovation, collaboration, and ambition come together, Empower Pharmacy is the place for you. Let’s transform healthcare together.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Director of Innovation & PMO owns the structure, velocity, and strategic ambition of the Marketing function at Empower Pharmacy. This role sits at the intersection of AI-enabled innovation, structured program management, and marketing experimentation. It exists to ensure the Marketing team executes against the highest-priority initiatives with rigor, consistently incubates ideas that drive incremental revenue, and launches programs that improve customer experience and brand performance.

This leader will build and govern the Marketing PMO, drive adoption of AI tools that improve speed and productivity across the team, and lead the design and launch of marketing experimentation programs. They report directly to the CMO and act as a force multiplier across brand, campaigns, content, demand generation, product and channel strategy.

The right candidate thinks in systems, executes with urgency, and has the commercial instincts to distinguish between experimentation for its own sake and innovation that moves the business forward. This role has no direct reports at launch but is expected to build and lead a team as the function matures.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Marketing PMO and Program Governance

  • Portfolio Ownership: Build and manage the Marketing PMO from the ground up. Own the full lifecycle of marketing initiatives from brief through post-launch review. Maintain a live portfolio view that enables the CMO to prioritize, deprioritize, and redeploy resources in real time.
  • Roadmap Planning: Translate CMO directives and marketing strategy into time-bound, cross-functional roadmaps with clear ownership, milestones, and escalation protocols. Ensure the team is always working on the highest-leverage activities.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as the integration point across Marketing disciplines and key stakeholder functions including Sales, Product, Customer Success, Legal, Regulatory, and Medical. Drive shared accountability and resolve misalignment before it creates execution risk.

Marketing Innovation and Experimentation

  • Innovation Pipeline: Build and steward the Marketing experimentation pipeline. Identify, evaluate, and advance ideas that improve revenue generation, customer acquisition, retention, or brand performance. Own the go/no-go framework for what gets resourced and launched.
  • Program Incubation: Design and launch structured marketing experimentation programs. Run experiments end-to-end when speed requires it; hand off to team members for scale when the model is proven. Ensure every program has a clear hypothesis, success metric, and decision point.
  • Channel Innovation: Identify emerging channels, campaign formats, and audience strategies that Empower has not yet activated. Bring structured test plans, not opinions. Convert what works into repeatable playbooks.

AI-Enabled Innovation

  • AI Workflow Design: Lead the identification and adoption of AI tools that make the Marketing team faster, more effective, and higher quality in their output. This includes generative AI for content and copy, AI-assisted campaign analytics, and automation of repeatable tasks across projects and programs. Build internal playbooks for responsible and compliant AI use in a regulated environment.
  • Performance Infrastructure: Build dashboards, KPIs, and reporting cadences that give the CMO and marketing leadership real-time visibility into campaign performance, pipeline influence, and channel effectiveness. Make data the default language of the team.
  • Capability Building: Evaluate, implement, and scale AI tools across the Marketing function. Develop team fluency in AI-assisted workflows and establish governance standards that ensure compliant, effective use across all marketing programs.

Strategic Leadership and Planning

  • CMO Alignment: Act as a force multiplier for the CMO by translating strategic vision into executable plans with clear owners, timelines, and success metrics. Surface risks and tradeoffs early to enable proactive decision-making.
  • Resource Prioritization: Maintain visibility into team capacity and initiative load across the marketing portfolio. Enable real-time reallocation of resources toward the highest-impact programs and away from lower-priority work.
  • Team Development: This role launches as an individual contributor but is expected to build and lead a team as the function matures. Identify talent needs, define team structure, and develop the case for investment as scope and results expand.

Execution and Accountability

  • Operational Rigor: Establish the operating rhythms, tools, and norms that enable the Marketing team to execute with consistency and speed. Ensure every initiative has a clear brief, defined ownership, and a structured review cadence.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Synthesize complexity into clear executive narratives and practical team-level direction. Maintain stakeholder confidence through transparent reporting, proactive escalation, and disciplined follow-through.
  • Outcome Orientation: Hold the Marketing team accountable to measurable results. Define what success looks like before launch, track performance against commitments, and ensure learnings are captured and applied to future programs.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  • Deep expertise in marketing program management, innovation pipeline development, and structured experimentation in complex, regulated, or high-growth environments. Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve effectiveness, speed, and productivity across marketing projects and programs; able to evaluate, adopt, and build team capability around AI in a compliant, regulated environment.
  • Strong command of marketing experimentation methodology: hypothesis design, test structure, statistical significance, and scaling what works.
  • Proven ability to manage concurrent, cross-functional marketing programs such as balancing scope, risk, and stakeholder alignment while delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Able to synthesize complexity into clear executive narratives and practical team-level direction. Comfortable operating in regulated industries and understands how to move quickly without creating compliance exposure.

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred. 7+ years in B2B or B2C marketing, marketing operations, or strategy roles, with at least 3 years at a Manager level or above in a high-growth or regulated environment.
  • Demonstrated experience building or managing a marketing PMO, program governance function, or operational marketing structure. Hands-on experience deploying AI tools in a marketing or operational context, with specific examples of tools implemented and outcomes achieved.
  • Experience in a regulated industry required. Healthcare, specialty pharma, compounding, telehealth, or life sciences backgrounds prioritized. Track record of designing and running structured marketing experiments that produced measurable, scalable outcomes.
  • Proven cross-functional collaborator with experience working alongside Sales, Product, Customer Success, Legal, Regulatory, and Medical teams.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Builds trust through customer-centric solutions.
  • Strategic AI: Guides responsible AI adoption and adaptation.
  • Optimizes Work Processes: Drives efficiency with continuous improvement.
  • Collaborates: Partners effectively to achieve shared goals.
  • Resourcefulness: Secures and deploys resources efficiently.
  • Manages Complexity: Simplifies and solves complex challenges.
  • Ensures Accountability: Delivers on commitments with integrity.
  • Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach to shifting conditions.
  • Communicates Effectively: Tailors messages to diverse audiences.

Values:

  • People: Empowering people defines who we are.
  • Quality: Excellence in every product, every time.
  • Service: Serving others is our highest purpose.
  • Innovation: Advancing care through technology and discovery.
