jobs.description:
Fractional Lead Marketing Manager (6–8 Hours per Week) – FinTech / Remote

PLEASE READ THE FULL JOB DESCRIPTION BEFORE APPLYING

Location: Remote
Working Pattern: Fractional – approximately 6–8 hours per week
Environment: Early-Stage FinTech

About the Opportunity

Our client is an early-stage FinTech business developing technology designed to improve access to financial services for businesses operating internationally.

The company is entering an important stage of its development and is building out its leadership and functional capability as it moves towards greater commercial readiness and growth.

As part of this next phase, the business is looking for a Fractional Lead Marketing Manager who can take meaningful ownership of its developing marketing function.

This is not a traditional marketing-management position within an established department.

You will be joining an early-stage organisation where positioning, messaging, channels, content and marketing processes are still developing. You will therefore need to be equally comfortable thinking strategically and personally executing the work required to turn that strategy into activity.

The opportunity is particularly suited to an ambitious marketing professional who is ready for broader functional ownership, enjoys building rather than inheriting, and wants the opportunity to demonstrate their ability within an early-stage FinTech environment.

Further details regarding the engagement and participation structure will be discussed directly with candidates progressing through the process.

Application – Mandatory Qualifying Questions

Please submit your CV together with a cover letter. Within your cover letter, you must answer each of the mandatory qualifying questions below.

  1. What experience do you have within B2B marketing, FinTech, financial services or another complex technology environment?
  2. Please provide an example of a marketing strategy, campaign or go-to-market initiative that you personally helped create and execute. What did you personally do and what was the outcome?
  3. What experience do you have developing positioning, messaging and content for complex B2B products or services?
  4. Please provide an example of marketing activity that you personally executed rather than delegated to a team or agency.
  5. What experience do you have generating measurable commercial outcomes such as qualified pipeline, customer engagement, partnerships, adoption or revenue?
  6. What experience do you have working within an early-stage or resource-conscious organisation where you were required to operate without a large established marketing team or budget?
  7. Do you have experience within FinTech, payments, banking, lending, trade finance or another regulated financial-services environment? Please explain.
  8. This opportunity requires approximately 6–8 hours per week. Can you consistently commit to this level of involvement alongside your other professional commitments?

These questions are mandatory and form part of our initial assessment process. Applications that do not provide a clear answer to every mandatory qualifying question will be automatically disqualified and will not be considered further in the recruitment process.

What You'll Be Doing

You will help build and lead the company's developing marketing capability, including:

  • Developing and executing the marketing plan
  • Refining market positioning, messaging and value proposition
  • Supporting go-to-market activity
  • Creating and coordinating content across relevant channels
  • Developing the company's digital and professional market presence
  • Supporting thought leadership and founder-led marketing
  • Developing communications for different audiences and stakeholders
  • Supporting commercial, partnership and customer-facing initiatives
  • Helping translate complex financial and technical concepts into clear external narratives
  • Identifying appropriate marketing channels and testing their effectiveness
  • Developing appropriate campaign and content calendars
  • Establishing marketing metrics and reporting
  • Using data and market feedback to improve activity
  • Helping determine future marketing resource and capability requirements as the organisation grows

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity. You should expect to personally execute activity rather than simply develop strategy for others to deliver.

What We're Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you have:

  • Strong B2B marketing experience
  • Experience taking meaningful ownership of marketing activity
  • Strong positioning and messaging capability
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Experience creating and executing marketing plans
  • Strong commercial instincts
  • Experience working with senior leaders or founders
  • Confidence marketing technically or financially complex propositions
  • Experience operating within early-stage or high-growth environments
  • The ability to prioritise effectively when resources are limited
  • The willingness to remain hands-on while taking increasing functional ownership
  • The ability to make meaningful impact within approximately 6–8 hours per week

Experience within FinTech, financial services, payments, banking, B2B technology or another regulated environment would be particularly valuable.

We are more interested in demonstrable capability, ownership and results than job title or corporate seniority.

Engagement Structure

This is a flexible, fractional engagement of approximately 6–8 hours per week within an early-stage FinTech venture.

It is designed for someone who understands the nature of participating in an early-stage business and is comfortable with a structure centred on longer-term participation in company growth rather than a conventional package at this stage.

The role can therefore be undertaken alongside other compatible professional commitments.

Full details of the participation structure will be discussed with candidates progressing through the process.

jobs.excerpt: About Kraymer Art & Anime StudioKraymer Art started as a jewelry brand for people who take their fandom seriously, collector-grade pieces made for people who notice the details, and it's grown a loyal community along the way.
jobs.description:
About Kraymer Art & Anime Studio

Kraymer Art started as a jewelry brand for people who take their fandom seriously, collector-grade pieces made for people who notice the details, and it's grown a loyal community along the way. We're now building out a new kind of anime studio alongside it, one built around the stories and creators that the indie community loves most, turning beloved manga, manhwa, and webcomics into fully produced anime for a passionate, fast-growing audience.

The Role

This is a ground-floor marketing seat spanning both sides of what we're building: an established brand with a loyal following, and a brand-new studio launching from zero. You are not coming in to run someone else's playbook. You're coming in to build the studio's presence from scratch, right alongside growing what's already working on the jewelry side.

To be specific: you'll be growing two things at once, KraymerTV (the anime studio's social presence, starting from zero) and Kraymer Art's existing jewelry channels.

We're looking for someone who has actually grown a social audience from nothing, who knows what real community-building, earned reach, and launch marketing looks like end to end, and who is genuinely excited to build both voices at once. This is a rare opportunity to have real ownership at a company that is still early enough that your fingerprints will be on everything we build.

What you'll own: Anime Studio / KraymerTV (build from zero)

  • Build KraymerTV's social presence from the ground up: content pillars, posting cadence, and a real content calendar across platforms, with the goal of growing followers, reach, and engagement from a standing start.
  • Plan and run an earned-reach strategy to get people talking: shareable hooks/mechanics, seeding relevant online communities, and sparking user-generated content and word of mouth (not just "boost the budget and hope").
  • Own the growth funnel at every stage, from pre-launch through launch and beyond: subscribe/waitlist offer, landing page copy, and signup flow, evolving as the studio moves from pre-launch to a real, growing audience.
  • Plan and help execute paid social ad campaigns: creative direction, copy, and overall ad strategy.
  • Partner with our email team/agency on a welcome and nurture email sequence for new subscribers.
  • Help shape and carry a single, consistent brand message across every touchpoint (social, landing page, email, ads) so the studio's launch feels unified rather than scattered.
  • Lay early community groundwork: identify where engaged fans are already showing up (comments, replies, shares) and how to nurture that ahead of future community spaces.
  • Exercise judgment on sensitive or brand-critical topics and flag anything that needs leadership sign-off before it goes public.

What you'll own: Kraymer Art / Jewelry

  • Manage and grow Kraymer Art's existing social channels (Instagram, YouTube), building on an established following.
  • Keep messaging consistent with the jewelry brand's voice (collector-grade, minimalist, design-led, craftsmanship-focused) while adapting tone appropriately when content crosses over with the anime studio.
  • Identify where the jewelry audience (Gen Z and younger millennials, fashion-forward anime/manga/gaming fans, largely US-based) overlaps with the anime studio's audience, and plan cross-promotion that grows both without alienating either.

How you'll work

  • We're a fully remote, async-first team, so clear and frequent communication is essential, not optional. You should be proactive about sharing progress, flagging blockers, and giving honest status updates without being chased.
  • Poor communication (going quiet, unclear updates, or surprises instead of early flags) is a dealbreaker for this role.
  • Comfortable owning two related but distinct brand voices at once and knowing when to keep them separate versus cross-pollinate.
  • High autonomy, high accountability: this role is about judgment and point of view, not just task execution. You'll be expected to bring recommendations, not just requests for direction.

What we're looking for

  • Genuine knowledge of and interest in anime/manga/manhwa, and fandom culture. You understand what these communities care about, how they talk, and what earns their trust, because you're already in the space or have marketed within it, not learning it from scratch on the job.
  • Proven experience growing a social media presence from zero: real examples of audience, reach, and engagement growth you can point to, not just managing an already-large account.
  • Experience with earned-reach or community-driven growth tactics (organic/UGC-driven), in addition to paid social advertising.
  • Strong copywriting instincts across formats: social captions, landing pages, ad creative, email.
  • Ability to juggle two brand identities and audiences under one company umbrella.
  • Excellent written communication and a track record of working well in a remote, async team; comfortable giving regular updates without prompting.
  • Startup mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and building process as you go.
  • Nice to have: experience in jewelry or fashion e-commerce, or working directly with independent creators/IP.

Why Work With Us

  • Genuine Flexibility: We are results-oriented. As long as the work gets done at a fast pace and the KPIs are met, you manage your own schedule.
  • Long-term job: We're looking to hire someone full-time for this position for the long haul.
  • Fully remote: No more long hours stuck in commute, join our entire team who are fully remote.
  • Work within a fun industry of anime jewelry and accessories, something perfect for anime fans and/or jewelry enthusiasts.
  • Ground-floor ownership: Beyond growing an established jewelry brand, you'll get to build our brand-new anime studio's social presence from zero, real influence on something still taking shape from day one.

SAP PRICING/INPUT ANALYST

THE POSITION IN A NUTSHELL

Sciens Building Solutions is seeking an experienced SAP Pricing/Input Analyst to support the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of pricing and related input data across the Sciens enterprise. This role is primarily administrative and detail-oriented, ensuring that supplier price books, standard parts pricing, one-off pricing requests, and other approved inputs are correctly prepared, validated, maintained, and communicated for use in SAP, SAP CPQ, estimating, purchasing, and related business processes.

The SAP Pricing/Input Analyst will work closely with procurement, finance, sales, estimating, operations, SAP master-data teams, Division stakeholders, and suppliers. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with large volumes of data, and able to follow defined processes, while identifying discrepancies and escalating issues quickly. This role supports Sciens’ continued effort to standardize pricing practices and improve data quality across all Divisions nationwide.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING (and doing well!)

Pricing and Input Administration

  • Maintain accurate and current supplier price books, standard parts pricing, labor-related pricing inputs, and other approved pricing data used by Sciens Divisions.
  • Receive, organize, review, and prepare pricing updates for entry or upload into SAP and related systems.
  • Process one-off parts and pricing requests in accordance with established approval and documentation requirements.
  • Validate pricing inputs against supplier information, approved price books, effective dates, part numbers, descriptions, units of measure, and other required fields.
  • Track manufacturer and supplier pricing changes, discontinued items, new items, substitutions, and other updates that may affect estimating or purchasing.
  • Confirm that pricing changes are complete, accurate, appropriately supported, and ready for ERP-team processing.

SAP and Data Quality Support

  • Enter, maintain, and support pricing-related master data in SAP, SAP CPQ, or designated input templates and repositories.
  • Perform data-quality reviews to identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, outdated, or incorrectly formatted pricing records.
  • Reconcile system pricing to supplier price books and approved source documentation; research and resolve discrepancies.
  • Maintain clear audit trails and documentation for pricing changes, approvals, effective dates, and follow-up items.
  • Coordinate with SAP master-data and ERP teams to submit approved updates and confirm successful processing.
  • Support data loads, testing, validation, and post-update reviews during SAP enhancements, releases, and Divisional go-lives.

Cross-Functional and Division Support

  • Serve as a reliable point of contact for Divisions and internal stakeholders regarding pricing inputs, data requirements, and update status.
  • Partner with Sciens procurement and suppliers to obtain current price books, pricing notices, product information, and supporting documentation.
  • Work with sales, estimating, finance, operations, and purchasing to understand how pricing data is used and identify downstream impacts.
  • Respond to questions and research pricing-related issues in a timely and professional manner.
  • Help communicate standardized procedures and reinforce consistent pricing-input practices across Sciens Divisions.
  • Prepare routine status reports, issue logs, reconciliation summaries, and other reporting requested by management.

Process Improvement and Compliance

  • Follow Sciens policies, procedures, internal controls, approval requirements, and data-governance standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve pricing-input workflows, templates, controls, documentation, and reporting.
  • Support the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures and job aids for pricing administration.
  • Recommend practical process improvements that increase accuracy, reduce rework, and improve turnaround time.
  • Protect confidential supplier, pricing, financial, and company information.
  • Participate in special projects and perform other job-related duties as assigned.

WHAT WE LIKE ABOUT YOU

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, supply chain, information systems, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Three to five years of experience in pricing administration, master data, purchasing, procurement operations, ERP support, data analysis, or a related function.
  • Experience working with SAP, SAP CPQ, another ERP system, or structured pricing/master-data processes.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including sorting, filtering, lookups, formulas, data validation, and reconciliation of large data sets.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain accurate records and manage repetitive, detail-sensitive work with a high degree of consistency.
  • Ability to review source documentation, identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and follow issues through resolution.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work with suppliers, internal stakeholders, and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Positive, service-oriented approach and willingness to support stakeholders across a growing national organization.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience maintaining supplier price books, parts catalogs, material masters, labor rates, or similar commercial data.
  • Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA, SAP CPQ, SAP Ariba, SAP Materials Management, or related SAP processes.
  • Familiarity with purchasing, inventory, estimating, pricing, or procure-to-pay processes.
  • Experience with data-load templates, SAP Migration Cockpit, reporting tools, or data-governance practices.
  • Experience in the fire and life-safety, construction, service, distribution, or other multi-Division environment.
  • SAP certification or formal training in supply chain, procurement, finance, or data management.

WHAT WE’RE BRINGING TO THE TABLE

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications.
  • Paid time off plan and holidays.
  • 401(k) matching.
  • Short-term and long-term disability.
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans with options.
  • Life insurance.
  • Professional career development opportunities.
  • Tuition reimbursement program.

Senior Data Analyst (LTV / Predictive Analytics)

StellarTech is a B2C mobile publisher in EdTech: subscription apps, in-app monetization and performance marketing at scale. LTV prediction is how we decide where to invest, and the forecasting pipeline is already live. We are opening this role to have one senior analyst own its accuracy and its evolution. This is research and predictive analytics, not reporting: everything that can be standardised is already automated by Data Engineering, so the work is hypotheses, factor analysis and improvements to the prediction algorithm itself. You report to the Head of the Operational Department and work directly with Product, UA, Finance and Data Engineering.

What you will do

  • Own and develop the LTV prediction algorithm: find the parameters and factors that increase forecast accuracy, prototype improvements in SQL, measure the gain, then hand the logic over to Data Engineering.
  • Validate forecasts on closed cohorts, monitor forecast quality over time and explain where exactly a model deviates from actual LTV.
  • Research what moves LTV: product features, segments, purchase sources (for example, purchases coming through CRM vs other sources), and adapt the prediction logic to them.
  • Run analytical research end to end, from a vague question to a documented recommendation for Product, UA and Finance: where payback improves, where to concentrate media buying, what changes unit economics at company level.
  • Automate analytical routines and model quality monitoring together with Data Engineering.

Requirements

Critical

  • 4+ years in Data Analyst / Senior Data Analyst / Product Analyst roles with a product analytics focus: measuring the impact of factors on business metrics, not marketing attribution.
  • Strong SQL: complex queries, window functions, optimisation. Here SQL is the main instrument for prototyping and testing the algorithm.
  • Solid mathematical statistics and understanding of how ML models work: you can build and validate a forecast, judge model quality (MAE, RMSE, MAPE, R2), run factor analysis and explain where a model broke.
  • Product background with in-app monetization and its economics: LTV, cohorts, retention, ROI, CAC, ARPU, payback. Subscriptions are ideal; other in-app B2C models also work. Ad-only monetization is a different pattern and is not a fit.
  • A proven end-to-end pattern: you take a vague question, form a hypothesis, dig into it and bring it to a recommendation. There is no micromanagement here and almost no standard tasks.
  • Ability to back conclusions with data and to communicate them to both technical and business stakeholders.

Non-critical

  • Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) for analysis and modelling: welcome, but not a blocker if the statistical and analytical thinking is there.
  • A/B testing and statistical hypothesis testing.
  • BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
  • Cloud DWH and large data volumes (Athena, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift or similar).

Will be a plus

  • Feature engineering and model interpretation (SHAP, feature importance).
  • Mobile products, gaming or subscription businesses.
  • Our stack: Amazon Athena, S3-based DWH, CatBoost, Tableau, Git, Jupyter.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

  • Impactful Work: Your contributions will directly shape the future of our company.
  • Innovative Environment: We're all about trying new things and pushing the envelope in EdTech.
  • AI solutions
  • Wealth: We offer a competitive salary.
  • Balance: Flexible paid time off, you get 21 days of annual leave + 10 bank holidays.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work alongside passionate professionals who are as driven as you are.

Hiring process

  • Intro call with the recruiter.
  • Technical interview: SQL, statistics and ML fundamentals, plus an analytical case on how you build a plan to investigate a problem.
  • Final interview with the department head. Optionally, a 30-minute culture fit conversation with HRBP.

If this is the kind of work you want to own, send us your CV. We will come back to you with the next step.

Overview

You will work daily to overcome the barriers faced by members early in recovery and must adopt a “member-first” attitude that prioritizes keeping members safe and engaged in treatment at all costs. Flexibility, empathy, and commitment to member success are critical attributes for a successful Staff Provider. You will also provide longitudinal maintenance care to a panel of members (pending prescription cap capacity). Additionally, you will support your regular provider colleagues by providing coverage when medical questions or needs arise and these providers are unavailable.

Your knowledge of the Groups Recovery System and the Groups culture will be critical for ensuring successful launches of Groups into new markets and new geographies within existing markets. Finally, you will be an integral partner of the medical leadership team in developing and deploying new medical service lines for our members.

Salary range: $110,253 – $126,929 *based on experience and education.

Responsibilities

  • Adhere to all clinical policies and procedures as outlined in the GRS Manual
  • Intake medical duties
  • Determine each patient’s medical necessity and appropriateness for treatment pursuant to applicable clinical models, policies and procedures, and manuals (e.g., Recovery System Manual) as required by Recover Together. For patients admitted to treatment, prescribe buprenorphine/naloxone and, where appropriate, other approved medications to treat withdrawal symptoms, in a manner consistent with Recover Together’s policies and procedures and Recovery System Manual.
  • Maintain a regular schedule of “intake shifts”, and be available to provide rapid-access telemedicine intakes across multiple geographies, including new markets.
  • Complete all intake documentation thoroughly, efficiently, and accurately.
  • Be accountable for successful initiation of MAT during the early weeks of treatment (weeks 1-4, approximately).
  • As needed, coordinate with community providers to support the successful transition of new members into Groups.
  • Collaborate with other provider colleagues to transition the care of new members into regular maintenance groups.
  • Escalate controversial situations to appropriate medical and/or clinical leadership;
  • Maintenance medical duties
    • Maintain a panel of maintenance members and serve as their dedicated provider at monthly provider groups, per the guidelines of the Groups. Recovery System.
    • Meet with each patient for whom the Physician prescribes buprenorphine at least once every thirty (30) days. This interaction occurs in a group setting, with individual conversations occurring before or after the group as needed. Such meetings may occur via telemedicine, to the extent Physician complies with all applicable federal and state laws, rules, and regulations and any requirements set forth by applicable payers (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, commercial plans) governing telemedicine.
    • Be available by phone and email to discuss each patient’s medical issues in between monthly visits (e.g., dose changes; prescription troubleshooting, interprofessional communication and collaboration).
    • When indicated and medically necessary, meet with patients for a pre-scheduled individual session to review medical progress. These visits are separate from the individual conversations that occur before and after regular shared medical visits. Such meetings may occur via telemedicine, to the extent Physician complies with all applicable federal and state laws, rules, and regulations and any requirements set forth by applicable payers (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, commercial plans) governing telemedicine.
  • Medical Records
    • In compliance with HIPAA and other applicable federal or state laws, rules or regulations regarding medical records, maintain patient records in confidence and complete records in a timely fashion and in accordance with policies of the Company.

    • Provide regular coverage for “makeup groups” and makeup 1:1 sessions.
    • Provide as needed cross-coverage for colleagues and answers to medical questions when other providers are unavailable.
    • Participate in rotating “on-call” schedule of urgent prescription coverage for unavailable providers.
    • Facilitate access to the State’s prescription drug monitoring database so Groups staff can regularly monitor the Provider’s patients’ access to controlled substances, per Recover Together’s clinical protocols.
  • Administrative duties - approximately 15% per week
    • Completing high quality documentation, specifically all medical encounters accurately and thoroughly on the same business day as the encounter
    • Sign all prescriptions on the same business day that they are generated
    • Manage group and individual sessions in a timely manner so members and office staff stay on schedule
    • Work with the office staff to maintain a clinical schedule that is mutually beneficial to provider and the office;
    • Stay familiar with all Recover Together policies, procedures, reference materials, contracts, etc.
    • Follow up on interprofessional communication
    • Assist with onboarding, training, and support of new providers.
    • Work with the medical leadership team to pilot new initiatives to improve outcomes during early treatment,
    • Assist with other duties as assigned.

About Us

CipherHealth is an award winning software company committed to enhancing care coordination and outcomes across the continuum. Since 2009, CipherHealth’s automated, scalable platform has empowered healthcare organizations to engage patients and care teams at every touchpoint, streamlining workflows and improving experiences. With tailored communication solutions powered by AI and deep integrations, CipherHealth drives better clinical results, operational efficiency, and financial sustainability, transforming healthcare one interaction at a time.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Product Manager to own a product area end to end—from discovery and definition through delivery and iteration. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success to ship products customers love and that drive measurable business results.

What makes product management here different is how we work. You'll operate inside an agentic PM loop, where AI agents handle much of the analytical and synthesis work—summarizing feedback, surfacing patterns, and drafting first-pass artifacts—so you can spend more time on customer empathy, prioritization, and cross-functional alignment. You'll also participate actively in our Product Council model, where cross-functional teams plan, prioritize, and own roadmaps together.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own a product area. Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for your domain, aligned to company goals and customer needs.
  • Drive discovery. Run continuous customer discovery, user research, and data-informed analysis to identify the right problems to solve.
  • Define and prioritize. Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria; maintain a well-groomed, prioritized backlog.
  • Ship and iterate. Partner with Engineering and Design to deliver on a healthy cadence; measure outcomes and iterate based on results.
  • Go to market. Work with Marketing, Sales, and CS on positioning, launch, and adoption for your area.
  • Communicate clearly. Keep stakeholders informed on priorities, trade-offs, and progress.

How You'll Work With AI

You'll be a power user of our agentic PM loop—a set of product-analyst agents that augment your day-to-day work. You'll use, evaluate, and help improve agents that:

  • Summarize support tickets and identify recurring themes
  • Cluster feature requests across channels
  • Watch competitors and flag meaningful moves
  • Analyze churn and surface root causes
  • Identify customer pain themes from unstructured feedback
  • Summarize sales calls and Gong recordings
  • Monitor usage analytics for adoption and friction signals
  • Generate weekly opportunity reports
  • Draft first-pass PRDs for you to refine and own

You won't just consume agent output—you'll treat it as a starting point, apply product judgment, validate with customers and data, and help us improve the quality and usefulness of the loop over time.

Product Council Participation

Each product area runs a recurring Product Council for Epic and Sprint planning. As the PM for your area, you'll:

  • Lead planning for your product's council meetings
  • Bring evidence from discovery, analytics, and the agentic PM loop into prioritization discussions
  • Engage cross-functional partners—Sales and CS participation is mandatory and expected to be substantive, not ceremonial
  • Produce and maintain a roadmap for your area that reflects customer needs, business value, and resourced priorities
  • Present your roadmap to the Strategic Product Council for alignment and resource allocation across company Threads

What Success Looks Like

  • You ship products that solve real customer problems and move the metrics that matter.
  • Your roadmap is evidence-based, clearly prioritized, and trusted by cross-functional partners.
  • You leverage the agentic PM loop effectively—faster insight, sharper prioritization, stronger first drafts.
  • Product Council meetings are productive, decisions are clear, and Sales/CS feel genuinely heard.
  • You grow in product craft while helping us refine how humans and agents work together.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–7+ years in product management with a track record of shipping products in B2B SaaS or a comparable environment.
  • Strong product craft. Comfortable with discovery, prioritization frameworks, roadmapping, PRD writing, and defining success metrics.
  • Customer and data driven. You ground decisions in customer insight and quantitative signals, not gut feel alone.
  • Agentic mindset. You're excited to work alongside AI agents, not threatened by them—you know where automation helps and where human judgment is essential.
  • Cross-functional collaborator. You build trust with Engineering, Design, Sales, and CS and run effective planning sessions with them.
  • Clear communicator. You write and present crisply; stakeholders always know what you're building, why, and what's next.
  • Ownership mentality. You take responsibility for outcomes in your area, not just output.

Orchestrating the data that funds the future of food

The Good Food Institute (GFI) is a nonprofit think tank working to make the global food system better for the planet, people, and animals. Alongside scientists, businesses, and policymakers, GFI’s teams focus on making plant-based, fermentation-enabled, and cultivated meat delicious, affordable, and accessible. Powered by philanthropy, GFI is an international network of organizations advancing alternative proteins as an essential solution needed to meet the world’s climate, global health, food security, and biodiversity goals.

How you will make a difference

In this position, you will have the opportunity to provide service-oriented support to the Development, Finance, and program teams by maintaining accurate, timely gift data in Salesforce and responding quickly to the data needs of internal stakeholders. You will be the go-to resource for the fundraising team’s day-to-day data questions — fielding ad hoc requests, resolving data discrepancies, and ensuring that gift records are always current and trustworthy. Success in this position requires not just attention to detail, but a genuine service orientation: the ability to triage competing requests, communicate clearly under pressure, and deliver reliable results to colleagues who depend on accurate data to do their jobs. The Donor Operations Coordinator will be responsible for:

Internal stakeholder support

  • Serving as the primary point of contact for gift data inquiries from the Development, Finance, and program teams — responding promptly and accurately to ad hoc requests for records, reports, and reconciliation details.
  • Triaging and prioritizing competing requests from multiple internal stakeholders, communicating realistic timelines, and proactively flagging delays.
  • Partnering with the Development Operations team to identify recurring pain points and build lightweight processes that reduce the volume of repetitive requests over time.
  • Maintaining a solutions-first approach when colleagues need urgent answers during high-pressure fundraising periods.

Gift entry

  • Entering donor gifts into Salesforce on a consistent weekly basis, including checks, ACH transactions, and non-cash gifts, ensuring accurate and complete record of all incoming gifts.
  • Processing and entering third-party fundraiser (TPF) gifts on a monthly basis.
  • Following established SOPs for all gift entry and surfacing process gaps or inconsistencies to the Director of Development Operations.
  • Reviewing data quality reports regularly to identify and resolve discrepancies before they surface as downstream problems for the team.

Gift acknowledgement

  • Processing gift acknowledgments electronically or via postal mail in a timely manner, including during high-volume year-end periods.
  • Maintaining and updating acknowledgment templates as needed in coordination with the Development team.
  • Coordinating with the Development team on special acknowledgment needs for major donors or campaigns.

Data import, reconciliation, and reporting

  • Supporting the Development team with bulk data imports and updates, including preparing datasets for import and ensuring data accuracy and consistency with data quality standards.
  • Supporting the gift reconciliation process between Salesforce and the financial accounting systems in collaboration with the Salesforce and Finance teams.
  • Running standard Salesforce reports on request and assisting colleagues in interpreting data outputs.
  • Performing other duties as assigned

Who we’re looking for

An ideal candidate for the Donor Operations Coordinator position will have experience that reflects the following:

  • At least 3 years of experience providing service-oriented support to fundraising or other data-driven teams.
  • Systems-oriented thinker who can see how the data pieces fit together, proactively recommend solutions, and partner with the team to resolve issues.
  • Demonstrated experience with data entry in Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform, preferably in a nonprofit environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high degree of organization — the ability to work accurately under frequent interruption is essential.
  • Clear and proactive written and verbal communication style that allows colleagues to rely on you to get the job done and to proactively reach out with updates.
  • Comfort managing multiple concurrent, competing requests and the judgment to prioritize effectively.
  • Ability to perform self-directed work while remaining consistently responsive to the team.
  • Availability to support GFI’s year-end fundraising activity, which may require longer than typical working hours (up to 29 hours per work week) during December and the beginning of January.
  • Familiarity with nonprofit fundraising operations and donor management preferred.
  • Experience with third-party fundraising platforms and/or Apsona preferred.
  • Prior experience in an internal operations support position involving shared inboxes, ticketing queues, or high-volume internal request management preferred.
  • A commitment to fostering a work environment that is respectful, supportive, fair, and welcoming to all.
  • Comfort working remotely in a collaborative, caring, and high-performing culture that values inclusion and innovation.
  • Strong support for GFI’s philosophy and mission; demonstrated interest in plant-based & other alternative proteins, public health, environmentalism, climate change, animal protection, or hunger relief.
  • A commitment to GFI’s values: believe change is possible, do the most good we can, share knowledge freely, act on evidence, and invite everyone to the table.

GFI wants the best people and is committed to a fair hiring process. We use a third-party anonymizing tool to redact personal information from submitted applications — including name, location, contact details, and several other factors — to increase fairness in our process. We also prioritize an inclusive work environment absent of discrimination and harassment during the application process and after you join the team. Please see our full Equal Opportunity Statement:

If you are passionate about GFI’s mission, think you have what it takes to be successful in this position, and meet many of the job requirements — even if you don’t check all the boxes — please apply. We’d appreciate the opportunity to consider your application.

The fine print

  • Terms of employment: Part-time, 20 hours per work week, exempt
  • Reports to: Paul Bradley, Director of Development Operations
  • Location: Remote; United States
  • Travel: Up to two weeks per year for organization retreats (reasonable accommodations for and exemptions from organization retreats considered on a case-by-case basis).
  • Benefits: Working from home; paid employee base medical coverage; dental, vision, and other medical insurance options; a 401(k) plan with employer match; 14 paid holidays; personal, sick, and vacation time; paid family/parental and medical leave; lifestyle spending account; opportunity for advancement; and a respectful and collaborative culture. More information here: .

At this time, GFI's policy is not to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas.
  • Salary: $36,466.45 - $37,669.84 (depending on experience and qualifications)

Important dates

Application instructions

GFI uses an anonymized hiring system that redacts key identifying personal information from all applications. We use this tool as part of a wider effort to reduce bias in our hiring process. Following these instructions will help to ensure your application is not delayed by a failed redaction.

  • Please use consistent names. It helps to ensure that the name you use in your resume and cover letter is the same as the name you type into the application below. For example, if your name is Jennifer, please sign your cover letter as “Jennifer” rather than “Jenny.”

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT FALCON ELECTRICFalcon keeps the systems modern life depends on running where ordinary power gives out: the remote pump station, the roadside traffic cabinet, the treatment plant that can never go dark.
jobs.description:
ABOUT FALCON ELECTRIC

Falcon keeps the systems modern life depends on running where ordinary power gives out: the remote pump station, the roadside traffic cabinet, the treatment plant that can never go dark. For 35 years, when conditions are too hot, too cold, too dirty, or too far from anywhere for standard equipment to survive, engineers have specified Falcon. We build true online power protection engineered for the field, and we stand behind it without dispute.

We have something rare: a 35-year engineering reputation, the trust of the engineers who stake their projects on us, and a mission worth winning. We chose the hardest corner of the power world on purpose, and we intend to own it completely, bringing the hunger of a startup to a company that earned its credibility the hard way. Part of that bet is how we work: our vision is to be AI-native, using AI and building our own into how we operate so a focused team can move with the speed and reach of one many times its size, with AI doing the heavy lifting and people making the calls that matter. We are early. The engine is being built now, not bought off a shelf, and you will help build it.

This is a chance to build something that matters, protecting the water, transportation, and power infrastructure the world runs on, with people who move fast, own their outcomes, and are a little obsessed with winning. If that is your kind of work, come build it with us.

WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW

This is a revenue seat, not a brand-and-comms one. B2B buying has changed: most buyers research independently, and the large majority now use AI answer engines to shortlist suppliers before they ever talk to sales. MQL volume has stopped predicting revenue, and demand generation is now judged on the qualified pipeline it creates and the deals it helps close. Falcon needs someone who builds the system that produces that pipeline and makes the Industry Account Executive and Channel Manager measurably more effective.

Falcon's edge is a signal-driven, account-based engine, not spray and pray. We identify the accounts and projects that are actually in-market in our verticals, put our sellers in front of them with the intelligence to win, and make Falcon the answer buyers find when they research harsh-environment power through AI. You own that engine end to end.

This is an AI-native builder role. The engine is being built now, not bought off a shelf. You design the workflows, direct Falcon's managed AI workforce to run the research, enrichment, and drafting, and keep people on the decisions that matter. If you use AI as a genuine force multiplier and think in pipeline, this role is built for you.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • The lead-generation engine. Design and run Falcon's demand engine: a system that delivers a steady flow of researched, prioritized, quote-ready opportunities to the direct and channel teams every week, with qualified pipeline contribution as your primary number.
  • Signal-based ABM. Use intent and buying-signal data to find the accounts and projects that are in-market in each priority vertical, and run coordinated, account-based programs that put the Industry Account Executive and Channel Manager in front of the right buying committee at the right time.
  • Lists, enrichment, and automation. Build, segment, and continuously enrich Falcon's target-account and contact data with buying context, product fit, and contact mapping, and design the AI-driven workflows that automate the research, enrichment, scoring, and routing behind it.
  • Sales and channel enablement. Arm the Industry Account Executive and Channel Manager with account briefs, buying signals, fit-check and quote-ready notes, application content, and ready-to-send outreach so they win more deals, faster.
  • Content and answer-engine visibility (AEO/GEO). Direct Falcon's managed AI marketing workforce to produce vertical content, application notes, and comparison and selection guides, and optimize so Falcon is the source AI answer engines cite when engineers research harsh-environment power, always guiding them toward a fit-check or a conversation with sales.
  • Attribution and measurement. Own marketing automation and CRM integration, closed-loop attribution from first touch to closed-won, and a weekly report on pipeline contribution and influence on win rate and deal velocity, tying every campaign and asset to a named vertical, account, or product motion.

FIRST 6 & 12 MONTHS

  • By day 90: Priority verticals selected with target-account lists built and enriched, a live intent and buying-signal feed, the first account-based campaigns running, and a baseline for AI answer-engine visibility instrumented.
  • By month 6: The demand engine producing weekly quote-ready opportunities for direct and channel, closed-loop attribution working in the CRM, and a running content and AEO program compounding visibility in your verticals.
  • By month 12: A measurable, repeatable pipeline contribution the sales and channel teams rely on, Falcon consistently surfaced in AI answers for harsh-environment power, and a documented demand system that scales to new verticals.

WHAT YOU BRING — MUST-HAVE

  • 5+ years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing with clear ownership of pipeline contribution and revenue impact, ideally in industrial, technical, manufacturing, or another considered-purchase market.
  • Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI to design workflows and multiply output across research, enrichment, content, and campaigns, with examples of what you built and the pipeline it produced.
  • Signal-based ABM and intent-data experience: turning in-market signals into coordinated, account-based programs that sales acts on.
  • Fluency in AI discovery and answer-engine optimization (AEO/GEO) and how to earn citations and visibility where buyers now research.
  • Strong CRM and marketing-automation command, with closed-loop attribution from first touch to revenue.
  • Pipeline and funnel discipline: you think in qualified pipeline and revenue influence, not MQL volume, and you operate lean by orchestrating AI rather than managing a large team.

PREFERRED

  • Familiarity with the modern AI demand stack, for example predictive intent, enrichment, and attribution platforms
  • A growth and experimentation mindset applied to a long-cycle, technical, spec-in motion.
  • Experience marketing to engineers, integrators, or other specifying and technical audiences.
  • Exposure to water/wastewater, traffic/ITS, or industrial automation verticals.

HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

Your primary measure is the qualified design-win pipeline you generate and the revenue the sales and channel teams close with it. Answer-engine visibility, account coverage, and pipeline velocity are the leading indicators on the way there, not MQL volume for its own sake. You will own a small, clear scorecard and a weekly operating rhythm.

Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Why this role matters

Every client relationship starts with a launch. The weeks after an agent signs with us set the tone for the entire relationship, and getting them to value quickly is one of the highest-leverage things we do. That experience used to mean getting a website live. Today it spans a growing set of products, and the definition of a successful activation keeps expanding with it.

We're looking for a Director of Launch Operations to own how that entire experience runs. Getting from $100M to $300M means activating far more clients, across more products, without adding proportional cost or giving up the quality that earns renewals. The path there is not a better version of what exists today. It is a fundamentally different operating model, and this role owns designing it.

What makes this role unique is that it sits at the intersection of operations and product. You won't just define how the work should happen and hand requirements to someone else. You'll own Launchpad, our purpose-built platform for managing onboarding, launch, and activation. You'll set the vision for what that platform becomes, decide what gets built, and ship it.

AI is central to how we do this, and not as an aspiration. We are actively building AI into the systems our teams use every day. If you get energy from looking at how work gets done and deciding which parts software and agents should handle instead of people, and you want to build that yourself rather than wait for a roadmap to deliver it, this is a rare place to do it at scale.

What you'll own

The client activation experience

  • Own the operating model behind onboarding, launch, and activation across our full product set
  • Set a materially higher bar for speed, consistency, and quality of client activation, and drive the organization to hit it
  • Design how the work should run at 3x the current volume, then get there

Launchpad

  • Own Launchpad as a product: vision, roadmap, prioritization, and what ships
  • Direct dedicated engineering and Salesforce development resources against that roadmap
  • Make Launchpad the system of record for activation, with clean data flowing through to Salesforce
  • Own the broader tooling the Onboarding and PFT teams rely on, in concert with other GTM Ops squads

AI-native operations

  • Identify the work in the activation process that should not require a human, and replace it

  • Hold a high bar for what good looks like when the alternative is an agent doing it instead

Performance and decision-making

  • Own how activation performance is measured, defined, and understood across the business
  • Establish what the right metrics are as the product set expands and old definitions stop fitting
  • Bring leadership a clear, reconciled view of where the operation stands and what to do about it

Team and execution

  • Lead a small team of senior operators and get real leverage from them
  • Run a fast operating cadence with a visible, prioritized backlog
  • Design processes that hold up as volume grows and staff turns over

How you'll work

You'll report to the VP of GTM Strategy and Operations and work in close alignment with the Head of Onboarding and PFT, whose teams your work directly serves. You'll sit alongside the leaders running CS Operations, Sales and Marketing Operations, RevTech, Analytics, and Enablement. This is a highly visible role. You'll shape the roadmap with engineers one day and make the case for it to the executive team the next, and you'll be the person who translates between those two conversations. Success depends on setting a bar across partner teams and building enough credibility that people move at the pace you set.

What we're looking for

Experience

  • 5+ years in operations roles at a SaaS or technology company, including experience leading a team
  • Direct experience running the operational layer behind an implementation, onboarding, professional services, or delivery organization
  • Demonstrable results consistently raising the bar on performance through operational improvement, not incremental tuning
  • A track record of building support for change across senior stakeholders who see the problem differently
  • Experience at high-growth companies, ideally between $100M and $500M in ARR

Leadership and communication

  • You think like a product manager about your own operations. You have a vision for where the function should be in two years, you prioritize ruthlessly against it, and you ship
  • You communicate with unusual clarity. You can take a complex operational or technical problem and make it obvious to an executive audience, in writing and in the room
  • You bridge technical and business conversations naturally, and neither side feels you're translating for the other
  • You drive. You create urgency, hold the line on pace, and make slippage visible rather than letting it sit
  • You're personally high output. You get into the detail and do real work, not just coordinate it
  • You pair drive with credibility. You influence partner teams rather than steamroll them
  • Deeply execution-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership
  • Comfortable operating in complexity and ambiguity

Technical foundation

  • Hands-on with AI in your daily work, with real examples of workflows you've built or rebuilt around it
  • Strong command of Salesforce and the systems that support a delivery organization
  • Comfortable working directly with engineers on what gets built and why
  • You can get to your own answers in the data, and you're skeptical of numbers you haven't reconciled
  • Fluent in process design, workflow optimization, and capacity thinking

This role is remote within the United States, with a preference for candidates based in Austin, Texas. Some travel is expected.

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

jobs.description:
The Senior Lead Tax Analyst - Americas is the enterprise owner of payroll tax governance, compliance strategy, risk management, and operational excellence across the United States, Canada, Mexico, Argentina, and Brazil. This highly specialized role leads the full payroll tax lifecycle, including tax configuration and calculations, agency registrations, deposits and filings, reconciliations, tax notices, amendments, quarter-end and year-end, equity compensation, controls, audits, and issue resolution. The position establishes standards, drives consistent controls, and leads cross-functional decisions with Payroll, Accounting, Stock Administration, HR, Global Mobility, Legal, Treasury, vendors, tax authorities, and external tax specialists. The role is expected to shape a scalable payroll tax operating model and provide functional leadership as the organization grows.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end U.S. federal, state, and local payroll tax compliance, including employee and employer withholding, taxable wage reporting, deposits, returns, reconciliations, corrections, and related accounting support.

  • Serve as the payroll tax functional lead for Workday Payroll, including tax configuration, earnings and deduction taxability, jurisdiction setup, calculation validation, testing, reporting, and production issue resolution.

  • Oversee ADP Smart Compliance Employment Tax activities, including data transmission, tax funding, deposits, filings, tax profiles, quarter-end exceptions, Statements of Deposit, amendments, tax notices, and service cases.

  • Lead quarter-end and year-end payroll tax activities, including balancing and review of Forms 941, 940, W-2, W-3, W-2c, W-3c, state and local returns, and amended filings.

  • Reconcile taxable wages and payroll tax liabilities across Workday Payroll, ADP Smart Compliance, payroll registers, general ledger accounts, cash funding, and filed returns; research and resolve variances.

  • Manage federal, state, and local tax notices and agency inquiries from receipt through resolution, including research, response preparation, vendor coordination, penalty abatement, refunds, and documentation.

  • Manage payroll tax registrations, tax identification numbers, powers of attorney, deposit frequencies, tax rates, account maintenance, and account closures for new and existing jurisdictions.

  • Own payroll taxation and reporting for RSUs, PSUs, ESPP, stock options, sell-to-cover transactions, tax shortfalls, excess withholding refunds, and related corrections in partnership with Stock Administration.

  • Provide expert guidance on multi-state and local taxation, remote and mobile employees, supplemental wages, FICA, FUTA, SUI, paid leave and disability programs, reciprocity, resident and work jurisdictions, and other complex tax scenarios.

  • Monitor legislative and regulatory changes; assess impact and coordinate updates to payroll configuration, vendor setup, controls, procedures, testing, reporting, and employee communications.

  • Maintain SOX-ready payroll tax controls, process documentation, calendars, issue trackers, reconciliations, audit support, and evidence of review; identify opportunities to automate and strengthen processes.

  • Lead complex payroll tax issue resolution with internal partners, tax authorities, ADP, Workday support teams, auditors, and external ; escalate vendor service or compliance risks when needed.

  • Support payroll tax audits, merger and acquisition activity, legal entity changes, successor employer requirements, and other special projects.

  • Develop and maintain the payroll tax governance framework for the Americas, including policies, standards, controls, compliance calendars, review protocols, documentation requirements, and issue escalation paths.

  • Serve as the company's highest-level payroll tax authority for the covered countries, establishing positions on complex matters and leading cross-functional decisions that affect payroll compliance, accounting, system design, and employee reporting.

  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and mitigate payroll tax risk across covered jurisdictions; provide leadership reporting on material exposures, audit findings, remediation plans, and recurring compliance trends.

  • Lead complex payroll tax investigations, corrections, voluntary disclosures, agency examinations, penalty-abatement efforts, and remediation programs through closure.

  • Lead payroll tax workstreams for enterprise initiatives, including Workday Payroll implementation and optimization, acquisitions, divestitures, legal entity changes, reorganizations, and payroll transformation programs.

  • Establish payroll tax design principles and control requirements that can scale to future countries, payroll solutions, and operating models.

  • Provide technical direction, coaching, and functional leadership to regional payroll teams and future payroll tax resources; contribute to talent planning and organizational design for the payroll tax function.

  • Own payroll tax governance and compliance oversight for Canada, Mexico, Argentina, and Brazil, coordinating with local payroll providers and internal stakeholders while maintaining primary ownership of U.S. payroll tax.

  • Provide backup support for U.S. payroll processing and related payroll compliance activities when necessary.

REQUIRED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Taxation, Human Resources, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • At least 10 years of progressive payroll tax experience, including deep, hands-on responsibility for U.S. federal, state, and local payroll taxes in a complex, multi-state environment and experience supporting payroll tax matters across multiple countries.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently own the full payroll tax lifecycle, including configuration, calculations, funding, filings, reconciliations, notices, amendments, quarter-end, year-end, and controls.

  • Hands-on Workday Payroll experience, including U.S. payroll tax configuration, calculation review, testing, reconciliation, reporting, and issue resolution.

  • Experience with ADP Smart Compliance Employment Tax or a comparable enterprise payroll tax filing platform.

  • Strong technical knowledge of federal, multi-state, and local payroll taxation, including FICA, FUTA, SUI, supplemental wages, paid leave and disability programs, reciprocity, and amended returns.

  • Experience with payroll taxation and reporting for RSUs, ESPP, and other equity compensation.

  • Experience managing tax notices, registrations, agency inquiries, vendor escalations, tax reconciliations, and payroll tax controls.

  • Ability to research complex payroll tax matters, interpret requirements, assess enterprise risk, document conclusions, influence decisions, and drive issues through resolution with limited direction.

  • Strong analytical, executive communication, program leadership, documentation, and cross-functional influence skills.

  • Demonstrated experience designing payroll tax governance frameworks, compliance programs, controls, and audit-readiness strategies.

  • Experience leading payroll tax workstreams for enterprise payroll, finance, HR, equity, or system transformation initiatives.

  • Proven ability to influence senior leadership and drive decisions across multiple functions without direct authority.

  • Experience translating regulatory requirements and risk assessments into scalable processes, system requirements, controls, and remediation plans.

PREFERRED:

  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) designation.

  • Workday Payroll certification or extensive Workday Payroll implementation and production-support experience.

  • Direct experience with the Workday Payroll and ADP Smart Compliance integration.

  • Experience in a large, publicly traded organization with significant multi-state payroll and equity compensation activity.

  • Experience with SOX controls, internal and external audits, acquisitions, divestitures, legal entity changes, or successor employer payroll tax requirements.

  • Direct experience supporting payroll tax requirements in one or more of the following countries: Canada, Mexico, Argentina, or Brazil.

  • Experience building or maturing a payroll tax function, center of excellence, or governance program.

  • Experience providing functional leadership to payroll tax specialists, regional payroll teams, or external service providers.

Job Title

Job Summary

The Redeterminations Examiner is responsible for examining incoming Medicare Redetermination appeals through a review of documentation to make appeal determinations. This position determines if adjustments within standard systems are in accordance with established guidelines and policies and responds to Medicare appellants ensuring quality administration of Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) regulations and continuous, proactive customer satisfaction.

Essential Functions

Key Duties/Responsibilities/Accountabilities

  • Conducts redetermination reviews per Medicare rules and regulations
  • Responds to incoming appeals from Medicare appellants in a professional, timely, and accurate manner. Including letter writing, proofreading with attention to detail following current guidelines.
  • Researches and identifies claims processing deficiencies and initiates corrective response
  • Evaluates all documentation and history needed to determine if it meets outlined policy criteria to ensure accurate and compliant processing in accordance with CMS guidelines.
  • Submits educational referrals as necessary to decrease redeterminations and allow claims to pay at the lowest level of appeal
  • Assists in writing and updating processing guidelines
  • Identifies internal/external education and/or training needs, communicates findings, and assists in training if necessary
  • Communicates information to appropriate internal and external parties in a timely manner
  • Problem solves and researches effectively
  • Process overpayment appeals as needed
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of working systems, processing instructions, and other relevant resourrces to ensure efficient and accurate appeal processing.
  • Maintains knowledge of CMS and Joint Operating Agreement (JOA) requirements

    • Support supplier quality management processes and monitor contractor quality performance.

    • Promote quality best practices across multiple projects and stakeholders throughout Europe.
    • Travel regularly to construction sites, manufacturing facilities, and customer locations within the UK and Europe.

Qualifications

    • Experience developing and implementing Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).
    • Proven experience conducting inspections, audits, and quality surveillance activities.
    • Knowledge of Non-Conformance Reporting (NCR), Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) processes.
    • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
    • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

• Full UK or EU driving license.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

    • Working knowledge of ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 standards is advantageous.
    • ISO 9001 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor certification preferred.
    • Membership of the Chartered Quality Institute (CQI), or progress toward membership, is desirable.
    • Additional European language proficiency is considered an asset

Required Education and Training

  • Degree, Higher National Diploma (HND), or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Construction, Quality Management, or a related discipline; or equivalent relevant professional experience.

    • Ongoing professional development in quality management, quality assurance, or related disciplines is desirable.
    • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 50% throughout the UK and Europe, including occasional travel outside normal working hours.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

Position Summary

The Epic Products Analyst, Senior applies advanced knowledge of healthcare operations and information technology principles to provide multifaceted direct Epic application support across the Epic software development life cycle for the design, development, implementation, testing, updating, integration, and maintenance of complex system configuration, system setup, and application tables by analyzing user, system, and application needs, and evaluating multiple alternative approaches to determine the best solution to meet the needs of the organization

Roles focuse will be Cadence/ Patient Access

Responsibilities

Essential Functions

  • Conducts and attends meetings to review end-user performance, tracking and trending of issues, workflow problems, system capabilities, monitoring feedback, and potential system enhancement needs
  • Performs workflow analysis, collects data, produces reports, and investigates issues in support of technical and business decision-making efforts associated with the Epic software
  • Assists with and coordinates the effort in change processes, content governance, and prioritization; implements approved new development, system enhancements, and releases
  • Troubleshoots problems and responds to questions received from the Service Desk and end users in a timely manner
  • Monitors system performance; troubleshoots and resolves application issues and system errors
  • Leads the effort in the evaluation and implementation of new module releases
  • Identifies, analyzes, and recommends improvements and enhancements to operational processes and system automation
  • Provides status reports and updates trackers for IT/CE and facility development projects, service line expansions, break/fixes, planned upgrades, and other aspects of the IT/CE program portfolio
  • Provides consulting support to Business Relationship Management teams to analyze business operations, investigate end-user preferences, and incorporate informatics best practices when making build decisions
  • Creates security classification templates to provide the appropriate level of access, while ensuring the protection of patient health information
  • Designs, modifies, and implements testing processes including script development, recording test results, facilitating end-user testing, testing hardware, and maintaining test environments
  • Coordinates and participates in application upgrades and changes
  • Monitors and collaborates with stakeholders during the integration of interfaced applications to ensure that the build and maintenance of the system and patient data integrity are not negatively impacted
  • Analyzes, designs, configures, tests, and evaluates new or changed clinical/business application functionality and workflows to meet enterprise requirements; manages master file changes for new features
  • Collaborates with Cogito analysts and others as needed for Epic native reports and dashboards
  • Provides information and support to Instructional Designers to facilitate training development
  • Ensures interoperability between Epic applications and other supporting applications
  • Communicates with vendors regarding technical issues with Epic integration
  • Utilizes understanding of IT trends and the practical application of existing, new, and emerging technologies to enable new and evolving business and operating models related to the Epic software
  • Participates in the evaluation and selection of software product standards and services, as well as the design of standard and custom software configurations
  • Analyzes the business-IT environment (run, grow, and transform the business) to detect critical deficiencies and recommend solutions for improvement, differentiation, and innovation
  • Maintains reasonably regular, punctual attendance consistent with Baptist Health policies, the ADA, FMLA, and other federal, state, and local standards
  • Maintains compliance with all Baptist Health policies and procedures

Other Related Functions

  • Solves unique problems within the Epic application that have a broad impact on the associated business functions and require conceptual and innovative thinking to develop solutions
  • Provides remote end-user support, including participation in on-call service rotations
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Education/ Training

  • in a life science, healthcare administration, computer science, information systems, informatics, or a related study
  • and two (2) years of directly related work experience may substitute for the Bachelor’s degree
  • or equivalent and four (4) years of directly related work experience may also substitute for the Bachelor’s degree

Licensure/ Certification

  • Epic certification in the primary build application is required within six (6) months of appointment and must be maintained

Experience

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience in an information technology field
  • Experience with Epic or other electronic health record software products

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions independently manages all employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance, excellent quality and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Senior Specialist is also expected to drive process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

Key Responsibilities

Offboarding

  • Manage and resolve complex end-to-end employee exits with minimal supervision across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and employees.
  • Provide sound and trusted guidance with an elevated level of knowledge on key jurisdictions, and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Independently lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.
  • Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, successfully navigating and directing multiple stakeholders with competing interests through a complicated, involved and sometimes lengthy process.
  • Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.
  • Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.
  • Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, among other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.
  • Act as the first point of informal escalation as a trusted colleague with good judgment, by way of providing expertise, mentoring and guidance to more junior team members.
  • Provide comprehensive guidance on Remote's Employee Relations resources, helping clients navigate complex workplace scenarios.
  • Conduct thorough preliminary assessments of workplace concerns, identifying key facts, applicable local regulations, and potential paths forward.
  • Serve as a trusted resource for internal and external stakeholders on employee relations matters, ensuring appropriate handling of complex cases.
  • Guide clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches, documentation requirements, and best practices for handling difficult situations.
  • Track and monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and appropriate coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Be the subject-matter expert and proactively resolve internal and external queries on all offboarding and first-level employee relations matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.
  • Actively identify opportunities, advocate for and drive process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.
  • Determine methods, procedures and standards on new assignments. Exercise judgment in selecting methods, evaluating, adapting complex techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results taking into account wider Lifecycle and Remote needs.

Key Requirements and Charactristics

  • Experience as an HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.
  • Tertiary qualifications in HR/labour relations/employment law considered a plus.
  • Proven experience with a strong background in independently managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR advice and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.
  • Understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues and apply problem-solving skills to independently (occasionally with minimal supervision) arrive at solutions, undertake research and translate this into usable team resources, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.
  • Superior communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to independently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, while conveying authority and expertise as the representative of Remote, and maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.
  • Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.
  • Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying, developing and implementing opportunities for automation and champion best practice.
  • Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment while successfully balancing multiple competing priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, and ability to inspire others.
  • Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.
