Riverbed. Empower the Experience

Riverbed, the leader in AIOps for observability, helps organizations optimize their users’ experiences by leveraging AI automation for the prevention, identification, and resolution of IT issues. With over 20 years of experience in data collection and AI and machine learning, Riverbed’s open and AI-powered observability platform and solutions optimize digital experiences and greatly improve IT efficiency. Riverbed also offers industry-leading Acceleration solutions that provide fast, agile, secure acceleration of any app, over any network, to users anywhere. Together with our thousands of market-leading customers globally – including 95% of the FORTUNE 100 – we are empowering next-generation digital experiences. Learn more at riverbed.com

Position

Title: Vice President, Product Marketing

Location: US - Texas, Florida, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Georgia, North Carolina, Michigan, Virginia, Arizona, or Tennessee

Travel Requirements: 15%

Riverbed is seeking a strategic and visionary Vice President of Product Marketing to lead its global product marketing organization.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, this executive will define and execute Riverbed's product marketing vision, strengthen the company's leadership position in Unified Observability, and drive market awareness, growth, and competitive differentiation. The VP will oversee market strategy, portfolio positioning, analyst relations, go-to-market execution, customer advocacy, and sales enablement while leading a high-performing global team and partnering closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, Corporate Marketing, and Executive Leadership.

What you will do

  • Define and execute the global product marketing strategy for the Rivebed Platform.
  • Lead portfolio positioning, messaging, and market differentiation to reinforce Riverbed's leadership in observability and digital experience management.
  • Develop and execute global go-to-market strategies for new product launches, portfolio expansions, and strategic growth initiatives.
  • Serve as a visible industry spokesperson and thought leader with customers, analysts, partners, media outlets, and industry events.
  • Drive analyst relations initiatives and strengthen Riverbed's positioning with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and other key influencers.
  • Build, develop, and lead a high-performing product marketing organization while establishing KPIs aligned with growth and revenue objectives.
  • Partner closely with Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, Customer Success, Corporate Communications, and Executive Leadership to improve market impact, customer engagement, and sales effectiveness.

What makes you an ideal candidate

  • 15+ years of product marketing or related leadership experience within enterprise software, SaaS, observability, networking, cybersecurity, cloud, or adjacent technology sectors.
  • Proven success leading product marketing organizations at the Senior Director, Vice President, or equivalent executive level.
  • Deep expertise in positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, product launches, analyst relations, sales enablement, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Strong understanding of observability, AIOps, Digital Experience Management, Network Performance Management, or related enterprise technology markets.
  • Demonstrated success building category leadership, creating market differentiation, and driving measurable business growth.
  • Exceptional executive presence, communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage customers, analysts, partners, media, and senior executives.
  • Experience building, scaling, and managing high-performing teams, including second-line leadership responsibilities.

What we offer

Our employee benefits including flexible workplace policies, employee resource groups, learning and development resources, career progression pathways, and community engagement initiatives are some of the reasons why we have had great success in bringing in new talent. In addition, our global employee wellness programs are crafted to support the physical, emotional, and financial well-being of our employees.

Benefits & Perks vary by Country.

About Riverbed

With a 20-year history of innovation, Riverbed is agile and proven—and we continue to disrupt the market with differentiated solutions that help customers deliver secure, seamless digital experiences and accelerate enterprise performance. We are relentlessly customer-first: we listen, learn, and act with urgency to solve real problems and earn trust every day. We pair bold ideas with operational efficiency, simplifying how we work, focusing on what matters most, and delivering with quality and speed. Fueled by a will to win, we set ambitious goals, hold ourselves accountable, and raise the bar through measurable outcomes. At the center of it all are our people—bringing our best selves to work with a shared commitment to excellence, transparency, and open communication. We strive to be an inclusive, fair, and enjoyable workplace where respect and wellbeing are prioritized. We are committed to our people, partners, and customers while supporting the communities where we work and live. It’s the Power ofWE that binds us together and drives high-impact success.

Riverbed is an equal employment opportunity/Affirmative Action (EEO/AA) employer and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or child birth (including breast feeding), sexual orientation, genetics, genetic information, marital status, veteran status or any other basis protected by and in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws.

jobs.excerpt: Are you ready to join Stone Harbor Staffing.  Inc.
jobs.description:
Are you ready to join Stone Harbor Staffing. Inc. and unlock a world of extraordinary opportunities? We're not just a company, we're a dynamic force of innovation and collaboration. Dive into a workplace where your creativity is cherished, your growth is prioritized, and your impact on healthcare and life sciences is monumental. If you're ready for a thrilling journey where passion meets innovation, Stone Harbor is waiting for you. Let's make every day an adventure together!


About the Position:

The Director of Recruitment is responsible for developing and executing the strategic vision for the recruitment function across the organization, providing high-level performance management, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration. 

About Us:

We are a mission-driven organization dedicated to supporting K–12 Special Education programs across the country through high-touch recruitment and retention solutions. Our exclusive focus on school-based services allows us to bring deep subject matter expertise to the students, educators, and communities we serve. As a member of our corporate team, you’ll help enable the clinicians and educators who make meaningful, lasting differences in the lives of children with diverse learning needs. We are passionate about building a supportive, inclusive work environment where purpose and people come first, because when we empower our teams to thrive, students thrive. Here, your work directly contributes to a brighter future for every learner.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and implement strategic recruitment plans to support organizational growth and goals. 

  • Head and mentor recruitment managers, guiding them in team leadership, performance management, and development. 

  • Analyze and interpret recruitment metrics and data to optimize strategies, drive efficiency, and ensure high performance. 

  • Oversee recruitment processes, identifying areas for improvement and implementing best practices to enhance the overall recruitment function. 

  • Collaborate with senior leadership and other departments to align recruitment strategies with business objectives and ensure client satisfaction. 

  • Prepare and present reports on recruitment performance, market trends, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership. 

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning within the recruitment teams. 

  • Ensure compliance with all relevant guidelines, standards, and regulations. 

  • Stay informed on industry trends, market conditions, and emerging best practices to maintain competitive advantage. 

  • Build and execute recruiting strategies that support expansion beyond special education school staffing, including Autism and Behavioral Health clinics, Therapeutic Day Schools, and other adjacent education and pediatric service models.

  • Develop recruiting strategies for new service lines, including talent mapping, sourcing strategies, recruiter education, candidate messaging, workflows, KPIs, and launch plans.

  • Create and facilitate ongoing training in areas such as sourcing, candidate engagement, pipeline development, skill marketing, job prioritization, candidate presentation, conversion, recruiter productivity, and book-of-business growth.

  • Own and continuously improve Recruitment SOPs, strategies, training materials, workflows, and documentation to ensure recruiters have clear and current guidance.

  • Develop strategies that help recruiters grow and manage their individual books of business through candidate pipelines, relationships, redeployment, referrals, and proactive talent development.

  • Maintain a strong commitment to the company's core K–12 Special Education business while identifying adjacent growth opportunities that complement the organization's expertise and mission.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Eight years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition, including significant experience in a leadership role. 

  • Proven track record in developing and executing recruitment strategies and managing large teams. 

  • Possess an overall knowledge of business functions and understanding of services, business strategy, policies and procedures, and job’s impact to the organization. 

  • Draw meaning and conclusions from quantitative and/or qualitative data. 

  • Analytically and logically evaluate information, propositions, and claims. 

  • Grasp the external political, economic, competitive, and social factors affecting the industry. 

  • Imagine and devise new and better ways of doing things. 

  • Create a motivating climate, achieve teamwork, train, and develop, measure work in progress, take corrective action. 

  • Engage effectively in dialogue. 

  • Demonstrated success leading and developing recruiting teams in staffing, healthcare, education, behavioral health, or another high-volume talent environment.

  • Experience launching or growing a new recruiting vertical, service line, market, client program, or talent strategy.

  • Experience recruiting within Autism/ABA, Behavioral Health, pediatric therapy, Therapeutic Day Schools, Special Education, or closely related clinical or education markets is strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to build training programs, facilitate learning, coach recruiters and leaders, and translate recruiting expertise into practical education.

  • Experience developing and maintaining recruiting SOPs, workflows, and performance standards.

  • Proven ability to balance performance accountability with engagement, recognition, development, and retention of recruiting talent.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with demonstrated success identifying and building new sources of revenue, talent, or market expansion.

  • Ability to operate strategically while remaining close enough to day-to-day recruiting operations to understand what recruiters are experiencing and where processes need to change.

Salary:$150,000 - $165,000 annually

The starting salary offer will vary based on the applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, internal equity, and alignment with market data. This position may also be eligible to participate in a company incentive plan and/or commission plan.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewUS Anesthesia Partners is the highest-quality single-specialty anesthesia practice in the United States, with over 6,000 employees distributed across 10 states.
jobs.description:
Overview

US Anesthesia Partners is the highest-quality single-specialty anesthesia practice in the United States, with over 6,000 employees distributed across 10 states. Our clinical and non-clinical staff support each other as they work toward a common vision: Forging a better future by empowering people to advance exceptional care.

POSITION SUMMARY: The Information Security Architect is a functional, hands-on architect whose responsibility is to lead the governance and maturation of secure design, implementation and management for Enterprise applications and systems across all IT domains. This role partners closely with developers, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, networking, solution architects and security teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC) while enabling rapid delivery of cloud-based solutions.

The ideal candidate has deep expertise in cloud security architecture, application security, DevSecOps, threat modeling, and modern cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure. This role also requires extensive knowledge and understanding of platform architecture, software development, well architected frameworks, and the ability to solve complex technical challenges. The Information Security Architect will serve as a trusted advisor to development teams, helping design resilient, scalable, and secure applications that meet business and regulatory requirements.

Job Highlights

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation) Pineapple

  • Establishes and enforces secure software development standards and cloud security best practices.
  • Leads the security lifecycle by reviewing emerging technologies, threats, and trends as well as maturing end of life governance for applications and technologies.
  • Participates in and matures the Architectural Review Board by applying a security focused mindset to all IT domains being reviewed.
  • Reviews application architecture documentation including diagrams and runbooks with a security focused lens.
  • Partners with engineering and DevOps teams to create security governance and best practice into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Conducts architecture risk assessments, threat modeling, and secure design reviews for new and existing applications.
  • Develops security reference architectures, design patterns, and technical standards for cloud-native applications.
  • Leads application security initiatives including SAST, DAST, software composition analysis (SCA), Infrastructure as Code (IaC) scanning, container security, and API security.
  • Works directly with the enterprise architect to ensure that overall enterprise security architecture, governance, and guidance is being executed on all IT domain levels.
  • Evaluates cloud services and third-party technologies for security risks and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborates with security operations, infrastructure, compliance, and engineering teams to investigate and resolve security findings.
  • Acts as a trusted advisor to development, infrastructure, network, cloud, data, and security teams.
  • Ensures cloud applications comply with organizational policies and applicable regulatory frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, and GDPR.
  • Provides technical leadership and mentorship to development teams on secure coding practices and cloud security.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES (KSAs):

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, business, or a related field required (or equivalent work experience).
  • 7+ years of experience securing enterprise environments across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud infrastructures.
  • Strong understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) and DevSecOps practices.
  • Strong knowledge of secure coding principles and common application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, API Security Top 10).
  • Solid knowledge and experience working with Azure Dev Ops technology with focus on CI/CD pipelines and GIT repositories.
  • Strong knowledge of identity and access management, authentication, authorization, OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, risk management, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Strong familiarity with SIEM, EDR/XDR, IAM, PAM, CASB, DLP, and vulnerability management platforms.
  • Experience in healthcare is preferred.
  • CISSP certification is preferred.
  • Ability to understand and translate business needs, aligning them to proper technical application solutions.
  • Ability to translate security policy, regulatory requirements, and risk findings into practical architecture guidance.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work with multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to work on multiple business critical projects simultaneously.
  • Understanding of core security and compliance principles in a healthcare environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to solve complex technical problems.

WE ARE HIRING: Senior Accountant

Role Overview

We are seeking a technically strong and quality-focused Senior Accountant to support complex Australian tax, compliance, financial statements, review work, and junior team development.

The selected candidate will act as a senior technical resource within the accounting function, preparing complex work, reviewing the work of junior accountants, reducing rework, improving quality standards, and supporting the Head of Accounting with accurate, timely, and compliant accounting output.

Key Responsibilities

Complex Compliance and Advisory Support

  • Prepare complex company, trust, and group tax returns.
  • Prepare financial statements for Australian business clients.
  • Handle technical tax matters including Division 7A, CGT, trust distributions, and tax planning calculations.
  • Prepare technical workpapers that can withstand ATO review and scrutiny.
  • Support advisers with tax modelling, technical calculations, and accounting queries.
  • Assist with structuring support and complex client accounting requirements.
  • Ensure all work is completed accurately, efficiently, and in line with Australian tax and compliance requirements.

Review and Quality Control

  • Review work prepared by Associate and Intermediate Accountants.
  • Identify errors, inconsistencies, and compliance risks before work reaches clients.
  • Provide clear, specific, and constructive review points that help junior team members improve.
  • Take ownership of first-time-right quality for reviewed jobs.
  • Reduce rework through proper review, coaching, and process discipline.
  • Escalate genuine technical uncertainties to the Head of Accounting with clear recommendations.
  • Maintain high standards of accuracy, documentation, and technical judgement.

Mentoring and Capability Building

  • Mentor junior accountants and support their technical development.
  • Convert recurring review points into training opportunities.
  • Share knowledge on Australian tax, compliance, workpapers, and review standards.
  • Help build a stronger accounting team through coaching, guidance, and practical feedback.
  • Support process improvements to reduce repeated errors and improve team efficiency.
  • Ensure own jobs and reviewed jobs continue moving through the workflow without unnecessary delays.

Workflow, Reporting and Process Improvement

  • Manage assigned jobs according to deadlines and workflow requirements.
  • Keep review queues moving and ensure turnaround timelines are maintained.
  • Identify recurring process issues and recommend practical improvements.
  • Support consistent use of accounting systems, tax software, and workflow tools.
  • Maintain proper documentation, review notes, technical records, and workpaper files.
  • Contribute to improved productivity, quality control, and team performance.

Candidate Profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Australian public practice accounting.
  • Strong experience preparing complex company, trust, and group tax returns.
  • Strong technical knowledge of Division 7A, CGT, trust distributions, company tax, and tax planning.
  • Experience preparing Australian financial statements and tax compliance work.
  • Proven experience reviewing the work of junior or intermediate accountants.
  • Ability to provide feedback that teaches and improves team capability.
  • Strong judgement with the ability to know when to decide independently and when to escalate.
  • Ability to escalate technical issues with analysis and recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to work during Australian business hours.
  • Strong experience using Xero, Australian tax software, and practice workflow tools.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong ownership, reliability, and ability to work under workload pressure.
  • Ability to maintain quality standards during busy periods.
  • Strong process improvement mindset.
  • Ability to mentor junior team members and support a high-performance accounting culture.
  • Professional, accountable, technically confident, and committed to delivering high-quality work.

Key Technical Areas

  • Australian tax compliance
  • Company, trust, and group tax returns
  • Financial statements
  • Division 7A
  • Capital Gains Tax
  • Trust distributions
  • Tax planning calculations
  • Technical workpapers
  • Review and quality control
  • Australian public practice accounting

Success Measures

  • Reviewed jobs released to clients with a high level of accuracy.
  • Complex own jobs completed with minimal review points.
  • Reduction in team rework through effective review and coaching.
  • Review turnaround maintained within agreed timelines.
  • Junior accountants actively mentored and developed.
  • Consistent contribution to stronger accounting standards and workflow efficiency.

Job title: Field Reimbursement Manager - Dermatology, Roanoke, VA

  • Location: Remote, US

About the Job:

In this field-based position, you'll serve as a critical front-line subject matter expert within the Dupixent Business Unit, helping patients access the life-changing therapies they need. As a Field Reimbursement Manager (FRM) reporting to the FRM Director, you'll be the go-to resource for customers on patient support, reimbursement, prior authorization, appeals, and financial assistance — working across a dynamic network of internal stakeholders including Sales Teams, Market Access, Account Directors, Trade, and the Dupixent MyWay Patient Support Program. You'll play a pivotal role in building reimbursement confidence and understanding with customers, driving patient pull-through efforts, and delivering an exceptional customer experience. From educating office personnel on payer landscapes and authorization processes to developing geographic business plans and fostering relationships with state societies and advocacy groups, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in patients' lives every day. If you're a driven, collaborative professional with a passion for solving complex access challenges and championing patient care, this is your chance to be at the heart of one of the most impactful roles in the field.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

The Field Reimbursement Manager (FRM) will be the field subject matter expert relating to patient support, access, reimbursement, prior authorization, appeal, financial assistance, and other business related issues within the Dupixent Business Unit. The FRM is a critical front-line member of the Sanofi Genzyme Patient Support Services organization and will work across multiple internal stakeholders, Sales Teams, Market Access, Account Directors, Trade, Dupixent MyWay (Patient Support Program) and program vendors to deliver an exceptional customer experience. They will be called upon to successfully help develop and execute the national strategy set forth by building reimbursement confidence and understanding with customers and assisting in patient pull though efforts.

FRM responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  • FRMs will be subject matter experts on Dupixent MyWay support programs, access issue resolution, financial assistance and alternative funding options provided by our Patient Support Program

  • Act as a point of contact for Patient Support Services (Dupixent MyWay), and communicate and collaborate cross-functionally in order to lead Dupixent pull through efforts assisting the ABM as appropriate

  • Support field in education of office personnel on prior authorization and appeals processes, reimbursement support through Dupixent MyWay, free drug programs and financial assistance programs

  • Plan and implement geographic business plans to support appropriate access to Dupixent

  • Establish and maintain knowledge on the local and national payer landscape, including Specialty Pharmacy and Utilization Management criteria for Dupixent

  • Establish positive and productive working relationships with all key customer segments (internal and external)

  • Partner with Alliance colleagues to create a culture of respect and customer focus

  • Develop working relationships with state societies, associations and advocacy groups, as needed, to support patient access and raise overall awareness for the Alliance, Dupixent MyWay and Dupixent

  • As needed, conduct HCP office visits to facilitate pull through efforts and problem solve escalated issues as a HIPAA compliant contact

  • Work compliantly to reduce cycle time and increase conversion rate for patients prescribed Dupixent

About You:

Basic Qualifications:

  • BA/BS Degree required, preferably in life science or business, MBA a plus

  • 5+ years' experience in the pharmaceutical/healthcare industry, Dermatology or respiratory and / or Market Access a plus

  • Ability to travel to meetings/trainings/programs as necessary - additional travel will be required within the assigned geography

  • Demonstrated success of cross functional teamwork and working in a matrix and co-promote

Skills:

  • Must be energetic and driven to succeed

  • Interpersonal skills including managing and resolving conflict and building strong working relationships

  • Obtain ability to adapt to change and react constructively in a high-energy and fast paced environment

  • Excellent strategic thinking, analytical, and communication skills required

  • Achieve and maintain compliance with all applicable Sanofi-Genzyme policies and procedures, regulatory and legal requirements, and help to monitor compliance during cross functional team interactions

  • Valid driver's license

Travel Requirements:

  • ~50% travel, depending on geography

  • Ability to travel to meetings/trainings/programs when necessary

Why Choose Us?

  • Make your work count by supporting a company that brings life-changing treatments to millions — and is committed to doing right by patients, communities, and the planet.

  • Drive progress from within by helping simplify, scale, and modernize how a global biopharma business delivers smarter, faster, and more sustainably.

  • Support teams across science, medicine, and operations by building better systems, shaping bold strategies, and enabling innovation at speed.

  • Make an impact across borders and functions, collaborating with leaders to turn complex challenges into real-world solutions.

  • Advance your career through stretch roles, cross-functional moves, and development opportunities designed to match your ambition.

  • Thrive in inclusive, high-performing teams where every role matters and every voice helps shape what’s next.

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

jobs.title: Sales Manager, Natural Channel
jobs.excerpt: About Us:Since 1935, we’ve been on a mission to bring a little extra happiness to everyday life and inspire connections over food.
jobs.description:
About Us:Since 1935, we’ve been on a mission to bring a little extra happiness to everyday life and inspire connections over food. We select the finest ingredients the world has to offer, craft premium products made with love, and never settle for shortcuts. We believe that when we share our food, we share a part of ourselves — and that’s the only way we’d put our name on it.

Today, our small family company has grown into a national leader in specialty olives, peppers, and sauces under the leadership of CEO Jeff Mezzetta, and our commitment to quality has never wavered. With an 80-year legacy behind us and a bright future ahead, we’re seeking passionate, driven candidates to help us bring our cherished family traditions to a new generation.

The ideal candidate will have an immediate connection to our Core Ingredients:

  • Crunchy Crunchy: We are hungry for excellence.
  • Own It: We think and act as an owner – with appetite, initiative, and responsibility.
  • Connection: We build authentic relationships that foster trust and open communications.
  • Vibrance: We come to work eager and passionate about fulfilling our vision. When we share our work, we share a part of who we are.

The primary role of the Sales Manager, Natural Channel is to grow revenue and build category market share for the Jeff’s Garden and Mezzetta brands within the Natural retail channel, nationally. This is a national role with responsibility across the entire U.S., not a single-region territory. Assigned retailers consist of Natural and Specialty accounts—Sprouts, NCG, INFRA, Natural Grocers, The Fresh Market, including the broad base of independent retailers. The role is also responsible for managing the distributors that supply these retailers, including UNFI, KeHE, and select specialty distributors.

The Sales Manager, Natural Channel drives revenue and market share by strategizing and developing sales plans for each account, selling and executing the sales plans directly with the accounts as well as through the assistance of third-party sales agencies (brokers).

Selling the Jeff’s Garden brand and Mezzetta products into assigned Natural channel accounts, the Sales Manager will partner closely with Marketing on executing Jeff’s Garden brand strategies and tactics, and will manage the UNFI and specialty distributor relationships that serve those accounts to optimize distribution and net landed cost.

Growing revenue and building category market share is done by optimizing item Distribution, Shelf presence, off-shelf Merchandising and retail Pricing (DSMP’s). Sales Managers influence DSMP’s via fact-based sales proposals and by investing merchandising funds. Sales Managers are accountable for investing merchandising funds within an approved budget.

Ultimately, successful Mezzetta Sales Managers grow revenue, enhance account profitability and build category market share across their assigned retailers.

This is a remote position that will require flexibility to travel up to 30% of the time, meaning one to two nights a week away from home. Some weekend/evening work required to meet deadlines and potentially to work trade shows. For Sales Managers who reside in Mountain, Central and Eastern time zones, there will be the occasional early evening conference calls due to Mezzetta being based in the Pacific Time Zone.

Responsibilities

  • Revenue: Achievement of assigned revenue goals as measured by internal financial reporting.
  • Category Market Share: Achievement of brand market share goals as measured by syndicated data sources (i.e., Nielsen, SPINS).
  • Distribution: Building retail item distribution across all categories, including new items (Innovation).
  • Account Profitability: Achievement of trade investment rate budgets and account profitability goals.
  • Forecasting Accuracy: Including monthly case volume demand and trade spend (via AR7).
  • National Broker Management: Prioritize and provide direction to brokers for execution excellence against key initiatives.
  • Develop proposals and recommendations that will simultaneously build sales, profits and market share for both the retailer and Mezzetta.
  • Collaborate with the Marketing team in the sharing of market intelligence and account-specific insights that enables Marketing the insights for them to develop strategies for the Natural Channel and Jeff’s Garden.

Requirements

  • 5+ years’ experience in Sales within the CPG industry, including 3+ years of key account management.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Strong proficiency with standard business tools: Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc…
  • Strong proficiency with analytical tools: Nielsen/IRI, analytics tools (PowerBI or similar).
  • Strong sales, influence and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to think both strategically and tactically.

Preferred:

  • 2+ years’ experience managing brokers for excellence in sales execution.
  • 2+ years’ experience calling on retailer accounts in the Natural Channel.
  • Open to candidates anywhere in the U.S.; this is a remote, home-based role with proximity to a major airport preferred to support account and trade-show travel.
Pay Range
$145,000—$160,000 USD

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace:
At Mezzetta, we embrace diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where you know you belong. Part of that commitment includes a zero-tolerance policy and being an Equal Opportunity Employer that prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at Mezzetta are solely based on merit, qualifications, abilities and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, marital status, national origin, disability, military or veteran status, family or parental status, pregnancy, or any other status protected by law. All of us share in the responsibility of fulfilling this commitment and creating a culture where our team can thrive.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks DevSecOps Engineers to support secure application delivery, pipeline automation, and environment configuration in a large federal and DoD-aligned mission environment. These roles maintain and enhance CI/CD pipelines, implement automated deployments, perform security scanning, support CMS and application environment configurations, and ensure adherence to secure DevSecOps practices.

DevSecOps Engineers will work closely with developers, cloud engineers, cybersecurity teams, and system administrators to deliver automated, secure, and reliable releases across development, testing, staging, and production environments.

These positions are fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

The DevSecOps Engineer will:

  • Support CI/CD pipelines, automated deployment workflows, and DevSecOps tooling.
  • Configure secure build pipelines, code quality scanning, and dependency management.
  • Implement security scanning tools, vulnerability checks, and static/dynamic analysis in pipelines.
  • Manage CMS and application environment configuration across DEV, TEST, STAGE, and PROD.
  • Maintain version control workflows, branching patterns, and code repository governance.
  • Collaborate with developers and security engineers on secure coding and release readiness.
  • Support automated infrastructure provisioning and configuration using cloud-native tools.
  • Diagnose build failures, deployment issues, and environment configuration problems.
  • Optimize pipeline performance and standardize DevSecOps processes.
  • Maintain documentation for pipeline steps, deployment patterns, and environment configuration.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, and release discussions.

Qualifications

Clearance Requirement

Must hold an active Secret clearance, supported by a Tier 3 background investigation.

Education (Required)

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Experience (Required)

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in DevSecOps, DevOps, cloud engineering, or software delivery automation.
  • Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and secure build processes.
  • Experience with code repositories, Git workflows, and environment configuration.
  • Experience implementing security scanning and automated quality gates.
  • Experience supporting cloud-hosted applications, preferably in AWS GovCloud or similar environments.

Technical Knowledge (Required)

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD tools (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, etc.).
  • Knowledge of security scanning tools (SAST, DAST, SCA).
  • Familiarity with IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation) and configuration management.
  • Understanding of containerization, orchestration, and deployment automation.
  • Experience with version control, branching strategies, and code governance.

Technical Knowledge (Preferred)

  • Experience with AWS cloud certifications or AWS-specific DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience supporting CMS or enterprise web platform pipelines.
  • Familiarity with monitoring/logging tools integrated into DevSecOps workflows.

Certifications

Required:

  • CompTIA Security+ or CISSP

Preferred:

  • AWS certification (Developer, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer)
  • ITIL v4 Foundation
  • Additional DevOps or cloud engineering certifications

Skills

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities for pipeline, build, and deployment issues.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across engineering, security, and operations teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple environment configurations and releases in a fast-paced mission environment.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

Tines serves a diverse range of customers, from startups to public companies, including Canva, Databricks, Elastic, Kayak, Intercom, and McKesson. At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a remote role that must be based in MST or PST.

About the Role

You'll join as a founding member of Tines’ forward deployed team, embedded directly with our most strategic enterprise customers to drive transformational AI adoption. Your job is to realize maximum potential for Tines’ customers and to ensure every stakeholder from end user to customer leadership understands and fully realizes the value of Tines.

You own the full arc of a customer's success: from deepening adoption and enabling stakeholders through to discovering new opportunities where the platform can create measurable business impact. You’ll show customers the art of what's possible and ensuring the value delivered today is only the beginning. You'll be the person customers trust most to make the Tines’ platform work for them in practice.

We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive in ambiguity and represent us at the highest level inside customer environments. You'll be as comfortable deep in a customer's technical environment as you are leading a training session with a non-technical team or presenting a business case to a CTO.

  • Own end-to-end deployment: Lead the technical implementation of Tines’ platform within complex enterprise environments. Integrating with existing systems, configuring for customer-specific workflows and ensuring a fast, smooth path to deliverable outcomes.
  • Drive adoption across the organisation: Proactively support and train users and stakeholders in the customer at every level from hands-on technical teams to business leaders ensuring the platform is understood actively used and maximized.
  • Identify and develop new use cases: Through deep familiarity with each customer's business, continuously surface new opportunities where Tines’ platform can create additional value expanding adoption across teams, workflows, and business units.
  • Be the primary technical point of contact: Serve as the customer's trusted advisor on all things platform-related. Troubleshooting issues, delivering workshops, answering technical questions and resolving blockers before they become problems.
  • Maintain strong customer relationships: Build lasting partnerships at every level of the organisation, from daily users to executive sponsors with a focus on long-term retention and growth.
  • Feed insights back to the product: Codify what you learn in the field. Surfacing recurring friction points, unmet needs and high-value use cases and sharing these with Tines’ internal teams such as Engineering, Product and GTM.
  • Travel 20–40% to customer sites to build trust, accelerate adoption and deepen relationships in person.

What you Bring with you:

  • 8+ years in a technical, customer-facing role: Solutions / Pre-sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Customer Success Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Integration / Implementation Engineer or Software Engineer with customer exposure
  • Proven track record of driving adoption and delivering measurable value from complex technical products inside enterprise environments
  • Strong engineering skills to own integrations, troubleshoot production issues and understand customer infrastructure
  • Strong Python skills (plus ideally TypeScript, Java, or similar)
  • Production experience with LLMs and AI systems: prompt engineering, agent workflows, and deployment at scale
  • Ability to train, enable and influence stakeholders across all levels
  • High agency and resourcefulness: you find a path forward independently, escalate only when necessary, and take full ownership of your accounts
  • Strong communication skills: clear, confident, and low-ego: you make complex things feel simple
  • Willingness to travel 20–40% to customer sites

Target Annual Compensation: $230K-280K OTE

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

Navarro Research and Engineering is recruiting a Nuclear Engineer (3975) that is remote but with some travel to Idaho Falls, ID. This is a consulting position.

Navarro Research & Engineering is an award-winning federal contractor dedicated to partnering with clients to advance clean energy and deliver effective solutions for complex challenges in the nuclear and environmental fields. Joining Navarro means being a part of an exceptional team committed to quality and safety while also looking for innovative strategies to create value for the client’s success. Headquartered in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, Navarro has active programs in place across the nation for DOE/NNSA, NASA, and the Department of Defense.

Position Summary

The Nuclear Engineer will provide analysis and design support for sodium-cooled reactor systems where they are small modular reactors (SMRs), with emphasis on sodium-cooled fast reactor technology. The engineer will apply thermal hydraulics principles, modeling and simulation methods, and reactor systems engineering expertise to evaluate system performance, heat transfer, transients, and safety-related behavior.

This position may be performed remotely and may require travel to Idaho to support conceptual design activities and related technical collaboration.

Responsibilities

  • Perform engineering analysis and design for sodium-cooled reactor systems.
  • Develop, execute, and evaluate thermal hydraulics models and simulations supporting sodium-cooled fast reactor design and analysis.
  • Support reactor systems design activities and evaluate system performance against applicable technical objectives and design criteria.
  • Apply computational fluid dynamics tools and/or reactor system analysis codes to assess fluid flow, heat transfer, and system behavior.
  • Conduct safety analyses, transient analyses, and heat transfer evaluations for advanced reactor systems.
  • Prepare and communicate technical results, assumptions, methods, and conclusions in support of design reviews and conceptual design activities.
  • Support nuclear licensing activities, technical design reviews, and advanced reactor development programs, as assigned.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, national laboratories, reactor vendors, and advanced reactor developers, as applicable.
  • Travel to Idaho as needed to support conceptual design activities and other project requirements.

Requirements

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in engineering or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience performing analysis and design for reactor systems.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and travel to Idaho as project needs require.

The candidates should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Sodium-cooled fast reactor (SFR) design and analysis
  • Thermal hydraulics modeling and simulation
  • Reactor systems design and performance evaluation
  • Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and/or system codes used in reactor analysis
  • Safety analysis, transient analysis, and heat transfer evaluations
  • Nuclear licensing, design reviews, or advanced reactor development programs

Education and Experience

A master’s degree or Ph.D. in engineering or a closely related technical discipline is required.

Due to the nature of the government contract requirements and/or clearances requirements, US citizenship is required.

jobs.description:
About the role

The Solution Architect – Fiber & Structured Cabling, AI Data Center is a customer-facing technical role responsible for designing and architecting high-density fiber and structured cabling solutions for large-scale AI data center environments. The role works closely with customers, Solution Specialists, Account Executives, engineering, Professional Services, OEMs, manufacturers, and delivery teams to translate AI infrastructure requirements into scalable, repeatable, and executable physical connectivity designs. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in data center fiber infrastructure and understands the unique density, speed, scale, quality, and deployment requirements associated with GPU clusters, high-performance networks, and hyperscale AI environments.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead technical discovery and architecture for fiber and structured cabling solutions supporting AI data center programs.
  • Translate customer compute, network, rack, and deployment requirements into physical layer designs, standards, BOMs, and implementation requirements.
  • Design high-density fiber architectures supporting GPU clusters, Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics, storage networks, and data center interconnects.
  • Develop rack-to-rack, row, zone, meet-me-room, backbone, horizontal, and cross-connect cabling architectures.
  • Define fiber types, connectorization, polarity, patching, labeling, pathway, containment, and cable management standards.
  • Develop and validate cable matrices, port maps, connectivity schedules, rack elevations, drawings, BOMs, and installation documentation.
  • Partner with OEMs and infrastructure manufacturers to validate interoperability, standards, product selection, and technical roadmaps.
  • Support estimating, proposals, statements of work, RFQs/RFPs, technical presentations, and customer design reviews.
  • Work with Professional Services and field delivery teams to ensure designs are constructible, scalable, testable, and repeatable across large deployments.
  • Support design-to-delivery handoff, installation standards, QA/QC requirements, testing, certification, documentation, and closeout.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize and automate fiber design, documentation, BOM creation, and deployment methodologies.

What you have

  • 5+ years of experience designing fiber, structured cabling, or physical network infrastructure in data center environments.
  • Strong background in one or more AI Data Center connectivity areas, including high-density fiber architectures, GPU cluster connectivity, Ethernet/InfiniBand fabrics, structured cabling, data center interconnect, rack-level connectivity, and large-scale fiber deployment.
  • Strong knowledge of single-mode and multimode fiber, MPO/MTP and LC connectivity, polarity methods, transceivers/optics, patching architectures, and high-density fiber management.
  • Experience supporting large-scale data centers, hyperscale environments, AI infrastructure, HPC, cloud providers, NCPs, or major colocation/data center operators is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to interpret network designs, rack elevations, port maps, equipment layouts, construction drawings, and customer technical standards.
  • Experience creating or validating BOMs, cable matrices, connectivity schedules, design packages, test requirements, and as-built documentation.
  • Knowledge of structured cabling standards, installation practices, testing/certification, labeling, pathways, and data center QA/QC processes.
  • Experience working with major networking OEMs, optics providers, fiber manufacturers, and structured cabling partners.
  • Strong customer-facing communication, technical presentation, documentation, and design-review skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across sales, architecture, engineering, Professional Services, project management, operations, field delivery, and partner organizations.
  • Ability to operate in fast-moving environments where designs and deployment requirements evolve rapidly.
  • AI infrastructure and large GPU clusters
  • 400G, 800G, and emerging high-speed data center connectivity
  • High-performance Ethernet and InfiniBand fabrics
  • Hyperscale or cloud data center fiber architecture
  • High-density rack and row-level connectivity
  • Large-scale fiber installation and patching programs
  • Pre-terminated and modular fiber solutions
  • Offsite fiber preparation, kitting, labeling, and pre-integration
  • Fiber testing, certification, troubleshooting, and remediation
  • Automated cable matrices, BOMs, port mapping, and design documentation
  • Multi-site deployment standards and repeatable data center design methodologies
  • Fiber Architecture – Deep understanding of high-density data center fiber design and physical connectivity.
  • AI Infrastructure Knowledge – Understands how GPU compute, networking, storage, and rack architectures drive physical layer requirements.
  • Design at Scale – Creates repeatable architectures capable of supporting thousands of racks and very large connection counts.
  • Technical Accuracy – Maintains rigorous attention to port mapping, polarity, labeling, testing, documentation, and quality.
  • Customer Engagement – Can lead technical discovery, design workshops, and customer architecture reviews.
  • Design-to-Delivery Thinking – Develops solutions that can be efficiently sourced, pre-built, installed, tested, and operated.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Connects customer requirements with sales, engineering, sourcing, partners, and field delivery.
  • Quality and accuracy of fiber and structured cabling designs
  • Speed from customer requirements to executable solution architecture
  • Design standardization and repeatability across AI Data Center programs
  • Reduction of field changes, rework, and connectivity defects
  • Successful technical support of pipeline and customer pursuits
  • Accuracy of BOMs, cable matrices, port maps, and design documentation
  • Successful transition from solution architecture into deployment
  • Customer satisfaction and technical credibility

The ideal candidate is a hands-on data center fiber architect who understands how to turn complex AI infrastructure and network requirements into highly accurate, scalable physical connectivity solutions. They should be comfortable working from GPU and network architecture down to the rack, port, optic, fiber, connector, pathway, and patching level. This individual should combine strong technical depth with practical deployment experience—someone who can design for scale while understanding how the solution will actually be sourced, staged, installed, tested, documented, and supported in a high-velocity AI Data Center environment.

What you can expect

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

About us

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. We help our world-renowned customers to source, transform, and manage their IT infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling users and their business. We’re a public company quoted on the London FTSE 250 (CCC.L) and employ over 21,000 people worldwide. In the US, we support some of the country’s best-known businesses with regional hubs in San Francisco and Irvine, CA; Norcross, GA; Plano, TX; and New York City; and Integration Centers in Silicon Valley and Atlanta.

Full-Cycle Recruiting • Talent Partnership • Candidate Experience

The People Attraction Partner manages the full recruitment lifecycle and helps attract the talent needed to support organizational growth. This role partners with hiring leaders to understand staffing needs, develop recruiting strategies, identify and assess qualified candidates, and deliver a positive experience from initial contact through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff.

What You’ll Be Doing

You will support a variety of positions and may manage high-volume, field-based, corporate, and specialized hiring needs. Success requires the ability to move quickly, manage competing priorities, build trusted relationships, and provide useful talent-market guidance.

● Manage full-cycle recruiting: Lead recruiting from intake through offer acceptance, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate evaluation, offer preparation, and onboarding handoff.

● Build candidate pipelines: Use job boards, social media, referrals, networking, direct outreach, recruiting events, and other sourcing channels to develop qualified talent pools.

● Support offers and hiring decisions: Partner with hiring leaders and People Operations to develop competitive offers, extend verbal offers, support negotiations, and drive offer acceptance.

● Provide talent-market insights: Share information about candidate availability, compensation expectations, hiring challenges, market conditions, and competitor activity.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a critical member of the Customer Experience Strategy team, you will focus on advancing our mission of delivering a superior experience throughout the customers' end-to-end journey. You will play a pivotal role in improving our customers' experience, loyalty and growth by influencing the company and our leadership to action using customer experience feedback and insights, increasingly powered by AI-driven signal analysis. This role reports directly to the Head of CX Strategy.

You have extensive voice of the customer (VoC) program management experience and are passionate about customer data, with a proven history of driving insights that improve the customer experience. You understand that AI is changing how companies listen to, understand, and act on customer feedback, and you're excited to bring that thinking into how we run our listening programs. You will partner with leaders across the organization to execute new customer listening programs and provide a more holistic, increasingly real-time voice of customer assessment for Samsara.

You'll come with a strong understanding of customer experience program management, analytics, and the ability to tell compelling stories with data. You will also come ready to dive deep into customer journeys and data — using both traditional analysis including customer visits and interviews, and emerging AI tools like LLM-based theme extraction and AI-inferred sentiment analysis — to understand and empathize with customer pain points and identify opportunities with respect to customer engagement, business strategy, and quality of service.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Build a world-class customer listening infrastructure. Design and lead new and emerging Voice of Customer (VoC) programs — NPS, CSAT, CES, transactional and relationship surveys as well as customer interviews — that give the organization actionable customer experience insights. Use AI to help move beyond periodic snapshots toward more continuous, real-time, customer sentiment. This includes survey design and operations, reporting, analysis, and managing a robust closed loop process.
  • Derive rich insights from quant and qual customer data. Go beyond top-line reporting — dig deep to uncover key drivers, surface less obvious trends, and business/customer-health impact.
  • Drive systemic customer experience improvements. Facilitate cross-functional insight reviews and action-planning meetings with internal stakeholders to drive customer experience improvements. Lead efforts targeting key customer pain points to optimize the customer experience, working cross-functionally to integrate quantitative and qualitative feedback to determine, design and implement strategic solutions.
  • Help evaluate and pilot AI tooling for CX intelligence, from automated insight-delivery platforms to AI-moderated research tools, partnering with the team to balance innovation with data quality and security.
  • Operationalize a customer-centric culture at Samsara. Inspire the organization to listen, understand and act on customer feedback as an effective data-driven storyteller.
  • Be a CX and AI thought leader. Bring industry leading trends, technologies, and best practices — including emerging AI applications in customer intelligence — to Samsara to continually stay best in class on customer experience programs and approaches.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years direct experience in Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Partner Experience, or Market Research in a B2B SaaS or Fortune 500 Company.
  • Travel: Comfort traveling to customer sites 2-3 times/quarter (1-2 days per trip) to gain first-hand understanding of customer operations.
  • Experience managing global customer or partner listening posts, such as NPS programs, advisory boards, transactional survey programs, or event-based surveys.
  • Knowledge of a variety of survey design and research methods.
  • Experience in analyzing and interpreting a mix of qualitative and quantitative data, constructing compelling narratives, and providing recommendations on complex topics. Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills; deep sense of curiosity.
  • Strong presentation skills, able to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner both verbally and in writing, comfortable in business and technical discussions. Ability to synthesize a broad set of information into a cohesive narrative.
  • Experience applying statistical techniques and working knowledge of statistics concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools applied to customer understanding — such as LLM-based theme extraction, AI-inferred sentiment analysis, AI-moderated research, or AI-augmented VoC programs.
  • Experience in building trusting relationships and influencing others (including executive audiences).
  • Comfort in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Willingness to roll up your sleeves; no task is too big or small.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience using Qualtrics, Medallia, or similar enterprise-level experience management platforms.
  • Experience using R programming or Stata for statistical analysis on customer experience data.
  • Experience running churn and predictive models based on customer experience data.
  • Exposure to AI-moderated research tools or automated insight/reporting platforms.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

$106,802—$161,550 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. Accommodations

Job Description

The Revenue Cycle Payor Knowledge Analyst will support the Revenue Cycle Payor Knowledge Team by interpreting and analyzing payer contract terms and reimbursement methodologies. The role includes reviewing payer contract language to create and maintain accurate fee schedules, identifying discrepancies between contracted terms and actual reimbursements, and analyzing data to identify opportunities to maximize reimbursements through payer negotiations, projects, and trends impacting the organization’s revenue. This position will collaborate closely with various internal teams, including Revenue Cycle Management, clinical leaders, application vendors, and SHM Revenue Cycle Systems and L&D teams.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage the contract management tool, Rivet.
  • Oversee SHM Revenue Cycle fee-related tablespaces.
  • Support prioritization and implementation of system changes and updates.
  • Troubleshoot issues and inquiries from end users.
  • Coordinate and participate in project task deliverables.
  • Prepare and attend payer meetings.
  • Review, interpret, extract, and organize key information from payer contracts and amendments into the Payer Contract Matrix.
  • Create, maintain, and validate fee schedules based on contract payment sources and reimbursement rates.
  • Analyze reimbursement data to identify discrepancies, payer trends, and opportunities for maximizing reimbursement.
  • Research payer contract documentation and payer websites (e.g., provider manuals, billing policies) to ensure contract compliance and reimbursement integrity.
  • Communicate identified opportunities and trends, both internally and externally, with data support.
  • Compile reports for RCM team members to review unfavorable claim outcomes, pursue recovery of underpayments, or submit corrected claims.
  • Initiate contact with payers to validate contracted rate discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with the Payor Knowledge team to resolve fee schedule errors, load new codes, and map payers.
  • Work with product and technology teams to develop new technology solutions or enhance existing software.
  • Prepare client-facing reports and special projects related to contracts and fee schedules, adhering to company branding and templates. Reports may include Charge Master Analysis, Quarterly Payer Scorecard Reports, Claim Analysis Reports, and Underbilling Alerts.

Minimum Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong analytical skills to reconstruct multi-step processes and correct sources of error.
  • Extensive knowledge of Revenue Cycle applications, including updates and enhancements.
  • Basic understanding of medical billing, including charge entry, EOB/remittance review, payment posting, and reconciliation practices.
  • Excellent verbal and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to explain problems, solutions, and changes effectively.
  • Proficiency with computer systems and the ability to quickly adapt to new programs and websites.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Ability to interpret contract language and manage contract database updates.
  • Advanced analytical and research skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple complex contracts simultaneously.
  • Industry certifications (e.g., CSPR, CRCR, CHAM, CHFP, FHFMA, FACHE) are a plus.
  • Knowledge and experience with various practice billing software systems, including understanding the workflow, processes, and billing procedures.
  • Familiarity with clinic, provider groups, and hospital revenue cycle and insurance payment methodologies.
  • Expertise in payer contracts, insurance types, and related billing and reimbursement policies.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage payer contract, fee schedule, and analysis responsibilities across multiple business units.
  • Initiative to stay current with evolving billing practices and share knowledge with the team.
  • Knowledge of state, federal, and commercial payer reimbursement rules, policies, and methodologies.

This role is essential to ensuring accuracy and maximizing revenue for the organization while maintaining strong payer relationships.

General/Body Radiologist | Build Your Own Schedule | Remote, Hybrid & Onsite | Texas
