Practice Radiology on Your Terms

What if you could have more control over when, where, and how much you work?

Austin Radiological Association (ARA), a Radiology Partners affiliate, is seeking General/Body Radiologists to join our growing practice with multiple opportunities designed around different physician preferences and lifestyles.

Choose from remote, hybrid, or onsite practice and a variety of daytime and evening schedules. Whether you want a traditional full-time schedule, greater flexibility during the week, or the opportunity to increase your income through additional shifts and pay-per-click work, we offer options to help you build the practice that fits your life.

You’ll join a nationally respected, physician-led practice with a broad clinical footprint, strong subspecialty support, modern technology, and an established infrastructure designed to make practicing radiology more efficient.

Build Your Career Around Your Life

We believe flexibility should mean more than simply choosing between two shifts.

Our model gives you the opportunity to create a schedule that aligns with your priorities while maintaining access to strong clinical volume, competitive compensation, and long-term career growth.

For physicians seeking a more traditional lifestyle, Monday–Friday options with no required after-hours or weekend coverage are available. Physicians who prefer additional flexibility or increased earning potential can incorporate PPC work, additional shifts, call, or weekend coverage into their schedule.

Why Radiologists Choose This Opportunity

  • Build your own schedule
  • Choose where you work: remote, hybrid, or onsite
  • Choose when you work: daytime or evening
  • Broad General/Body Radiology case mix
  • Strong subspecialty support across Body, MSK, Neuro, Breast, IR, and more
  • Competitive compensation and incentive opportunities
  • PPC model with additional earning potential
  • Commencement & retention bonus opportunities
  • Partnership track opportunities
  • Fellowship stipends available for eligible fellows
  • Optional additional shifts for increased income
  • No requirement to take additional calls or weekend coverage
  • Established, high-volume practice
  • Unified PACS, standardized protocols, and streamlined dictation workflow
  • Robust technology and dedicated IT support
  • Physician-led culture focused on autonomy and clinical excellence
  • Academic affiliation with Dell Medical School at The University of Texas at Austin

The Opportunity

As a General/Body Radiologist, you will interpret a diverse range of diagnostic imaging studies within a highly collaborative and efficient practice environment.

Clinical responsibilities may include:

  • General diagnostic radiology
  • CT interpretation
  • MRI interpretation based on experience and practice needs
  • Ultrasound
  • X-ray and radiographs
  • Body imaging
  • Emergency and acute-care imaging
  • Collaboration with subspecialty radiologists
  • Communication with referring physicians and clinical teams
  • Timely, accurate, high-quality diagnostic interpretation

Fellowship training in Body, MSK, Neuro, Breast, or General Radiology is welcomed. The case mix can be aligned with your experience, clinical interests, and practice needs.

Choose How You Practice

Remote -Enjoy the freedom of working from home without the daily commute, supported by an established remote infrastructure, unified workflow, and dedicated IT team.

Hybrid -Combine the flexibility of remote practice with the collaboration and collegiality of an onsite environment.

Onsite-Work alongside experienced subspecialty radiologists in a collaborative reading-room environment with strong clinical and operational support.

Daytime or Evening -Choose from multiple scheduling options based on your lifestyle and career goals. Whether you prefer traditional daytime hours or an evening schedule, we have opportunities available.

More Flexibility. More Choice. More Opportunity.

Radiologists have different priorities—and those priorities can change over time.Maybe you want to spend more time with your family. Maybe you want to eliminate your commute. Maybe you want a predictable weekday schedule. Or perhaps you're looking for an opportunity to increase your income by taking additional shifts.

Your practice doesn't have to look like everyone else's.Build the schedule that works for you, then adjust it as your priorities change.

For those seeking a traditional schedule, Monday–Friday options without required after-hours or weekend coverage are available. For physicians interested in maximizing earning potential, PPC work, additional call, evening, or weekend shifts may be available.

About ARA & Dell Medical School Partnership:

ARA and Dell Medical School at The University of Texas at Austin are working together to help redefine how diagnostic imaging is designed, delivered, and leveraged to improve patient health.

ARA is a nationally recognized radiology practice with a 73+-year legacy of excellence and more than 118 radiologists+ serving hospitals and outpatient imaging centers throughout Central Texas. ARA currently serves 24 hospitals and operates 18 outpatient imaging centers, with expansion plans underway to grow to 19 outpatient imaging centers by the end of 2026.

Through its academic relationship with Dell Medical School, ARA provides opportunities for physicians interested in teaching, mentorship, and academic collaboration.

Our mission is simple: To Transform Radiology.

This Opportunity Is Ideal If You’re Looking For:

  • A General/Body Radiology position
  • The ability to build your own schedule
  • Remote, hybrid, or onsite practice
  • Daytime or evening opportunities
  • Broad diagnostic imaging
  • Strong subspecialty support
  • Competitive compensation and incentive opportunities
  • PPC opportunities to increase your income
  • Partnership potential
  • Commencement and retention incentives
  • Optional additional call and weekend shifts
  • A modern, streamlined clinical environment
  • Strong technology and operational support
  • A physician-led culture where radiologists have a voice
  • Long-term career stability and growth

Whether you're an experienced General Radiologist looking for greater autonomy, a physician seeking a better lifestyle fit, or a recent fellow looking for mentorship and career growth, this opportunity gives you the flexibility to practice the way you want to practice.

Qualifications

  • Board Certified or Board Eligible in Diagnostic Radiology by the ABR or AOBR
  • Fellowship training in Body, MSK, Neuro, Breast, or General Radiology welcomed
  • Comfortable interpreting a broad range of general diagnostic imaging
  • Strong interpersonal and collaborative communication skills
  • Commitment to clinical excellence and high-quality patient care
  • Active Texas medical license or ability to obtain one
  • Fellows and residents are encouraged to apply

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • Commencement, retention, and incentive packages available
  • Pay-Per-Click opportunities
  • Additional call opportunities for physicians seeking increased earning potential
  • Fellowship stipends available for eligible fellows
  • Partnership opportunities
  • Comprehensive benefits package, subject to eligibility, including:
    • Health, dental, vision, life, disability, and malpractice insurance
    • CME allowance and healthcare reimbursement
    • 401(k) with employer support
    • Family planning benefits
    • Telehealth benefits
    • Additional wellness benefits

Why Austin, Texas

Austin offers an unmatched combination of professional opportunity and exceptional quality of life.

  • Vibrant food, music, and cultural scene
  • Excellent schools and family-friendly communities
  • Abundant outdoor recreation
  • Thriving healthcare and technology sectors
  • Rapidly growing economy and population
  • No state income tax
  • One of the country's most desirable destinations for physicians and families

If you're looking for a General/Body Radiology opportunity that gives you choice, flexibility, earning potential, and long-term career growth,we would love to connect with you.Choose where you work. Choose when you work. Choose how much you work.Build your schedule. Build your career. Build it your way.

FOR MORE INFORMATION OR TO APPLY:

For inquiries about this position, please contact Jen Cunningham 682-220-5681.

Radiology Partners Overview

Radiology Partners, through its owned and affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As physician-led and physician-owned practice, we advance our bold mission by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

Radiology Partners is an equal opportunity employer. RP is committed to being an inclusive, safe and welcoming environment where everyone has equal access and equitable resources to reach their full potential. Each brand has access to a deep community of experts, tools and resources to grow their practices, and an unwavering commitment to delivering high-quality consumer healthcare experiences at scale.

As a reflection of our current needs and planned growth we are very pleased to offer an opportunity to join our dedicated team as Vice President, Field Sales & Operations supporting the ClearChoice Dental Implant Centers brand. For over 15 years, ClearChoice Dental Implant Centers has provided innovative and quality dental implant care to patients across the United States. Each center is focused on the same mission—to provide quality dental implant treatment for people who are looking for a long-term solution to chronic dental issues. ClearChoice Holdings is a provider in practice management services to a network of affiliated same-day dental implant centers. ClearChoice provides administrative and non-clinical services to dental implant centers, a network of doctor owned and operated dental treatment centers providing dental implant care (similar to ADMI/TAG). In 2022 we received "Top 150 Places to Work" by the Denver Post.

The Vice President, Field Sales & Operations is the senior sales leader for a +25-location, +300-employee, +$200M revenue division of ClearChoice. Reporting to the Division President, this role is primarily responsible for designing, executing, and optimizing the division's sales strategy to drive sustainable revenue growth, market share expansion, patient acquisition, and case acceptance performance across the division.

While supporting broader business performance, the Vice President's principal focus is leading the division's sales organization, developing high-performing sales teams, and building scalable sales processes, capabilities, and accountability systems that deliver consistent results. This leader will partner closely with the Division President, who retains ultimate accountability for both divisional sales and operational performance.

In addition to serving as the division's sales leader, the Vice President will provide support and partnership in key operational initiatives. Working alongside Regional Directors, General Managers, Clinical Leadership, and the Division President, this role will help identify operational improvement opportunities that strengthen patient experience, enhance sales outcomes, improve organizational effectiveness, and support overall business performance.

To succeed in an evolving competitive landscape and support ClearChoice's continued growth, the Vice President, Field Sales & Operations must be an agile and influential leader who can translate business objectives into effective go-to-market strategies, inspire high-performing teams, leverage data to drive decisions, and lead through change.

A successful Vice President will deliver accelerated sales growth, increased patient acquisition, improved conversion metrics, stronger forecasting accuracy, enhanced team capability, and sustainable revenue performance while serving as a trusted strategic partner to the Division President, doctors, and regional leadership teams.

Strategic Leadership & Growth

  • Serve as the divisional leader responsible for developing and executing sales strategies that drive year-over-year revenue growth, patient acquisition, and market expansion.

  • Analyze market dynamics, competitive intelligence, referral patterns, and patient trends to identify growth opportunities and optimize commercial performance.
  • Lead the development of sales-focused initiatives that increase case acceptance, maximize revenue opportunities, and improve overall division performance.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and corporate partners to align demand-generation strategies with divisional growth objectives.
  • Support divisional people and culture initiatives that strengthen engagement, performance, and retention across the sales organization.

Divisional Sales Leadership

  • Develop, implement, and continuously refine the division's comprehensive sales strategy.
  • Establish annual, quarterly, and monthly sales objectives aligned with company growth goals.

jobs.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
jobs.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
jobs.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team
  • Taking on projects and initiatives delegated by the Service Director


Position Specs:

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month, consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • Contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement, meaning you cannot hold a position of a similar nature elsewhere while working for Hustler Marketing
  • A 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Performance reviews every 9 to 12 months, with the first one after 3 to 6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

You are a senior designer with at least five years behind you, and a portfolio of real client work across different brands and niches rather than a handful of personal projects. At least three of those years involve email marketing design.

You are expert in Figma. Not comfortable in it, expert. You should be able to build and maintain component libraries, and it helps if you follow what Figma releases closely enough to tell the team when something new is worth adopting. Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity is a useful complement, though we do not lean on either heavily.

You know more than one kind of design output. Email and SMS campaign design is the core of it, but ad images, GIFs, and short video edits come up constantly. Some basic knowledge of web design is a plus rather than a requirement, since landing pages appear from time to time and the team already handles most of that themselves.

What matters most is your eye, and how you talk about it. You can look at a design that is not performing and say what is wrong with it, in what order, and what you would change first. Then you can put that in a message a designer understands without needing a follow-up call. That skill is most of this job.

You are organised enough to run a week of work across several people, and to rearrange it at short notice without the whole thing falling apart.

You are the sort of person a team talks to. Ours is independent and reliable, and there are a few things they would like to see improved that are hard to change quickly. What matters to them is knowing their comments are being considered and answered, not that every one of them gets a yes.

You are curious. You notice when a process could be better and you do something about it instead of working around it. You bring people together across teams with workshops, documents, and tutorials without waiting to be asked.

And you notice detail, in your own work and in everyone else's.


Key traits for this position:

Strong visual judgement, and the vocabulary to explain it. Organised, and calm when the week changes shape. Approachable, and willing to have the honest conversation rather than the easy one. Curious about tools and trends without chasing every new thing. Detail-oriented past the point of comfort. At ease working remotely with people spread across several countries and time zones.


Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience as a graphic designer, with a minimum of 3 years in email marketing design
  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building and working from component libraries
  • Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite or Affinity
  • Experience producing ad images, animated GIFs, and short video edits
  • An established portfolio showing on-brand, effective design work for a range of clients, stores, and niches
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating other designers. A formal lead title is not required, but you should have done the work
  • The ability to review someone else's design work and give written feedback that is specific and actionable
  • The ability to distribute and reorganise a team's weekly workload, including at short notice
  • A basic understanding of web design and landing pages is a plus
  • Experience with Klaviyo, or with a comparable email marketing platform, is a plus
  • Comfortable with Slack, Asana, Hubstaff, Google Workspace, and Figma, and willing to learn whatever else we use
  • Fluent written and spoken English. It does not need to be your first language, but you will be writing feedback and running calls in it every day
  • Remote work experience, ideally with a team spread across time zones
  • Available and responsive during office hours, Monday to Friday between 3 and 6 PM Barcelona time
  • Consistently working 30 to 35 hours per week, which is 140 hours per month
  • A stable internet connection, a laptop or PC, and the ability to join video calls

The Role We Need

PadSplit's demand engine spans Marketing, Lifecycle, Member Acquisition, and Member Success, but no one owns how these teams connect once a lead is approved, leaving us blind to where members stall on the way to a move-in and unable to see which outreach actually converts. We need a Revenue Operations Lead to own the last, most critical leg of the funnel: the calling and human outreach that turns an approved lead into a housed member, along with the reporting that makes the whole funnel legible. This role starts narrow (conversion and outreach) with room to expand into the broader Demand Growth function over time.

The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for a builder-operator with 5+ years in revenue operations, growth operations, or funnel analytics, who is fluent in SQL or a BI tool like Hex, Mode, or Looker and has real instinct for calling operations, script testing, and agent coaching. This person uses AI daily to build reporting, analyze calls, and scale outreach, and has a clear point of view on where AI makes an ops team faster. They can hold many channels at once without losing the thread, and translate a messy funnel into decisions leadership can act on.

jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewPlus Power is an energy storage market leader, with a market-leading 10+ GW portfolio across more than 25 states that will transform North American electric grids into cleaner and more versatile critical infrastructure.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Plus Power is an energy storage market leader, with a market-leading 10+ GW portfolio across more than 25 states that will transform North American electric grids into cleaner and more versatile critical infrastructure.

Standalone energy storage is rapidly transforming the North American energy markets, because it is cheaper than new natural gas plants, faster to build than fossil peakers or transmission, and able to perform diverse energy services. Plus Power partners with electricity system operators, utilities, and investors to originate, develop, finance, own and operate standalone energy storage projects that provide critical services to the wholesale electric market. Plus Power’s team applies an intentional mindset to energy storage development by using a data-driven approach to development and operations.

At Plus Power, we are focused on solving hard climate problems, profitably. We are growing fast, and value candidates who, like us, share a focus on setting high expectations, owning and learning from mistakes in the spirit of radical transparency, and are committed to internal partnering as a key element of our ideas meritocracy. Our team praises Plus Power’s culture and excels through our game-changing mission and supportive ecosystem.

About the Role

Plus Power is looking to hire a Finance and Capital Markets Analyst to join the company’s finance team. This individual will support all aspects of project finance transactions for Plus Power’s battery storage projects including construction financing, term debt/back-leverage and tax equity. Key responsibilities include creating and managing complex financial models, supporting the due diligence process, project management of financing deliverables, and coordinating with external financing parties to support the closing and funding of transactions. In addition, you will assist the finance team in bidding and structuring offtake agreements and executing on project acquisitions and project sales. This individual will get broad exposure to all aspects of the energy storage development and financing process and will collaborate with all functional teams across the company. This role includes significant responsibilities and room for growth within the company.

Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Support: Support all aspects of debt and tax equity financing transactions, including preparation of marketing materials, due diligence, management of external consultants, and financial modeling.
  • Project Modeling: Own all aspects of project financial models throughout the project lifecycle, including development, construction and operations. Modeling activities include project optimization, offtake bidding, and sourcing and vetting model inputs with experts in various groups across the company (Development, Interconnection, Markets, EPC, Origination, Asset Management).
  • Data Analytics & Tools: Support the creation of dashboards, reports, and analytics to support senior management decision making and reporting to corporate investors
  • Market Analysis: Analyze macroeconomic and ISO-level trends, including impacts of tax law changes, interest rate environments, and broader sector trends, and their effect on the viability of the company’s portfolio.
  • Cross-Functional Support and Collaboration: Collaborate with other teams within Plus Power to perform economic analysis and support key business decisions, including PPA pricing, optimization of project design, major equipment selection and O&M contract negotiation.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or related field
  • 1-2 years of project finance transaction experience at a developer, investment bank, project finance lender, tax equity investor, or infrastructure investor; OR finance/technical degree from a rigorous undergraduate program and completion of (or willingness to complete) a financial modeling course
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, especially Microsoft Excel, including experience with project financial modeling
  • Tax equity modeling experience a plus
  • Specific experience in energy storage, renewables, or gas a plus
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and effectively in a cross-functional environment with team members who are geographically dispersed
  • Highly organized with impeccable attention to detail
  • Experience managing large projects with multiple stakeholders on tight timelines
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill and present complex information clearly and succinctly to internal and external stakeholders, including financing counterparties.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build positive working relationships and interact effectively with individuals across a range of roles, seniority levels, and working styles
  • Ability and desire to learn and take on responsibility quickly
  • Location flexible with a preference for candidates based in or near San Francisco, Chicago, Brooklyn, or Seattle (where other finance team members are based)

Compensation, Location, and Benefits

Highly competitive total compensation from one of North America’s leading energy storage developers, owners, and operators, along with market-leading health benefits, 401(k) match, generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, work from home stipend, and other programs designed to support employees and their families.

Flexible work arrangements include work-from-home or hybrid options from Plus Power’s offices in The Woodlands, San Francisco, Chicago, Seattle, Brooklyn, Denver, Palm Beach Gardens, and Birmingham. While we are a remote-first company, we also have a highly engaged and connected culture, with opportunities to come together for in-person connection, professional development, and continued learning and growth. 

The expected salary range* for this position begins at $105,000. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range based on several factors including, but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, geographic labor market, and other factors consistent with applicable law. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual bonus program. 

The deadline* for applying to this role is 10/3/2026.

Plus Power is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds can thrive. Plus Power is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes ownership, and enjoys solving operational challenges at scale.

Deal Desk & Sales Operations

Reporting & Analytics

Process Improvement & Automation

Cross-Functional Collaboration

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Senior Consultant, MEQI Location: RemoteDescriptionFounded in 2004, BME Strategies is a Massachusetts-based consulting firm specializing in the design, implementation, and evaluation of public health programs for local, regional, and state government partners.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Consultant, MEQI
Location: Remote

Description

Founded in 2004, BME Strategies is a Massachusetts-based consulting firm specializing in the design, implementation, and evaluation of public health programs for local, regional, and state government partners. Our work supports evidence-based, community-driven solutions that strengthen public health systems and advance equity across the communities we serve. At BME, our clients are on the front lines of Public Health. Priorities may shift but our commitment to supporting our partners does not. We take pride in having multi-year, multi-project engagements, often working closely as an extension of their staff. Our success comes from our shared values: a bias toward action; optimistically collaborative; willingness to navigate ambiguity; minimal ego - no job is too small or big; pursuing the equitable solution; always learning, and; committed to quality at every stage.

Position Overview

The Monitoring, Evaluation, and Quality Improvement (MEQI) Senior Consultant plays a key role in designing, managing, and delivering evaluation, assessment, and quality improvement projects for state and local public health clients. Senior Consultants at this level work across BME's MEQI service pillars (Participatory Local Evidence, Continuous Improvement, Evidence at Scale, and Data Modernization & Interoperability) and may contribute to one or more pillars depending on project need and candidate expertise. Engagements with an Evidence at Scale focus are the most likely placement for candidates with strong evaluation methodology backgrounds. This position will report to an Associate Principal within the MEQI practice.

This role is an excellent fit for someone who combines strong evaluation methodology and analytical skills with the project management and coordination instincts needed to run complex, multi-stakeholder engagements well. The ideal candidate is as invested in the systems that hold a project together as in the analysis itself, communicates fluently with clients and partners at varying levels of technical sophistication, and is energized by translating rigorous methods into actionable findings for public health decision-makers. Experience in a management consulting firm is required.

Key Responsibilities

BME Org-Wide Responsibilities for Senior Consultants (Subject Matter Experts):

  • Senior Consultant roles at BME consist of approximately 85% project work, 5% administrative work, and 10% business development.
  • Leads project design and attends to client relationships.
    • May serve as a technical expert and/or individual contributor on highly specialized workstreams.
  • Minimal project oversight needed.
  • Manages projects to exemplary client satisfaction.
  • Recognizes business opportunities with existing clients and works with leadership to pursue.
  • Proactively does outreach and sourcing of new clients.
  • Sources RFPs of interest.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Evaluation, Assessment & Quality Improvement:
    • Design and implement evaluation frameworks, including logic model development, indicator design, data collection planning, analysis, interpretation, and reporting.
    • Conduct epidemiologic analyses, surveillance reviews, community health assessments, and other data-driven assessments that inform client priorities.
    • Apply contribution analysis and other evaluative approaches appropriate for complex, multi-initiative public health programs.
    • Support quality improvement engagements, including identifying improvement opportunities, facilitating QI projects, and developing related tools and guidance.
    • Support public health accreditation (PHAB) readiness where assigned, including performance management systems, documentation review, and domain mapping.
  • Project Leadership & Client Coordination:
  • Serve as project manager and day-to-day client contact on assigned engagements, keeping projects on scope, schedule, and budget.
  • Coordinate across internal team members, client staff, subcontractors, and partner organizations.
  • Anticipate logistical and methodological challenges before they become problems; bring proposed solutions rather than escalating issues alone.
  • Manage client relationships with professionalism and responsiveness, including with senior health department leadership and state agency staff.
  • Serve as a primary liaison between clients, community partners, and project stakeholders.
  • Support the design and implementation of public health initiatives, trainings, and technical assistance activities across assigned projects.
  • Data & Reporting:
    • Develop and maintain organized systems for project tracking, data management, and reporting.
    • Prepare high-quality written deliverables including technical reports, data summaries, dashboards, presentations, and policy or procedural documents.
    • Conduct community outreach activities, including participatory evaluation and assessment approaches.
  • Collaboration & Business Development:
    • Collaborate with colleagues to build tools, templates, and guidance that build lasting client capacity in performance management, accreditation, and QI.
    • Support onboarding and skills development for junior BME staff assigned to CI engagements.
    • Contribute to business development by supporting proposal writing, scope development, and identifying new opportunities within existing client accounts.
    • Other duties as assigned in support of BME's mission and client commitments.

Experience, Qualification, & Skills

  • Minimum of 6 years relevant experience required, including 4 or more years in a consulting firm environment.
  • Master’s degree in Public Health or a related field.
  • People management experience preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years client-facing experience, including 2 or more in project leadership roles.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  • Track record of managing client relationships and converting delivery quality into expanded account scope is required.
  • Strong analytical abilities across quantitative and/or qualitative methods, with the ability to select and apply approaches appropriate to the evaluation question.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex findings into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.
  • Strong project management instincts: comfortable managing timelines, coordinating across stakeholders, tracking deliverables, and flagging risk proactively.
  • Skilled facilitator capable of supporting evaluation discussions, QI sessions, community outreach, or accreditation workgroups.
  • Proficient with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Excel, R, Stata, Tableau, or similar).
  • Familiarity with public health systems and practices at the local and state level.
  • Understanding of evaluation frameworks, contribution analysis, and/or performance management approaches preferred.
  • Familiarity with and understanding of data modernization within the public health space.
  • Calm, adaptable, and solution-oriented in dynamic, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • And an alignment with BME’s shared values.
  • Preferred:
    • Experience in at least one of the following: program evaluation and evaluation design; epidemiologic methods and analysis; quality improvement; public health accreditation (PHAB) documentation or readiness support.
    • Experience with state-scale or multi-site evaluation design is a plus.

Work Environment

  • This is a full-time position based in a home office environment within the U.S.
  • BME Strategies in a remote-first organization. This role may require occasional travel to client sites, conferences, or meetings as required.

Compensation & Benefits

  • BME Strategies offers a competitive compensation package that includes:
    • 6+ weeks total leave, including paid vacation, sick time, personal leave, and floating holidays;
    • Health, dental, and vision insurance, with 75% employer-paid coverage for the employee & 50% employer-paid coverage for dependents;
    • Health FSA and dependent care FSA;
    • 401(k) with employer match;
    • Employer-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance;
    • One-time technology stipend;
    • And opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • The salary range for this position is $91,520 - $151,840 annually.

Please note: New employees are typically brought into the organization at a salary between the range minimum and the salary range midpoint, dependent upon internal equity and the budgeted amount for the position.  

How to Apply

  • To apply for this position, please complete and submit all information in the application link.
  • We expect a large volume of applicants for this position and only those candidates invited to move forward in the interview process will be contacted.
  • Important Notice on Recruitment Fraud: BME Strategies communicates with applicants only through email addresses ending @bmestrategies.com. We do not use third-party domains for recruitment outreach. If you receive communication from a different email address, please do not respond and report it to us at
  • Please note that BME Strategies is unable to sponsor work-related visas.
  • BME Strategies is made up of individuals with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. These varied points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. BME Strategies is an equal opportunity employer.   • Establish pricing, rebate structures, product positioning, implementation plans, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Identify growth opportunities across commercial cards, integrated payables, virtual cards, supplier payments, and AP automation.

  • Experience leading and developing product managers or other product professionals.
  • Deep expertise in commercial cards, AP automation, or integrated payables.
  • Experience establishing product strategy and leading products through development, launch, commercialization, and ongoing management.
  • Experience partnering with technology teams to build, modernize, and launch card or payment products.

  • Strong financial knowledge of card economics, including interchange, rebates, pricing, processing expenses, credit losses, fraud losses, technology costs, and profitability.
  • Strong understanding of accounts payable workflows, supplier payments, and commercial client payment needs.
  • Knowledge of card-network rules, regulatory requirements, risk controls, and B2B payment processes.
  • Experience developing business cases, managing product investments, and evaluating revenue, pricing, profitability, and portfolio performance.
  • Experience leading complex initiatives across technology, sales, operations, credit, risk, AML, fraud, legal, and compliance.
  • Experience managing relationships with processors, card networks, fintech providers, and payment technology partners.

About Kraymer Art & Anime Studio

Kraymer Art started as a jewelry brand for people who take their fandom seriously, collector-grade pieces made for people who notice the details, and it's grown a loyal community along the way. We're now building out a new kind of anime studio alongside it, one built around the stories and creators that the indie community loves most, turning beloved manga, manhwa, and webcomics into fully produced anime for a passionate, fast-growing audience.

The Role

This is a ground-floor marketing seat spanning both sides of what we're building: an established brand with a loyal following, and a brand-new studio launching from zero. You are not coming in to run someone else's playbook. You're coming in to build the studio's presence from scratch, right alongside growing what's already working on the jewelry side.

To be specific: you'll be growing two things at once, KraymerTV (the anime studio's social presence, starting from zero) and Kraymer Art's existing jewelry channels.

We're looking for someone who has actually grown a social audience from nothing, who knows what real community-building, earned reach, and launch marketing looks like end to end, and who is genuinely excited to build both voices at once. This is a rare opportunity to have real ownership at a company that is still early enough that your fingerprints will be on everything we build.

What you'll own: Anime Studio / KraymerTV (build from zero)

  • Build KraymerTV's social presence from the ground up: content pillars, posting cadence, and a real content calendar across platforms, with the goal of growing followers, reach, and engagement from a standing start.
  • Plan and run an earned-reach strategy to get people talking: shareable hooks/mechanics, seeding relevant online communities, and sparking user-generated content and word of mouth (not just "boost the budget and hope").
  • Own the growth funnel at every stage, from pre-launch through launch and beyond: subscribe/waitlist offer, landing page copy, and signup flow, evolving as the studio moves from pre-launch to a real, growing audience.
  • Plan and help execute paid social ad campaigns: creative direction, copy, and overall ad strategy.
  • Partner with our email team/agency on a welcome and nurture email sequence for new subscribers.
  • Help shape and carry a single, consistent brand message across every touchpoint (social, landing page, email, ads) so the studio's launch feels unified rather than scattered.
  • Lay early community groundwork: identify where engaged fans are already showing up (comments, replies, shares) and how to nurture that ahead of future community spaces.
  • Exercise judgment on sensitive or brand-critical topics and flag anything that needs leadership sign-off before it goes public.

What you'll own: Kraymer Art / Jewelry

  • Manage and grow Kraymer Art's existing social channels (Instagram, YouTube), building on an established following.
  • Keep messaging consistent with the jewelry brand's voice (collector-grade, minimalist, design-led, craftsmanship-focused) while adapting tone appropriately when content crosses over with the anime studio.
  • Identify where the jewelry audience (Gen Z and younger millennials, fashion-forward anime/manga/gaming fans, largely US-based) overlaps with the anime studio's audience, and plan cross-promotion that grows both without alienating either.

How you'll work

  • We're a fully remote, async-first team, so clear and frequent communication is essential, not optional. You should be proactive about sharing progress, flagging blockers, and giving honest status updates without being chased.
  • Poor communication (going quiet, unclear updates, or surprises instead of early flags) is a dealbreaker for this role.

Purpose

Describe the primary goals, objectives or functions or outputs of this position.

Advance AbbVie's pipeline by striving for excellence in clinical research, turning science into medicine for our patients and leveraging new advanced capabilities to drive industry leading performance.
Partners with the investigator and site staff for meaningful and effective engagements positioning AbbVie as the choice in clinical trials.
Focus on site clinical research that ensures appropriate conduct of the trial while driving improvement in data integrity, compliance, overall study performance and customer experience.

Responsibilities

List up to 10 main responsibilities for the job. Include information about the accountability and scope.

  • Considered as the primary point of contact for the investigative site. High level of competency or experience in providing contextual information on the clinical trials, connects stakeholder to the investigative sites and strengthens AbbVie’s positioning.
  • Aligns, trains and motivates the site staff and principal investigator on the goals of the clinical trial program, protocol and patient treatment principles for the trial ensuring a trusted partnership.
  • Conducts site evaluation, site training, routine, and site closure monitoring activities with compliance to the protocol and monitoring plans, in accordance with applicable regulations, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), ICH Guidelines, AbbVie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and quality standards, ensuring safety and protection of study subjects.
  • Advanced understanding of site engagement and ability to customize site engagement strategy for assigned study (ies). Gather local/site insights and utilize site engagement tools such as the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tool, to report/track progress and measure impact of that strategy.
  • Advanced level of competency connecting the study protocol, scientific principles and clinical trial requirements to the day-to-day clinical trial execution activities. Evaluate and ensure effective recruitment and retention techniques/plans based on the patient disease journey.
    Develop solid knowledge of therapeutic area, asset and clinical landscape / patient journey to enable successful patient recruitment and overall protocol compliance.
  • Possesses experienced level of competency to mentor and train less experienced CRAs on various aspects of work and provides input into their development.
    May participate in global/local task forces and initiatives. Responsible for activities as assigned by manager.
  • Responsible for continuous risk-assessment proactively, and in collaboration with Central Monitoring team, monitor activities conducted by clinical sites to detect early overall study performance or patient safety issues.
  • Advanced ability to think critically to resolve site risk signals while having robust understanding of site processes to drive study execution. Ensures preventative and corrective action plans are put into place, as needed, to mitigate risk and promote compliance using a customer centric approach.
  • Identifies, evaluates and recommends new/potential investigators/sites on an on going basis. Potential sites may be identified through networking or internal AbbVie requests to assist in the placement of planned clinical studies with qualified investigators.
  • Ensures quality of data submitted from study sites and assures timely submission of data, including appropriate reporting and follow-up for all safety events by site personnel.
    Ensures audit and regulatory inspection readiness at assigned clinical site at all times.
    Manages investigator payments as per executed contract obligations, as applicable.

Qualifications

List required and preferred qualifications (up to 10). Include education, skills and experience.

  • Appropriate tertiary qualification in health related disciplines (Medical, Scientific, Nursing) preferred.
  • Minimum of 1 year of clinically related experience, of which a period of 6 months is required in clinical research monitoring of investigational drug or device trials. Familiar with risk‐based monitoring approach, onsite and offsite monitoring.
  • Knowledge of appropriate therapeutic area indications is preferred with the ability to understand and apply scientific concepts as they relate to the conduct of clinical trials.
  • Advanced knowledge on existing and emerging local regulatory and legal requirements, ICH/GCP Guidelines and applicable policies.
  • Demonstrate strong cross-functional collaboration skills among internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate strong planning and organizational skills and the ability to work effectively and efficiently in a dynamic environment with competing projects and deadlines.
  • Advanced ability to leverage technology, tools and resources to provide customer centric support based on the health of the site.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with excellent written, verbal, active listening and presentation skills, with ability to establish and leverage site relationships and trusted partnerships through engagement, motivation, and training.
  • Ability to use functional expertise with appropriate guidance, leverage critical thinking skills and apply good judgement to address clinical site issues.
  • Acts with integrity in accordance with AbbVie code of business conduct and leadership values. Self-motivated individual focused on delivering timely and quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community.  Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

  • Multilingual proficiency and cross-cultural experience.

Systems.

jobs.excerpt: Join Our Dynamic Team as a Solutions Architect!  🌟 Are you passionate about telecoms?
jobs.description:
Join Our Dynamic Team as a Solutions Architect! 🌟

Are you passionate about telecoms? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, innovative environment? At Babble, we’re on a mission to be our customer’s most trusted advisor for cloud-based technologies. We’re looking for passionate and talented individuals to join our dynamic team. If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you!

Purpose of the Role

The Solutions Architect is the senior technical authority within the Babble Professional Services team and a hands-on technical delivery resource. The core focus of the role is the technical implementation, configuration and deployment of customer solutions across Modern Workplace, Cyber Security, Network and Backup/DR domains. Operating as a Level 3 Engineer, the role leads and performs hands-on deployment on complex, high-risk and multi-domain projects and sets the technical standard for how solutions are built and configured across the team.

The role also owns the design phase of customer engagements, producing High-Level Designs, Low-Level Designs and Statements of Work that translate requirements into buildable, production-ready solutions. Design and deployment are treated as a single continuum: the Solutions Architect is accountable for the technical quality of the solution from design through to a working, tested and handed-over deployment, and stays hands-on throughout.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead hands-on implementation on complex, high-risk or multi-domain projects including Azure Virtual Desktop deployments, complex network architectures, multi-tenant security configurations, hybrid identity environments, and large-scale migration programmes.
  • Produce High-Level Designs and Low-Level Designs for customer solutions across Modern Workplace, Cyber Security, Network and Backup/DR domains, defining the technical architecture, configuration specifications, integration requirements, and dependencies that form the basis of all Professional Services delivery.
  • Author Statements of Work that clearly define project scope, deliverables, assumptions, exclusions, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones, ensuring commercial and technical alignment between what has been sold and what will be delivered.
  • Provide technical guidance and design assurance throughout the delivery lifecycle, reviewing implementation progress against HLD/LLD specifications, validating configuration decisions made by fellow engineers and advising on deviations from the approved design where necessary.
  • Act as a senior technical resource for the wider Professional Services team, providing guidance on design ambiguities, environment conflicts, vendor-specific technical issues, and scope boundary questions to support effective project delivery across all levels.
  • Support pre-sales technical activities including customer scoping calls, solution qualification, technical feasibility assessments, and design input for proposals, ensuring opportunities are technically sound and deliverable before commitment to Statement of Work.
  • Conduct technical design reviews with customers to validate requirements, confirm design assumptions, identify risks, and secure sign-off on the proposed solution architecture before delivery commences.
  • Define and maintain technical standards, deployment checklists, configuration baselines, and design templates used across the Professional Services team, ensuring consistency and quality across all project deliveries.
  • Validate UAT results and technical acceptance for projects where the Solutions Architect has produced the design, confirming that the delivered solution meets the specifications defined in the HLD/LLD and Statement of Work.
  • Mentor and develop Level 1 and Level 2 engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, knowledge sharing and structured feedback, actively supporting career progression and capability uplift within the Professional Services team.
  • Collaborate with the Service Desk, NOC, and managed services teams to ensure solutions are designed for operational supportability, including monitoring requirements, escalation paths, documentation standards, and ongoing managed service compatibility.
  • Contribute to vendor relationship management by maintaining advanced certifications, attending vendor technical briefings, evaluating new product capabilities, and advising on the evolution of the Babble solution portfolio.
  • Identify and communicate project risks, design constraints and technical dependencies to Project Managers, the Solutions Delivery Manager and customers, providing clear recommendations and mitigation options to support informed decision-making.
  • Lead post-implementation design reviews on complex projects, evaluating design effectiveness against delivery outcomes, capturing lessons learned and feeding improvements back into design standards and templates.
  • Maintain expert-level technical skills and advanced vendor certifications across the Babble solution portfolio, staying current with platform roadmaps, architectural best practices and emerging technologies across Microsoft, Mimecast, Sophos, Acronis, networking, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Extensive experience of solution design and delivery across all four domains (Modern Workplace, Cyber Security, Backup/DR and Networking) and Azure.
  • Demonstrable design authorship (High-Level Designs, Low-Level Designs and Statements of Work) and pre-sales technical experience.
  • Track record of mentoring and raising the technical capability of a delivery team.

Desired Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or its current Microsoft successor certification.
  • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100), or its current Microsoft successor certification.
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102), or its current Microsoft successor certification.
  • Sophos Certified Architect for Sophos Firewall and Sophos Central Endpoint/Server (each requires the corresponding Sophos Certified Engineer certification as a prerequisite).
  • Acronis Certified Engineer (Cyber Protect).
  • Mimecast Certified Product Professional, Advanced level (Email Security, Cloud Gateway).

Advantageous Certifications

  • PRINCE2 7th Edition Practitioner, or equivalent project management certification (for example PMP or APM PMQ).
  • ITIL 4 Foundation (or ITIL Version 5 Foundation) in IT service management.
  • CISSP (ISC2), or equivalent senior security certification; CompTIA Security+ (SY0-701) is an acceptable foundational alternative.
  • CrowdStrike Falcon certifications such as CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA) or Falcon Responder (CCFR), and familiarity with the Falcon Complete managed detection and response service.

Why work for Babble?

  • Risk cover; covering Life Cover, Critical Illness Cover, funeral benefits and some Disability benefits
  • 22 days holiday Balance PLUS UK Bank Holidays - with increased annual leave based on length of service
  • 5% allowance based on basic salary that can be towards Medical Aid.
  • UPS provided to assist with load shedding (2-4hrs power for a laptop)
  • Babble issued laptop
  • Annual Company Celebrations

Home-Working Policy

  • Your location will be home based, and you will require stable internet connection.
  • It will be your responsibility to have a solution in place to mitigate loadshedding to ensure you are able to work your normal shifts effectively, working from a public space is not deemed a acceptable solution.
  • As a home worker we expect you to have a suitable work set up, desk and a chair in a quiet space.

The recruitment journey

We want to fill this role quickly, but we want to get the right person. The recruitment process will consist of a screening call. If you proceed past this then you will have an interview over Teams and possibly a follow up interview and competency testing depending on the role requirements.

Babble is a Customer Experience-led growth business. As the ultimate Trusted Advisor for cloud-based technologies, we specialize in empowering businesses with the best solutions from the world's leading providers.

jobs.description:
In 2017, Jan Sapper, Paperlike's founder and CEO, developed and launched a screen protector for the iPad that became an instant hit with digital artists and notetakers.

Since then, we've come a long way.

Today, we sell professional accessories for iPad users worldwide through our Shopify store, Amazon, and retail stores. We've built a global team (25 amazing people from all over the world) and a brand that is well-respected in our community.

And that's where you come in. We've built a solid foundation with 250k+ followers across all social media platforms. Now we're looking for a strategic, data-driven Social Media Manager to own and evolve how Paperlike shows up on social, and help us grow a brand that people genuinely love.

About this Role

We're looking for a full-time Social Media Manager to own Paperlike's presence across all brand channels. This isn't a content creation role. It's a strategy role. You'll be responsible for how the brand communicates on social: what we say, when we say it, to whom, and why it's working (or not).

You'll own the publishing calendar, manage community engagement, drive creator seeding outreach, and report on the metrics that actually matter. You'll bring a strong point of view on strategy and the organizational rigor to execute it.

What will you do as Paperlike's Social Media Manager?

Strategy

  • Own and drive Paperlike's social media strategy across all brand channels
  • Use performance data to inform content decisions, optimize for growth, and identify opportunities
  • Stay on top of platform trends and algorithm shifts and know when to act on them
  • Bring strategic recommendations to leadership with clear rationale and measurable goals

Content & Publishing

  • Own the social publishing calendar end-to-end: planning, scheduling, and quality control
  • Write copy across all social channels with a consistent, on-brand voice
  • Maintain a strong aesthetic eye for what goes out: every post should look and feel like Paperlike
  • Project manage the content production pipeline with two video producers and the creative team to brief, review, and deploy content

Community & Creator Relations

  • Manage community engagement across all platforms, including DMs and comments
  • Lead creator seeding outreach: identify, contact, and start relationships with relevant creators

Reporting

  • Track and report on social reach, engagement, and community growth on a regular cadence
  • Translate data into insights: not just numbers, but what they mean and what to do next

>>APPLY HERE<<

This role is for you if:

  • You have a track record of owning strategy (not just executing it).
  • You lead with data. You know how to read performance metrics and use them to make decisions.
  • You're a strong copywriter. You can write a caption that stops a scroll and sounds like a real person.
  • You have a genuine eye for aesthetics and understand what "on-brand" actually means in practice.
  • You are exceptionally organized. You can juggle a multi-channel publishing calendar, creator outreach, community management, and reporting without dropping balls.
  • You have experience with Notion and Sprout Social (not required, but a strong plus.)
  • You're comfortable working independently in a remote, async-first environment.
  • You're fluent in English, with excellent written communication skills.

>>APPLY HERE<<

Who will you work with (mostly)?

  • Kayla. Head of Brand Awareness, who leads social, partnerships, and marketing campaigns. You'll report directly to her.
  • Elina. Our Partnerships Manager, who owns all things creator and brand partnerships. You’ll work with her on any campaigns and sourcing UGC.
  • Harriett. Our Social Media Support Assistant, who is in our inbox five days of the week and will be supporting you in maintaining Paperlike’s voice when we comment or DM.
  • Content Producers. Two video creators who produce art and productivity content for our organic channels. You’ll write the briefs and give feedback on their content before scheduling them to go live.
  • The broader Paperlike team, a fully remote group of 25 people spread across the world.

Money, Time & Position Type

  • This is a full-time role. You can be based anywhere in the world, but we'd need you available for occasional video calls sometime between 9:00 and 17:00 CET.
  • Either freelance (international) or employed (Germany).
  • Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience.

>>APPLY HERE<<

Jan founded Paperlike in 2017 as a side project to solve his own need for a better iPad and Apple Pencil experience. Since he loves crowdfunding, he launched a Kickstarter for the Paperlike and was blown away by the response. He soon left his job and made Paperlike a full-time endeavor.

Now in 2026, we're a team of about 25 people. At our core, we still operate the same way: relentlessly focused on what matters, automating whatever we can to free our time and minds.

Our team is 100% remote, spread all over the world: from New York to Turkey, from Germany to China.

jobs.description:
Cheesecake Labs is an AI, data, and product engineering partner for established and scaling organizations navigating legacy systems, fragmented data, AI pressure, or limited engineering capacity.

Our services include AI Implementation, Application Modernization, Data & Analytics, Product Engineering, AI-Accelerated Delivery, and Embedded Engineering Teams. We deliver agentic workflows in 8-12 weeks and modernize applications in 5-10 months rather than 2 years. We also build trusted data foundations and digital products designed to scale. Our agentic software development lifecycle accelerates execution, while experienced engineers embed with client teams to provide technical depth, security, and clear ownership.

Member of Anthropic's Claude Partner Network; technology partners include Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, and AWS.

Across 13+ years, Cheesecake Labs has built 300+ products for clients including Eurasia Group, MoneyGram, the World Bank, Stellar, Wedgewood, PepsiCo, Merck, Sodexo, and Mercado Libre.

The story behind this role

At Cheesecake Labs, product work usually starts before things are fully defined.

We’re often brought in when companies are still shaping ideas, validating opportunities, aligning stakeholders, or trying to understand what should actually be built — and why.

That’s why we maintain a network of strong contractor Product Managers we can engage quickly as new projects and client opportunities emerge.

This is not a traditional long-term internal role.

It’s a contractor opportunity designed for people who enjoy navigating ambiguity, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, and helping turn business problems into valuable digital products across different industries and client contexts.

We’re looking for a Product Manager (Contractor) who combines product thinking, communication, organization, and client management in fast-moving international environments.

Engagement details

  • Contractor / project-based engagement
  • Paid in USD
  • Remote-first
  • Flexible allocation depending on project availability and fit
  • Opportunities may vary in duration, scope, and weekly commitment depending on client needs

Some opportunities may start immediately.
Others may become active as new projects enter our pipeline.

What this role actually looks like

This is not a “just manage backlog” type of role.

On a typical project, you might:

  • Work with clients and stakeholders to understand business goals, user problems, and product opportunities
  • Help shape product direction even when requirements, priorities, or product vision are still evolving
  • Create and organize product backlogs, user stories, business rules, and feature definitions
  • Work closely with delivery managers, designers, and engineers to define valuable, feasible, and usable solutions
  • Facilitate alignment across clients, technical teams, and business stakeholders
  • Participate in product discovery, roadmap discussions, prioritization, and go-to-market conversations
  • Join product ceremonies and help ensure the product is evolving in the right direction

Some projects will be highly strategic and discovery-oriented.
Others will be much more execution and delivery-focused.

Most are a mix of both.

What tends to work well here

We’ve seen that people who thrive in this type of engagement usually:

  • Have strong experience managing digital products across web and mobile environments
  • Feel comfortable navigating ambiguity, evolving priorities, and fast-changing product contexts
  • Know how to balance business goals, user needs, technical constraints, and delivery realities
  • Feel totally confident working in English with international clients and teams (calls, discussions, async) — at least advanced level
  • Operate well across multidisciplinary environments involving product, engineering, design, and delivery teams
  • Adapt well to consulting-style environments where different projects and industries require fast context-switching
  • Already use AI as part of their day-to-day workflow — whether for organization, discovery, documentation, research, prioritization, or workflow acceleration

Previous experience in consulting/service environments, enterprise products, or US-based client contexts is a strong plus.

This probably won’t be your thing if

Just to be transparent:

  • You prefer highly structured environments with very stable scopes and long planning cycles
  • You’re uncomfortable navigating ambiguity or balancing multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously
  • You prefer operating only at a strategic level without involvement in execution and day-to-day product decisions
  • You’d rather avoid client-facing conversations or cross-functional collaboration
  • You rely heavily on mature product structures, large internal product teams, or extensive metrics environments to operate effectively

There’s nothing wrong with any of that — it’s just not how these engagements usually operate.

One last thing

To participate in this selection process, you must:

  • Have a valid business registration in your country (such as CNPJ, VAT, EIN, or equivalent)
  • Have a bank account eligible to receive payments in USD
  • Be able to issue invoices accordingly

These requirements are necessary for contractor engagement and payment processing.

Not sure if you check every box?

That’s okay.

We know that many great people — especially from underrepresented groups — hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the requirements.

If this opportunity sounds interesting, we’d still love to hear from you.

IMPORTANT TIP -> The communication during the selection process is done by email. We suggest that you keep an eye on your email inboxes and set the permission to receive messages from @cheesecakelabs.hire.trakstar.com so our messages will not be directed to the spam box ;)

The collected personal data will be used only to manage and control candidate resumes to assess the necessary requirements such as contact information, and conduct this selection process.

The collected data will not be shared with others (“third parties”) without your authorization, and their use will be restricted to Cheesecake Labs' internal staff, and also to the service providers that process your data for the selection process.
