jobs.description:
Overview

What We Do

We calm the confusion of IT by guiding the connection between people and technology. If a customer is looking for a better way to manage their warehouse inventory, equip their workforce, or secure their data, we make it happen. All it takes is finding the right combination of tech hardware, software, cloud solutions, and support services. That’s what we do. We’re the IT Department’s IT Department.

Who We Are

Our team is made stronger by a multitude of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. It’s what makes Connection unique—what drives us to innovate and create technology solutions that stand apart from the crowd. We’d love for you to be a part of that fabric, to share your ideas and experiences with a team that thrives on fresh thinking, creativity, and helping others.

Why You Should Join Us

You’ll find supportive teammates and a rewarding career at Connection—plus great benefits. We take pride in supporting employees with a total rewards package that provides financial, emotional, and physical resources for you and your family. Our compensation, 401k plans, medical insurance, and other benefits are progressive and competitive. We value the importance of our employees’ emotional wellbeing. To support employees, we provide free therapy visits, mental health coaching and tools, and meditation resources. You’ll also enjoy a generous paid time off package that includes not only vacation and sick time, but also Wellness and Volunteer Time Off days.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Responsibilities

The Onboarding Inside Account Manager (OBIAM) is more than a sales training role—it's the launchpad for a successful career in enterprise technology sales. As an OIAM, you'll combine customer relationship management, consultative selling, and operational excellence while learning from experienced Enterprise Account Executives (EAEs).

In this hybrid role, you'll serve as both an Inside Account Manager (IAM) and Client Experience Specialist, helping new customers experience the best of Connection from day one. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives, manufacturers, distribution partners, and internal support teams to onboard customers, uncover new business opportunities, drive revenue growth, and deliver exceptional service throughout the customer lifecycle.

If you're motivated by building relationships, solving business challenges, and developing a career in technology sales, this role offers hands-on experience, mentorship, and a clear path for growth.

What You'll Do

Create Exceptional First Impressions

You'll lead a world-class onboarding experience that helps new customers quickly realize the value of partnering with Connection.

  • Deliver a personalized, "white glove" onboarding experience for new enterprise clients.
  • Introduce customers to their dedicated Connection team and available resources.
  • Demonstrate our technology solutions, customer portal, reporting capabilities, and self-service tools.
  • Understand each customer's business priorities, challenges, and strategic initiatives.
  • Configure customer portals, standards, and purchasing workflows to align with business needs.
  • Build trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders from the very beginning.

Develop into a Trusted Sales Advisor

Working alongside experienced Enterprise Account Executives, you'll learn to identify opportunities, support sales initiatives, and contribute to business growth.

  • Support one or more Enterprise Account Executives with proactive sales activities.
  • Develop and manage customer quotes, including technically configured solutions.
  • Maintain a four-hour response goal for customer quote requests.
  • Register opportunities and manage deal registrations with manufacturer partners.
  • Follow up on active proposals and sales opportunities.
  • Identify cross-sell, upsell, and whitespace opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Conduct spend analysis and proactively recommend new technology solutions.

Build Strong Customer Relationships

You'll become a trusted business partner by providing responsive service and strategic account support.

  • Maintain ongoing communication with customers, manufacturers, distributors, and internal teams.
  • Build relationships across multiple customer departments and decision-makers.
  • Help customers maximize the value of their technology investments.
  • Partner with customers on pricing strategies, standards management, and procurement optimization.
  • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and proactive account recommendations.

Lead Operational Excellence

You'll coordinate the resources needed to deliver a seamless customer experience from quote through fulfillment.

  • Oversee daily account activity to ensure timely order processing and issue resolution.
  • Partner with Inside Sales Support to maintain order accuracy and meet shipment expectations.
  • Assist with pricing reviews, order escalations, and complex open-order management.
  • Support return merchandise authorization (RMA) escalations.
  • Ensure Salesforce opportunities remain accurate and current.
  • Analyze customer activity and prepare meaningful business reports.

Collaborate and Lead

As your knowledge grows, you'll become a key resource for both customers and teammates.

  • Coordinate activities across Sales, Operations, Customer Support, and manufacturer partners.
  • Mentor and guide Inside Sales Support Representatives on customer priorities.
  • Share best practices and contribute to team success.
  • Support new Enterprise Account Executives during onboarding by introducing company resources, sales processes, and operational tools.
  • Help accelerate new EAE productivity through coaching, collaboration, and ongoing support.

What Success Looks Like

Successful OIAMs:

  • Build lasting customer relationships based on trust and responsiveness.
  • Deliver an outstanding onboarding experience that drives customer confidence.
  • Identify and develop new revenue opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Meet or exceed sales, gross profit, and customer satisfaction goals.
  • Balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Collaborate effectively across teams to deliver seamless customer experiences.
  • Continuously grow their sales, technical, and business knowledge.

Why Join Connection?

At Connection, you'll gain exposure to enterprise technology sales while working alongside experienced professionals who are invested in your success. You'll receive hands-on training, mentorship, and opportunities to build meaningful customer relationships, develop consultative selling skills, and grow into increasingly strategic sales roles.

If you're driven by learning, collaboration, and delivering exceptional customer experiences, this is an opportunity to build a rewarding career with a company that values innovation, partnership, and continuous growth.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities and qualifications for this position. Duties and responsibilities may evolve to meet business needs.

Min

USD $22.84/Hr.

Max

USD $28.89/Hr.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • Strong customer service, sales support, account management, or inside sales experience.
  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and ERP systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise or B2B technology customers.

  • Experience preparing solution quotes and managing complex sales opportunities.
  • Understanding of manufacturer partner programs, pricing strategies, and deal registration.
  • Experience with customer onboarding, account growth, or consultative sales.

Work Environment

This is a remote position requiring a dedicated home office environment. Candidates should be comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams through virtual communication tools.

Some flexibility in working hours may be required to support customers across multiple time zones.

This role will focus on ensuring a secure, efficient, and user-friendly experience for macOS devices while collaborating with the MDM team to align with organizational IT policies and objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Deployment and Configuration: Design, implement, and maintain Jamf Pro for managing macOS devices, including device enrollment, configuration profiles, policies, and application deployment.

  • User Support: Provide Tier 2/3 support for macOS-related issues, working closely with end-users and the IT support team to resolve problems efficiently.

  • Automation and Scripting: Develop and maintain scripts (e.g., Bash, Python) to automate workflows, reporting, and device management tasks within Jamf Pro.
  • Patch Management: Oversee the deployment of macOS updates, third-party application patches, and firmware updates to ensure devices remain current and secure.
  • Inventory and Reporting: Maintain accurate device inventory and generate reports on device status, compliance, and usage metrics using Jamf Pro tools.
  • Collaboration: Work with cross-functional IT teams to integrate Jamf Pro with other systems (e.g., Entra ID, SSO, or endpoint security tools) and support broader MDM strategies.
  • Documentation and Training: Create and maintain documentation for configurations, processes, and troubleshooting guides. Provide training to IT staff and end-users as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience managing macOS devices in an enterprise environment using Jamf Pro.
  • Proven track record of deploying and supporting MDM solutions for small to medium-sized user groups (100-200 users).

Technical Skills:

  • Expertise in Jamf Pro administration (e.g., Smart Groups, Policies, PreStage Enrollments, Self Service).
  • Strong knowledge of macOS system administration, including file systems, permissions, and networking.
  • Familiarity with integrating Jamf Pro with identity providers (e.g., Okta, Azure AD) and security tools.
  • Understanding of Apple’s Device Enrollment Program (DEP) and Volume Purchase Program (VPP).

Soft Skills:

  • Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong communication skills to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Education:

Clearance:

Desired Qualifications

Preferred Certifications:

  • Jamf Certified Associate or Jamf Certified Admin.
  • Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with managing iOS/iPadOS devices in Jamf Pro.
  • Knowledge of endpoint security tools (e.g., CrowdStrike).
  • Microsoft Intune for mobile device management.
  • Proficiency in scripting (Bash, Python, or similar) for automation and customization.

About the role

The Solution Architect – Rack Integration & DC Compute, AI Data Center is a customer-facing technical role responsible for architecting and operationalizing rack-level compute infrastructure for large-scale AI data center deployments. The role connects server, GPU, storage, networking, power, cooling, rack design, factory integration, and onsite deployment requirements into a complete, executable solution. The ideal candidate combines deep compute and data center infrastructure expertise with hands-on knowledge of rack integration and manufacturing processes. The role works closely with customers, Solution Specialists, OEMs, engineering, Professional Services, integration centers, supply chain, project management, and field delivery teams.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead technical discovery and solution architecture for AI compute and rack integration opportunities.
  • Translate customer GPU, server, storage, network, power, cooling, and deployment requirements into standardized rack-level designs.
  • Develop and validate rack architectures, rack elevations, BOMs, component placement, power requirements, network connectivity, and integration specifications.
  • Architect solutions for GPU and accelerated compute platforms, high-density AI racks, traditional compute platforms, storage, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Define rack integration workflows including receiving, kitting, assembly, installation, cabling, configuration, firmware, burn-in, testing, QA/QC, packaging, and shipment.
  • Partner with compute, networking, storage, power, cooling, rack, and integration OEMs to validate compatibility and technical requirements.
  • Support high-density and liquid-cooled rack designs, including CDU interfaces, manifolds, power distribution, weight, space, and facility dependencies.
  • Develop repeatable rack build standards and golden configurations that can be scaled across large AI Data Center programs.
  • Support RFQs/RFPs, proposals, statements of work, technical presentations, customer workshops, and design reviews.
  • Work with integration centers and field delivery teams to ensure designs are manufacturable, deployable, testable, and supportable at scale.
  • Define acceptance criteria, validation plans, documentation standards, and design-to-delivery handoff requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to automate BOM creation, rack design, configuration, validation, testing, and deployment documentation.

What you have

  • 7+ years of experience in data center compute, converged infrastructure, systems engineering, solution architecture, rack integration, or related infrastructure roles.
  • Strong background in one or more AI Data Center areas including GPU/accelerated compute, server platforms, converged or hyperconverged infrastructure, rack integration, high-density compute, AI/HPC infrastructure, storage, or data center networking.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise and data center compute platforms, including server architecture, CPU/GPU systems, memory, storage, PCIe, NICs/DPUs, firmware, and systems management.
  • Experience designing or supporting integrated rack solutions including compute, network, storage, PDUs, cabling, power, cooling, and mechanical requirements.
  • Experience with large-scale rack build, factory integration, staging, configuration, test, QA/QC, and deployment processes is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with AI CSPs, hyperscalers, NCPs, HPC environments, large data center operators, or major compute OEMs is highly desirable.
  • Understanding of high-density power and liquid cooling requirements associated with current and next-generation AI compute platforms.
  • Ability to create and validate rack elevations, BOMs, build documentation, configuration standards, test plans, and implementation requirements.
  • Experience working with major compute and infrastructure OEMs and understanding technology roadmaps and lifecycle considerations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills across integrated compute, network, storage, firmware, and physical infrastructure.
  • Strong customer-facing communication, technical presentation, documentation, and architecture-review skills.
  • Ability to work across sales, engineering, OEMs, integration operations, Professional Services, supply chain, project management, and field delivery.
  • NVIDIA GPU and accelerated computing platforms, including integrated AI rack architectures
  • Dell Technologies, HPE, Lenovo, Supermicro, or other enterprise/AI compute platforms
  • Converged and hyperconverged infrastructure
  • AI/HPC clusters and large-scale GPU deployments
  • High-density rack integration and factory build environments
  • Liquid-cooled compute and rack-level thermal infrastructure
  • 400G/800G Ethernet and InfiniBand connectivity within AI compute environments
  • Enterprise and AI storage platforms
  • Firmware, BIOS, BMC, systems management, configuration, and validation
  • Burn-in, functional testing, L1/L2 validation, QA/QC, and rack acceptance testing
  • Automation of rack design, BOMs, configuration, testing, and deployment workflows
  • Multi-site deployment standards and repeatable AI infrastructure methodologies
  • Compute Architecture – Deep understanding of server, GPU, storage, networking, and integrated data center compute platforms.
  • Rack Integration – Understands how to convert a technical architecture into a repeatable physical rack build and integration process.
  • AI Infrastructure Knowledge – Understands the density, performance, power, cooling, connectivity, and operational requirements of AI compute environments.
  • Design for Scale – Creates standardized architectures and golden configurations that can be replicated across hundreds or thousands of racks.
  • Technical Problem Solving – Can troubleshoot complex issues across hardware, firmware, networking, storage, power, cooling, and physical integration.
  • Design-to-Delivery Thinking – Architects solutions with manufacturing, logistics, deployment, testing, field installation, and lifecycle support in mind.
  • Customer Engagement – Leads technical discovery, architecture workshops, solution reviews, and executive-level technical discussions.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership – Connects customer requirements with OEMs, engineering, integration centers, sourcing, Professional Services, and field delivery.
  • Quality, accuracy, and scalability of AI compute and rack integration designs
  • Speed from customer requirements to an executable rack architecture and BOM
  • Standardization and repeatability of rack designs and integration processes
  • Reduction in integration defects, field changes, rework, and deployment issues
  • Successful technical support of AI Data Center pursuits and customer programs
  • Accuracy of BOMs, rack elevations, build documentation, and configuration standards
  • Successful transition from solution architecture through integration and onsite deployment
  • Customer and OEM confidence in the technical solution
  • Continuous improvement and automation of rack integration methodology

The ideal candidate is a highly technical data center compute architect who understands both the logical architecture of AI infrastructure and the physical realities of building it at rack scale. They should be able to work from a customer's compute and GPU requirements down through server configuration, rack layout, networking, power, cooling, firmware, cabling, integration, testing, and deployment. A profile similar to the current role combines AI solution architecture with deep prior experience in compute, converged/hyperconverged infrastructure, engineering, and hands-on infrastructure design. The strongest candidates will be builders who can turn complex AI platform requirements into standardized, factory-integrated solutions that can be deployed rapidly and consistently at scale.

What you can expect

There’s so much more to enjoy about being at Computacenter than just having a rewarding career. In addition to offering competitive compensation plans and long-term career opportunities, we provide an attractive mix of benefit plans to contribute to your good health, future financial security, and peace of mind.

Computacenter is a leading independent technology partner, trusted by large corporate and public sector organizations. jobs.excerpt: Was wir suchenDie #1 Plattform für NeukundenJedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir.
jobs.description:
Was wir suchen

Die #1 Plattform für Neukunden

Jedes Unternehmen braucht laufend neue Kunden – und genau dieses Problem lösen wir. Mit Interlead bauen wir die #1 Plattform für Leads, Termine und Aufträge und machen die Kundengewinnung für unsere Partner damit einfacher, transparenter und planbarer.

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir daher einen Head of IT (m/w/d) für unser IT Team, zu 100 % aus dem Home-Office (Deutschland) oder bei uns im Bremer Office!

Das sind deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst unser Tech-Team (aktuell 8 Personen aus Entwicklung, Daten und Infrastruktur) disziplinarisch und fachlich – inklusive 1:1s, Zielvereinbarungen, Weiterentwicklung und Recruiting neuer Teammitglieder.
  • Du übernimmst das operative Tagesgeschäft des CTO: Priorisierung, Ressourcenplanung, Eskalationen und alle Entscheidungen, die heute noch an ihm hängen bleiben.
  • Du verantwortest die Umsetzung unserer Roadmap über alle vier Bereiche hinweg – Product, Daten, Software und Infrastruktur – und sorgst dafür, dass zugesagte Termine gehalten werden.
  • Du sorgst für planbare Lieferfähigkeit: Du etablierst klare Prozesse für Planung, Entwicklung, Testing und Release und machst den Fortschritt für alle Bereiche im Unternehmen sichtbar.
  • Du baust eine belastbare Datenbasis auf: Du bringst unsere Kennzahlen zu Leads, Terminen und Aufträgen in eine Form, der Sales, Marketing und Geschäftsführung vertrauen können.
  • Du verantwortest Stabilität, Security und Skalierbarkeit unserer Plattform – von Monitoring und Incident-Management über Backups und Zugriffsrechte bis zu DSGVO-Themen.
  • Du bleibst technisch nah dran: Du bewertest Architekturentscheidungen, liest Code-Reviews mit und kannst im Zweifel selbst in den Code schauen – auch wenn du nicht mehr die Mehrheit deiner Zeit dort verbringst.
  • Du steuerst technische Schulden aktiv: Du machst sie sichtbar, bewertest sie wirtschaftlich und verhandelst mit den Fachbereichen, wann wir sie abbauen.
  • Du bist der Ansprechpartner der Fachbereiche für alle technischen Themen und übersetzt zwischen Business-Anforderung und technischer Umsetzung.
  • Du steuerst externe Dienstleister und Tools, inklusive Auswahl, Verträgen und Budgetverantwortung für den IT-Bereich.

Dank deiner Expertise erreichst du folgende Meilensteine bei uns

  • 0-3 Monate:

    • Du kennst Team, Systemlandschaft, Roadmap und die wichtigsten Stakeholder und hast mit jedem Teammitglied ein 1:1 geführt
    • Du hast eine schriftliche Bestandsaufnahme erstellt: größte Risiken in Stabilität und Security, größte Engpässe in der Lieferfähigkeit, Zustand unserer Datenbasis
    • Du hast die 1:1s, die operative Priorisierung und die täglichen Eskalationen vollständig vom CTO übernommen
    • Gemeinsam mit dem CTO ist schriftlich festgehalten, welche Entscheidungen bei dir liegen und welche bei ihm

  • 4-6 Monate:

    • Fachbereiche wissen jederzeit, woran gearbeitet wird
    • Monitoring, Alerting und ein Incident-Prozess inklusive Post-Mortems sind etabliert; kritische Security- und DSGVO-Lücken aus der Bestandsaufnahme sind geschlossen
    • Eine erste verlässliche Version unseres Kennzahlen-Reportings zu Leads, Terminen und Aufträgen ist live – mit klar definierten Metriken und benannten Ownern
    • Der CTO wird nur noch bei strategischen Fragen eingebunden, nicht mehr im Tagesgeschäft

  • 7-12 Monate:

    • Die Lieferfähigkeit ist messbar besser als bei deinem Start (z. B. kürzere Durchlaufzeiten, höhere Release-Frequenz, weniger Fehler in Produktion)
    • Ein Plan zum Abbau technischer Schulden läuft und ist mit den Fachbereichen abgestimmt
    • Das Team ist entsprechend der Wachstumsplanung aufgestockt und strukturiert; du hast selbst eingestellt und Verantwortung im Team weiterverteilt
    • Die Plattform trägt das geplante Wachstum ohne Stabilitätsprobleme, und die Datenbasis ist im Unternehmen die anerkannte Wahrheit

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Führung von Tech-Teams (ab ca. 3 Personen) – als Head of Engineering, Engineering Manager, Teamlead, Head of IT oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle
  • Einen soliden technischen Hintergrund als Entwicklerin oder Entwickler (idealerweise 5+ Jahre) – du hast selbst gebaut, was du heute verantwortest
  • Verantwortung über mehrere Disziplinenhinweg: Du hast nicht nur Entwicklung geführt, sondern auch mit Daten und/oder Infrastruktur zu tun gehabt
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Infrastruktur (AWS, GCP oder Azure), CI/CD und modernen Web- und Plattform-Architekturen
  • Ein sicheres Gefühl für Priorisierung: Du kannst begründet Nein sagen und hältst auch dann Kurs, wenn mehrere Bereiche gleichzeitig etwas von dir wollen
  • Erfahrung darin, Prozesse einzuführen, die tatsächlich gelebt werden – ohne das Team in Bürokratie zu ersticken
  • Ein datengetriebener Arbeitsstil: Du misst, bevor du entscheidest, und machst Ergebnisse für andere nachvollziehbar
  • Kommunikationsstärke Richtung Nicht-Techniker: Du kannst Sales, Marketing und Geschäftsführung erklären, warum etwas dauert – so, dass es verstanden und akzeptiert wird
  • Eigenverantwortung und Umsetzungsstärke: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, sondern erkennst selbst, was zu tun ist
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld (Start-up, Scale-up oder Agentur) ist ein klarer Pluspunkt
  • Erfahrung mit Lead-Generierung, Performance Marketing oder B2B-SaaS ist ein Bonus, aber keine Voraussetzung

Was uns wichtig ist

  • Diese Stelle kann zu 100 % im Home Office erledigt werden. Für Team-Events und Quartalsplanung freuen wir uns über ca. 1–2 Präsenztage pro Quartal in unserem Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt (Reisekosten übernehmen wir).
  • Du berichtest direkt an den CTO und bist Teil des erweiterten Führungskreises.
  • Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitstelle in unbefristeter Anstellung.
  • Diese Rolle ist bewusst breit angelegt: Product, Daten, Software und Infrastruktur laufen bei dir zusammen.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Ein dynamisches Marketing- und Tech-Umfeld sowie die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam “The Lead Company” aufzubauen.
  • Ein riesiger Markt und zahlreiche interne Wachstumsmöglichkeiten – wir lösen das größte Problem unserer Partner: die Automatisierung ihrer Neukundengewinnung.
  • Volle Flexibilität im Arbeitsort (remote, im Bremer Headquarter oder nach Absprache auch aus dem Ausland).
  • Volle Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeit – du gestaltest deine Arbeitszeiten individuell mit deinem Team.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr + die Möglichkeit, jederzeit unbezahlten Urlaub zu nehmen.
  • Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (die “Interlead‑Rente”).
  • Jährliche Teamevents wie Sommerfest & Weihnachtsfeier.
  • Agiles Arbeitsumfeld – moderne Tools wie Slack, Monday, Notion, Google Workspace und OKRs/Scrum unterstützen dich bei der täglichen Arbeit.
  • Zuschuss fürs Fitnessstudio (über Urban Sports Club oder E‑Gym Wellpass).
  • Schnelle Entscheidungen – wir sind 100 % bootstrapped, profitabel und unabhängig von Investoren.
  • Eine offene Feedback‑Kultur und regelmäßige interne Trainings.
  • Transparente Kommunikation durch monatliche All‑Hands‑Meetings, wöchentlichen Newsletter und feste Team‑Updates.
  • Im Headquarter in der Bremer Überseestadt erwarten dich ergonomische Arbeitsplätze, großartiger Kaffee & Espresso, Getränke und Grillabende.
  • Für Home‑Office‑Mitarbeitende: monatliche Home‑Office‑Pauschale von 20 €.
  • Bikeleasing, lease dein Wunschfahrrad oder E-Bike zu attraktiven Konditionen.

Das sind unsere Werte

  • Fail Fast: Wir leben eine ausgeprägte Testing- und Fehlerkultur. Wir sind pragmatisch, mutig und fühlen uns mit Veränderung wohl.
  • Ergebnisse: Wir arbeiten flexibel, aber verlässlich. Bei uns steht Freiheit in Einklang mit Ergebnisorientierung und Eigenverantwortung.
  • Vertrauen: Wir gehen offen mit Zahlen, Stärken und Schwächen um und machen das, was für die Firma richtig ist ("Ego zurück").

About the Role

Are you an experienced infrastructure engineer ready to work across stable, enterprise-grade environments while supporting a diverse MSP customer base? As a Senior Infrastructure Service Desk Engineer, you will support and maintain core infrastructure platforms across servers, virtualisation, networking, storage, backup, and hybrid environments.

You will play a key role in maintaining secure, resilient customer infrastructure while contributing to service improvement, reliability, and effective incident resolution. The role combines strong foundational infrastructure expertise with exposure to Microsoft 365 and hybrid technologies.

About the Client

You will be working with a high-performing technology services partner that delivers secure, resilient infrastructure solutions to a diverse managed services customer base across on-premises and hybrid environments.

Ideal Profile

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering or advanced service desk roles, ideally within an MSP environment.

  • Strong hands-on experience supporting on-premises infrastructure.

  • Proven capability across server, networking, and virtualisation technologies.

  • Experience supporting multiple customers and varied infrastructure environments is highly desirable.

Technical Capability

  • Windows Server administration, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy.

  • VMware and Hyper-V virtualisation.

  • Backup and recovery platforms such as Veeam, Commvault, Cove, or similar.

  • Networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, VPNs, firewalls, switching, and routing.

  • Microsoft 365 administration across Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint.

  • Basic Azure exposure, particularly in hybrid environments.

  • PowerShell scripting for administration and automation.

Desirable

  • Experience with security tooling, endpoint protection, and vulnerability management.

  • Experience supporting hybrid Microsoft environments.

  • Familiarity with RMM and PSA platforms such as N-central and Autotask.

  • SharePoint administration experience.

  • Hands-on data centre experience, including hardware support, racking/stacking, and physical infrastructure management.

  • Understanding of ITIL processes and service delivery frameworks.

Qualifications & Certifications

  • Degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

  • Microsoft or relevant vendor certifications are highly regarded.

  • ITIL Foundation is desirable.

Responsibilities

Core Infrastructure & Platform Operations

  • Provide advanced support across primarily on-premises and hybrid customer infrastructure environments.

  • Administer Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, IIS, and file/print services.

  • Support on-premises and hybrid Microsoft Exchange environments.

  • Provision, administer, monitor, and troubleshoot virtual servers across VMware, Hyper-V, and other applicable hypervisors.

  • Perform OS administration, including patching, performance tuning, and capacity management.

  • Support Linux servers across mixed environments where required.

Networking & Infrastructure Services

  • Support switching, routing, firewalls, and VPN connectivity.

  • Troubleshoot LAN/WAN connectivity issues.

  • Maintain the availability and performance of core infrastructure services.

Storage, Backup & Disaster Recovery

  • Administer and maintain backup platforms such as Veeam, Rubrik, Cove, and Commvault.

  • Monitor backup jobs, investigate failures, and maintain recovery capability.

  • Support disaster recovery planning and testing.

  • Maintain applicable SAN/NAS storage platforms.

MSA-Aligned Services & Platforms

  • Support managed services technologies including RMM, PSA, backup, recovery, security, and Microsoft 365 platforms.

  • Administer and support SharePoint, including permissions, access, and document management structures.

  • Ensure service delivery aligns with customer MSAs, SLAs, and operational standards.

Incident, Problem & Change Management

  • Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues across servers, networking, storage, and virtualisation.

  • Participate in major incident response and resolution.

  • Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventative measures.

  • Operate within ITIL-aligned incident, request, and change management processes.

Security & Systems Reliability

  • Apply system hardening, patching, and infrastructure security best practices.

  • Support vulnerability remediation and security improvement initiatives.

  • Maintain least-privilege access across infrastructure systems.

  • Assist with compliance against internal and customer security standards.

Hybrid & Cloud

  • Support Microsoft 365 and Azure environments where they integrate with core infrastructure.

  • Assist with migrations and hybrid configurations.

  • Support identity integration between on-premises Active Directory and cloud services.

How we take care of our team

💰 Get paid in Australian Dollars

🏥 Medical insurance from day one for you + spouse (or parents if unmarried)
🩺 Generous OPD coverage from doctor visits to all your medical needs
🏡 Home office setup allowance to build your ideal workspace
🌐 Internet allowance to keep you connected
💪 Gym & wellness allowance to stay fit and balanced
🎉 Work hard, play hard – regular team events & engagement activities
🧠 Diji Assist – Mental health & counseling support when you need it
📚 We invest in you – reimbursement for industry certifications
🗣️ Open-door culture – your ideas and feedback always matter
🌍 Flexible work – home or office, wherever you do your best work
🏆 Rewards & recognition that actually recognize you
🥳 Great christmas & financial year-end parties to unwind with your loved ones

The Opportunity

Solo practitioners and small law firms still lose work the same way: missed calls, slow callbacks, and intake handled between hearings. Hiring is no answer — payroll, training, and turnover are exactly what these firms cannot absorb.

Problem and solution validation are complete. Multiple live pilots are entering production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, and scalability. The teams that ship credible AI workers into trust-sensitive verticals in the next 18 months will define the category. We intend to be one of them.

The Venture

BloomLex is a managed AI staffing platform that delivers AI workers as fully-set-up hires — trained, monitored, and continuously improved by our team. Rather than another self-serve SaaS tool, BloomLex operates as a Role-as-a-Service business: lawyers evaluate us on outcomes — time saved, calls answered, consults booked — not configuration effort.

Our first hire, Ava, is an AI Front Desk that answers calls 24/7, captures structured intake, books consultations, and performs outbound callbacks, without creating new operational burden for the lawyer. The roadmap expands from the front desk into adjacent AI staff roles, all delivered through the same managed model.

The Partnership

The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, and live pilots are running. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder — a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership stake.

This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.

What you'll own

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will write the first lines of production code, set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

  • Architecture & Reliability — Harden Ava's voice and workflow systems for in-production reliability. Establish core architecture, observability, and audit-trail standards
  • RaaS Delivery Layer — Build the internal infrastructure that lets the team configure, monitor, and optimize AI performance without scaling engineering headcount
  • Unit Economics — Own the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call, and lock in unit economics within the $499/month pricing model
  • Customer & Market — Represent the company in front of lawyers, partners, and investors as the technical voice of the venture
  • Roadmap — Convert pilots into paying customers, expand the AI staff beyond the front desk, and begin a path toward custom and self-hosted models where legal and privacy requirements demand it
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding engineering team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Shipped LLM-powered and voice systems into production environments where incorrect outputs carried real consequences
  • Full-stack confidence across applied LLMs, real-time voice and conversational AI, telephony, human-in-the-loop workflows, observability, and secure multi-tenant SaaS
  • Well-formed convictions about reliability engineering, edge-case management, and the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call
  • Experience building managed and service-heavy platforms, with the discipline to scale delivery without scaling engineering headcount
  • Prepared to operate as a principal — including saying "this won't scale" or "this isn't ready" when the integrity of the product requires it
  • Strongly preferred: prior founder or early-stage technical leadership experience; background in legal tech, healthcare, or another trust-sensitive vertical; capability to self-host custom models to meet legal and privacy needs

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Principal Architect - Cloud Native

Job Location: Work at Home, Illinois, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary

We're hiring a Principal Architect to take ownership of how we do observability and hybrid cloud at CVS Health. This person will sit within our Enterprise Architecture organization and be responsible for the architecture, standards, and technical direction behind our observability platforms and our multi-cloud infrastructure posture.

We run workloads across on-prem private cloud (OpenShift, KVM, Dell PowerFlex), Azure, AWS, and GCP. We need someone who can build and maintain the reference architectures, telemetry standards, and instrumentation patterns that let our engineering teams monitor all of that consistently. We've committed to an OpenTelemetry-first approach and use the Grafana stack (Mimir, Loki, Tempo) as our primary backends, but we also operate Datadog, Splunk, and Dynatrace in various parts of the org.

On the cloud side, there is real work to do around workload identity, runtime selection, autoscaling guidance, and FinOps. Teams are asking for concrete standards they can follow.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write architecture docs, build proof-of-concepts, configure OTel pipelines, and present to leadership.

*This position can work remotely from anywhere in the continental USA.

Responsibilities

Observability

  • Own the enterprise observability reference architecture covering metrics, logs, traces, and events across all environments (cloud and on-prem).
  • Drive the OpenTelemetry-first instrumentation strategy -- standard libraries, semantic conventions, collector topologies (DaemonSet, gateway, sidecar), and pipeline design.
  • Build and operate telemetry pipelines on Grafana Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, including multi-tenant configurations, retention policies, and capacity planning.
  • Define how we measure reliability: SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, and alerting frameworks -- consistently across all lines of business.
  • Own the integration between observability tooling and incident management (ServiceNow ITOM, xMatters).

Drive telemetry schema standards to ensure teams emit data that is useful downstream, not just technically compliant.

Hybrid Multi-Cloud

  • Build and maintain reference architectures for our hybrid footprint: OpenShift on-prem with KVM/libvirt and Dell PowerFlex storage, plus Azure, AWS, and GCP.
  • Lead standards work around workload identity and federation using SPIFFE/SPIRE and cloud-native IAM patterns to move away from static secrets.
  • Provide guidance on compute runtime selection -- containers vs. VMs vs. bare metal vs. serverless -- with a clear decision framework for teams.
  • Help teams connect autoscaling and capacity planning behavior to actual telemetry signals.

Push FinOps maturity forward by integrating cost data into the observability stack, establishing unit economics, and working toward open billing standards like FOCUS.

AI + Observability

  • Identify where AI/ML adds practical value in our observability stack -- anomaly detection, root cause analysis, log clustering, and smarter alerting.
  • Define observability standards for AI-powered systems (agents, RAG pipelines) -- covering latency, token costs, model drift, and related signals.

Ensure new AI-powered platforms are instrumented correctly from day one.

Architecture Community

  • Participate in cross-functional architecture working groups focused on observability and hybrid cloud standards.
  • Publish architecture decision records and reference implementations that teams can actually use.
  • Mentor architects and platform engineers; conduct architecture reviews to raise the bar across the org.
  • Work with security and compliance on HIPAA, SOX, and PCI requirements as they apply to telemetry and cloud infrastructure.

Represent CVS Health in vendor evaluations and stay connected to the open-source ecosystem (CNCF, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Labs).

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in infrastructure, cloud architecture, platform engineering, or SRE
  • 8+ years of architecture work in observability, cloud infrastructure, or both at a large enterprise

At Sollit we're looking for a Marketing Specialist to join our team.

About the job

We’re looking for a Marketing Specialist who has seen robust growth before and knows what it takes to get there again. Even more importantly, they want to go on such a rewarding journey and leave their finger prints over it.

This is not a “manage the status quo” role. You’ll take ownership of marketing at Sollit and push it to the next level. You’ll work directly with the CEO, be deeply connected to sales, and combine strategy + execution every day. No large teams, no layers, just impact.

On Monday, you might be at an event talking to existing clients and new prospects for the Netherlands. While on Tuesday, you are working with your colleagues from Spain on how to scale our community in the coming year. Wednesday morning starts with a client visit and a discussion of recent news articles about oil prices and how renewable energies are essential moving forward. Well, this got your creativity in overdrive and by Thursday, you have a small campaign written out. On Friday, you will talk with partners about your idea and have a webinar scheduled for next week. Friday afternoon, you wrap up the week, analyze the data provided by an external agency, and right before you go enjoy some well-deserved rest, you get a call from the client you spoke to on Wednesday, thanking you for the great collaboration.

What You’ll Own

Scaling demand generation

  • Take what’s already working and scale it (content, events, campaigns).

  • Build new growth channels from scratch.

  • Improve lead quality, volume, and conversion together with sales.

    Finding what’s next

    • Identify new opportunities in the Dutch market.

    • Experiment fast: test, learn, double down. You have an out-of-the-box idea, be sure to try it out quickly.

    • Bring structure to growth instead of random initiatives, including measurable results.

      Building an international brand

      • Help position Sollit beyond the Netherlands (Belgium, Germany and Spain).

      • Translate local success into scalable messaging.

      • Improve the foundation for international marketing to ensure cross-country successes and learnings.

        Running marketing end-to-end

        • Own campaigns, content, website, and funnel performance.

        • Work with external partners (agencies, freelancers).

        • Keep things moving without needing a big team, but you also do not have to do it alone.

          About you

          • Worked in a B2B SaaS or tech company that scaled (and saw what changed along the way).

          • Owned or heavily contributed to demand generation and growth.

          • Been in a role where you had to figure things out, not just execute a playbook.

          • Bonus: Experience working with HubSpot. You have worked in the industry before.

            You are:

            • Hands-on: you execute, not just plan.

            • Commercially sharp: you understand clients, not just the pipeline or the number of leads. Especially in our sectors, a good understanding of the clients is essential to make a difference.

            • Structured in chaos: you bring clarity where things are still evolving.

            • Passionate about renewable energy (you don’t need to know it yet, but you’re willing to learn fast and you enjoy the topics).

            • Fluent communication in German. Dutch is a plus.

              Apply for the job

              Do you want to join our team as our new Marketing Specialist? Then we'd love to hear about you!

jobs.title: Client Account Operations Specialist
jobs.excerpt: OverviewNV5 is a provider of engineering and consulting services to public- and private-sector clients.
jobs.description:
Overview

NV5 is a provider of engineering and consulting services to public- and private-sector clients. Through its Real Estate Transaction Services group, GRS, NV5 supports commercial real estate transactions with services that include land surveying, zoning, environmental site assessments, property condition assessments, seismic risk assessments, and construction-related due diligence.

NV5 is seeking a Client Account Operations Specialist to support our group's high-volume project portfolio. Embedded within team operations, this role becomes engaged once an invoice is issued and is responsible for its administrative tracking and client communication through payment collection. The specialist works directly with clients, sales representatives, project managers, service coordinators, leadership, and NV5 corporate accounting to confirm payment status, remove barriers, document commitments, and drive timely resolution. A key responsibility is maintaining accurate documentation and actionable reporting that demonstrates progress, supports effective follow-up, and helps prevent outstanding invoices from becoming increasingly aged.

This client-facing business operations role offers an opportunity to strengthen client relationships, improve account visibility, and help establish a consistent account management process. Success in this position requires professional persistence, sound judgment, disciplined documentation practices, and the ability to identify the root causes of payment delays while coordinating the appropriate response to achieve resolution.

The ideal candidate will be located on the Central to East Coast!

Responsibilities

Client Account Ownership

  • Own the structured tracking and follow-up process for invoices from issuance through payment, with activity aligned to client payment terms and internal protocols.
  • Contact clients to confirm receipt, processing status, expected payment timing, and any requirements preventing payment.
  • Proactively develop relationships with AP leads at key clients to understand their payment cycles and set efficient means to update the AR status during monthly calls.
  • Manage a high-volume portfolio by prioritizing activity based on invoice age, dollar value, client history, transaction status, and business risk.
  • Document all communications, client commitments, disputed items, internal owners, escalation actions, and next steps in designated NV5 systems.
  • Provide responsive, professional client service while maintaining clear expectations and consistent follow-through.

Project and Invoice Issue Resolution

  • Research outstanding invoices to identify whether delays relate to invoice receipt, client portals, purchase orders, vendor registration, documentation, contract terms, project delivery, transaction status, scope questions, or service concerns.
  • Coordinate with GRS project managers and service-line leaders to resolve questions involving surveys, zoning reports, environmental assessments, property condition assessments, seismic risk assessments, and construction services.
  • Confirm that invoices align with the correct project, property, client entity, fee, and applicable supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate resolution of portfolio billing requirements, report acceptance questions, reliance documentation, client-specific forms, and other transaction-related barriers.
  • Assign or confirm internal ownership of each open issue, establish a follow-up date, and escalate unresolved or high-risk matters through established protocols.
  • Prepare complete account histories and supporting information for leadership and corporate accounting decisions; route adjustments, credits, contractual concerns, and write-off requests to the authorized decision-makers.

Reporting, Controls, and Process Improvement

  • Prepare weekly aging and resolution reporting for GRS leadership, emphasizing changes, risks, commitments, and accounts requiring intervention.
  • Support recurring GRS account-review meetings with project managers, operational leaders, and NV5 corporate accounting.
  • Track recurring delay reasons by client, project manager, service line, and issue category to identify preventable causes.
  • Recommend improvements to project setup, client-contact data, invoice documentation, portal requirements, handoffs, and escalation procedures.
  • Help establish and maintain standard operating procedures, contact cadences, reporting definitions, and documentation expectations for the GRS client-account process.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the operational link among Clients, Project Teams, Service-line Leadership, and NV5 corporate accounting.
  • Coordinate with corporate accounting to access the records and supporting information needed to research and resolve client account issues.
  • Communicate emerging Client or portfolio risks to Leadership promptly and with sufficient supporting information for action.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in client account support, project administration, billing operations, contract administration, or a comparable high-volume professional-services environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a large portfolio of open items with accurate documentation, prioritization, and consistent follow-through.
  • Experience communicating directly with business clients regarding invoices, documentation requirements, account questions, or payment status.
  • Strong research and problem-solving skills, including the ability to distinguish administrative issues from substantive project or client concerns.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Suite, including but not limited to Excel, Outlook, Teams, and business systems used to manage project or financial information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to handle sensitive conversations professionally.
  • Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, exercise sound judgment, and collaborate effectively across organizational functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate or bachelor's degree in business administration, operations, accounting, finance, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
  • Experience in commercial real estate due diligence, engineering, environmental consulting, land surveying, construction services, or another project-based professional-services business.
  • Experience with Deltek Vantagepoint, Deltek Vision, or a comparable enterprise resource planning or project accounting system.
  • Experience developing reports, operating procedures, process controls, or workflow improvements.

Measures of Success

  • Assigned invoices are tracked from issuance and receive timely, documented follow-up under the established contact cadence.
  • Fewer balances migrate into older aging categories, particularly from 31-60 days into 61-90 days and beyond.
  • Client payment commitments, open issues, internal owners, and next actions are complete and current.
  • Invoice and project issues are identified early, routed correctly, and resolved within defined timeframes.
  • Weekly reporting is accurate, actionable, and reliable for management decision-making.
  • Recurring causes of delayed payment are identified and translated into practical process improvements.

The pay range for this remote position is $32.00-35.00 per hour. Base pay offered may be higher or lower depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location of the candidate. Restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered.

All local employment laws apply. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via the NV5 careers site.

NV5 offers a competitive compensation and benefits package including medical, dental, life insurance, PTO, 401(k) and professional development/advancement opportunities.

NV5 provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. NV5 complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Le contrat est prévu jusqu’à la fin mars 2027. Pour ce projet spécifique, nous considérons principalement les candidatures de personnes basées en Amérique du Nord ou en Europe.

L’artiste d’effets conçoit et réalise des simulations visuelles complexes, feu, fumée, fluides, destructions, effets abstraits, dans le respect des standards artistiques et techniques de Rodeo FX. Intégré.e au cœur du pipeline 3D, il.elle collabore étroitement avec la supervision FX, CG et les autres départements pour livrer des plans photoréalistes, dynamiques et techniquement solides. Sa créativité, sa rigueur et sa maîtrise des outils procéduraux permettent de traduire les intentions visuelles du projet avec efficacité.

Principales responsabilités :

Maîtrise de son métier

  • Produire des simulations complexes (fumée, feu, explosions, liquides, destructions, effets magiques ou abstraits) en respectant les directives artistiques et techniques.
  • Utiliser Houdini avec efficacité (Pyro, Flip, RBD, Vellum, SOPs) pour générer des effets optimisés et adaptables.
  • Maintenir un haut niveau d’autonomie dans la gestion des tâches FX confiées, du setup initial jusqu’au rendu final.
  • Assurer un contrôle qualité rigoureux de ses fichiers, caches et workfiles avant toute soumission.

Qualité créative

  • Proposer des solutions artistiques simples, efficaces et alignées avec la vision du projet.
  • Participer activement aux dailies et intégrer les rétroactions de manière constructive.
  • Adapter les effets aux besoins narratifs, au style visuel et au rythme de la scène.
  • Améliorer les prises de vue en apportant une valeur ajoutée créative aux simulations.

Qualité technique

  • Assurer l’optimisation des caches, la stabilité des setups et le respect des conventions techniques internes.
  • Identifier rapidement les problèmes techniques et y apporter des solutions fonctionnelles.
  • Collaborer avec l’équipe Pipeline pour intégrer ou tester de nouveaux outils selon les besoins du projet.
  • Vérifier la compatibilité des effets avec les autres départements (layout, lighting, comp).

Communication

  • Fournir des estimations réalistes, communiquer rapidement en cas de difficulté ou de risque de retard, et collaborer avec la production à l’ajustement des priorités si nécessaire.
  • Maintenir un échange fluide et respectueux avec la production, les leads et les artistes des autres disciplines.
  • Communiquer avec clarté sur les enjeux, délais, besoins ou limitations techniques.
  • Participer activement aux turnovers, briefings ou suivis d’avancement avec l’équipe projet.

Apprendre, transmettre et évoluer

  • Rester à l’affût des dernières pratiques, techniques et références en effets visuels.
  • Partager ses connaissances, outils ou techniques avec ses collègues.
  • Participer à la documentation ou à l’amélioration des méthodes de travail du département FX.
  • Accueillir les rétroactions avec ouverture dans une perspective de progression continue.
  • Expérience préalable en FX dans un studio VFX (10 ans minimum recommandé).
  • Excellente maîtrise de Houdini (Pyro, Flip, RBD, Vellum, SOPs).
  • Connaissances de base en compositing (Nuke) et en rendu (Arnold et Karma).
  • Connaissance en USD et Solaris.
  • Bon sens du mouvement, de la physique et du rythme visuel.
  • Rigueur, autonomie, souci du détail, esprit d’équipe.
  • Atout : connaissance de Flow Production Tracking, expérience en développement d’outils Houdini, scripts Python ou VEX.

Nous recherchons actuellement des artistes disponibles pour rejoindre l’équipe dans les prochaines semaines, avec une solide expertise en effets visuels photoréalistes haut de gamme. Le contrat est prévu jusqu’à la fin mars 2027. Pour ce projet spécifique, nous considérons principalement les candidatures de personnes basées en Amérique du Nord ou en Europe.

Diversité, équité et inclusion

Chez Rodeo FX, la diversité est une valeur fondamentale. Nous nous engageons à créer un milieu de travail inclusif et équitable, où les différentes perspectives sont valorisées. Chaque membre de notre équipe apporte un point de vue unique qui enrichit notre créativité, remet en question nos façons de penser et nous aide à produire un travail de meilleure qualité.

Utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle dans le recrutement

Rodeo FX peut utiliser des outils basés sur l’intelligence artificielle (IA) pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus de recrutement, notamment la transcription d’entrevues ou l’analyse préliminaire des candidatures. Ces outils peuvent être exploités par des fournisseurs tiers et certaines données peuvent être traitées à l’extérieur du Québec. Ces outils ne remplacent jamais la prise de décision humaine : toutes les décisions finales d’embauche sont prises par notre équipe de recrutement et nos gestionnaires d’embauche. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous protégeons vos renseignements personnels et sur vos droits, veuillez consulter notre Politique de confidentialité.

Postuler avec LinkedIn

Si vous souhaitez utiliser la fonctionnalité « Postuler avec LinkedIn » afin de simplifier votre candidature, veuillez vous assurer d’accepter les cookies sur la page de candidature SmartRecruiters. Cela permet à la fonctionnalité de s’afficher et de fonctionner correctement.

Élue à plusieurs reprises l'un des meilleurs employeurs de Montréal et récipient du prix Mercuriades 2022 pour Employeur de l'année - Grande Entreprise, Rodeo FX est une compagnie créative haut de gamme de plus de 15 ans offrant des services d'effets visuels, d’animation et de publicité et d'expérience.

Nominée pour plusieurs Emmy® Awards pour son travail sur les séries Stranger Things saison 4, The Witcher saison 2 et The Lord of The Rings : The Rings of Power saison 1, l'entreprise indépendante lauréate d'un Oscar® compte près de 900 artistes qui travaillent dans des studios situés à Montréal, Québec, Toronto, Los Angeles et Paris.

Rodeo FX est un partenaire créatif des meilleurs conteurs du monde, notamment Netflix, HBO, Disney, Marvel, Amazon Studios, Warner Bros. et Sony, et a collaboré à des publicités pour YouTube, NBC et Apple. Ses projets actuels incluent Blue Beetle, Monarch : Legacy of Monsters, et Rebel Moon de Zack Snyder. Parmi les projets récemment sortis, citons John Wick : Chapter 4, Black Adam, The Little Mermaid de Disney et Love, Death and Robots Volume 3, pour lequel la société a remporté un prix VES 2023.

Location: Remote | Contract / Fractional

The Opportunity

Code3 is looking for an experienced, well-connected recruiter to help us identify and engage exceptional talent as our hiring needs evolve.

This isn't a traditional full-time recruiting role. We're looking for a fractional recruiting partner who loves the hunt: someone who knows how to map a talent market, identify great people who may not be actively looking, and create enough interest to start a conversation.

You'll work closely with Code3's People team and hiring leaders across the agency, with a particular focus on proactively sourcing talent for priority roles.

What You'll Do

  • Proactively source and engage high-quality candidates for open and anticipated roles
  • Build targeted talent maps and pipelines across digital media, commerce, creative, analytics, strategy, client leadership and agency operations
  • Identify passive candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networks, referrals, industry relationships and creative sourcing strategies
  • Develop a strong understanding of Code3, our culture and what distinguishes exceptional talent here
  • Conduct initial candidate outreach and, as appropriate, introductory conversations
  • Provide hiring leaders with market intelligence on talent availability, compensation and competitive dynamics
  • Maintain organized candidate pipelines and ensure promising relationships don't disappear when an immediate opening isn't available
  • Partner with our People team and hiring managers to continually sharpen candidate profiles based on what we're learning in the market

What We're Looking For

You are an experienced recruiter or talent sourcer who is particularly strong at finding people, not simply processing applicants.

Ideally, you have:

  • Significant recruiting or talent-sourcing experience, preferably within advertising, digital marketing, media, ecommerce, technology or adjacent industries
  • A strong network and understanding of the digital agency talent marketplace
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and engage passive candidates
  • Excellent judgment about talent—you can quickly distinguish a good résumé from someone who could genuinely make Code3 better
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to represent Code3 credibly in the marketplace
  • Comfort working independently with limited process or bureaucracy
  • A proactive, curious and persistent approach to finding great people

Agency recruiting experience is welcome, but we're especially interested in people who want to operate as an extension of Code3 rather than as a traditional external search firm.

The Engagement

This is a fractional contract role, designed for an experienced recruiter who wants flexibility while becoming a trusted recruiting partner to Code3.

We're open to structuring the engagement based on the right person's preferred model, including hourly, weekly/fractional, or performance-based compensation.

The initial engagement is expected to be approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the opportunity to expand or evolve based on Code3's hiring needs.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: About ManifestManifest is building modern software for the tours and activities industry.
jobs.description:
About Manifest

Manifest is building modern software for the tours and activities industry.

Our customers run real-world businesses: tours, attractions, experiences, rentals, and activities. They need software that helps them sell more, operate smoothly, and deliver great guest experiences.

We're building a B2B2C SaaS platform that brings booking, ecommerce, payments, accounting, operations, and customer experience together in a modern architecture. The product surface is broad, the workflows are nuanced, and the opportunity is big. That surface now spans several distinct product areas, including a newer, AI-native platform for building and delivering customer websites end-to-end. We're hiring more than one Senior Product Manager, and we'll match each hire to the area where their strengths fit best, from established features to fast-moving, zero-to-one greenfield work.

We're looking for Senior Product Managers to own product direction, roadmap, and prioritization for one or more key areas of Manifest.

This is not a backlog management role. We're looking for someone who can take ambiguous customer and business problems, find the shape of the opportunity, make smart tradeoffs, and help a cross-functional team ship high-quality product experiences.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll turn customer insight, business context, and technical possibilities into clear product direction and own the delivery end-to-end.

Modern product work is changing, and this role reflects that. We expect our PMs to be fluent and genuinely enthusiastic users of AI-assisted tools—using Claude, Cursor, v0, and similar tools to explore interactions, build lightweight prototypes, and make product ideas concrete before implementation begins. On some of our teams, AI-native workflows are not just a way of working faster; they're central to the product itself.

You'll work closely with Product leadership, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and design-minded front-end engineers. Depending on the area you own, there may not be a dedicated product designer, so you should be comfortable playing an active role in shaping user workflows, interaction patterns, and overall product quality.

You'll also be the bridge between executive vision and execution: taking high-level direction set by our leadership team and honing it into concrete, buildable product requirements. Leadership helps frame the why and the what, but you own the product decisions about what to build and how to bring it to life.

You do not need to be a front-end engineer, and you won't be expected to write production code. But strong technical fluency is a real advantage—enough to collaborate deeply with engineers on UI-heavy, technically nuanced product areas, and to understand the systems you're shaping. A technical or former engineering background is strongly preferred.

You should also be comfortable owning the delivery side of the work, along with the product vision, like milestones, sequencing, and keeping a small team moving.

What You'll Do

  • Own roadmap, prioritization, delivery, and product outcomes for one or more areas of Manifest
  • Develop a deep understanding of our customers, their businesses, and the tours and activities industry
  • Lead discovery with customers, internal stakeholders, support teams, sales, customer success, and go-to-market partners
  • Translate customer problems, business goals, and operational complexity into clear product direction
  • Define product requirements, success metrics, release scope, and tradeoffs
  • Partner closely with engineering to shape pragmatic, high-quality solutions, and help sequence and drive delivery
  • Work closely with front-end engineers on user flows, interaction details, edge cases, and product polish
  • Use AI-assisted tools, lightweight prototypes, wireframes, diagrams, and sketches to clarify product ideas and reduce ambiguity
  • Help raise the bar for UX quality, including in areas without a dedicated Product Designer
  • Create clear product artifacts: problem statements, opportunity briefs, product specs, workflow diagrams, acceptance criteria, launch plans, and release notes
  • Balance customer value, business impact, technical constraints, and delivery realities
  • Communicate product direction clearly across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and leadership
  • Collaborate with Product leadership on strategy while taking ownership of day-to-day product execution

What We're Looking For

  • Significant Product Management experience, ideally in a B2B or B2B2C SaaS environment
  • A track record of owning roadmap, prioritization, and delivery for meaningful product areas
  • Strong product judgment: you can move from ambiguous problems to coherent product direction
  • Strong written communication and the ability to create clear, actionable product specs
  • A measurement-driven approach to product, defining success metrics up front and proving the impact of changes quantitatively
  • Fluency and enthusiasm for AI-assisted product work using tools like Claude, Cursor, v0, Figma, or FigJam to prototype, explore, and communicate ideas
  • A technical background, former engineering experience, or strong technical fluency; enough to understand the product deeply and partner closely with engineers on technically nuanced, UI-heavy areas
  • Comfort owning delivery and project execution on small teams alongside product vision
  • Experience leading discovery, evaluating opportunities, and making thoughtful tradeoffs
  • Strong UX instincts and an eye for product quality, usability, workflow design, and polish
  • Familiarity with modern front-end patterns, design systems, HTML, CSS, or component-based product development
  • Experience with complex workflows, operational tools, booking flows, ecommerce, marketplaces, or other transaction-heavy SaaS products
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and bring structure to undefined problems, including in zero-to-one / startup-mode environments
  • A pragmatic, collaborative operating style

Nice to Have

  • Experience in travel, tourism, activities, hospitality, reservations, ecommerce, or booking platforms
  • Experience working on developer-adjacent products or platforms
  • Experience in a scale-up environment where product, design, and engineering responsibilities are highly collaborative
  • A track record of using AI tools to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, analysis, or specification in a real production setting
  • Experience with analytics, experimentation, funnel optimization, SEO, or conversion-focused product work

How We Work

We move quickly, but we care about craft.

Manifest serves users with complex day-to-day workflows, so product quality matters. We care about whether the product makes sense, whether the workflow is intuitive, whether the edge cases are handled thoughtfully, and whether the experience feels modern and trustworthy.

We value product managers who are curious, direct, clear-thinking, and outcome-oriented. We are not looking for someone who simply collects requirements or manages tickets. We're looking for someone who can understand customer problems, shape direction, make tradeoffs, and partner with Engineering from ambiguity through delivery and iteration.


The salary range for this position is $130,000 - $170,000 CAD, commensurate with experience.
