Job Description

IQVIA Biotech has an exciting position within its EU Biostats team. As the Biotech and Emerging Biopharma arm of IQVIA, we continue to grow and win new business. Historically IQVIA Biotech focused on Oncology, Dermatology and Medical Device studies but with the addition of CNS, Immunology and Cardiovascular we have a need for a strong Lead Statistician.

We're looking for enthusiastic and independent professionals with great communication skills who are willing to work from home with an international team. This is the perfect opportunity to join an established department and develop leadership skills.

IQVIA Biotech specialises in working with smaller biotech and emerging biopharma clients and as such we have a vibrant, fast-paced work environment. You'll be working with a lot of the new innovative and upcoming research groups across a variety of therapy areas.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive oncology drug development experience across a broad range of oncology indications, with demonstrated expertise in applying advanced statistical methodologies throughout the clinical development lifecycle.

They should have the technical expertise to provide senior-level statistical review and oversight of Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs), ADaM specifications and datasets, Tables, Listings, and Figures (TLFs), and other key study deliverables, ensuring scientific rigor, quality, and consistency across programs.

The candidate will be an effective people leader with a proven ability to mentor, develop, and support biostatistical staff across global regions, including Europe and JPAC.

Strong customer engagement and relationship management skills are essential, including the ability to serve as a trusted statistical advisor to emerging biopharma customers who may have limited experience with clinical development, regulatory requirements, and statistical considerations.

The successful candidate will also have experience supporting regulatory submissions and interacting with regulatory agencies. Experience participating in and leading bid defense meetings is expected, along with the ability to coach and develop future Statistical Team Leads by strengthening their customer-facing, business development, and presentation skills.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS, DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborate with internal program staff and sponsors on the implementation and analysis of statistical aspects of research protocols.
  • Provide statistical consultation for clinical programs, including but not limited to protocol development, randomization, sample size assessments, efficacy evaluations, and data review.
  • Define and manage project timelines for specific projects, and ensure that project timelines are met for both internal and external clients.
  • Ensure that project tasks are completed with superior quality for both internal and external clients.
  • Review, approve and develop, as needed, the statistical analysis summary and analysis plans, including textual description of planned analysis and mock-ups of data displays.
  • Oversee and/or perform statistical analyses, including hypothesis testing and modeling.
  • Interact with Medical Writers to ensure appropriateness of data inferences and/or write pertinent sections of a clinical study report.
  • Interface with clients and/or regulatory agencies as the project biostatistician.
  • Ability to oversee a program of studies.
  • Assist the Manager and Sr. Director in defining and maintaining departmental standards, SOPs and working practices.
  • Provide leadership, mentoring and statistical support for Biostatistics staff.
  • Assist the Manager and Sr. Director in development of training materials and execution of training in Biostatistics and general Clinical Reporting activities, for new and existing Clinical Reporting staff.
  • Make presentations to clients and other interested individuals about the processes and procedures of the Clinical Reporting department.
  • Assist the Manager in the coordination of project tasks and resources across the Biostatistics group, and act as backup during the Manager's absence, as assigned.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Understanding of GCP, ICH, and FDA guidelines and regulations applicable to conduct clinical research.
  • Advanced knowledge of statistical methods used in the design and analysis of Phase I-IV clinical trials.
  • Experience with SAS Base and SAS Stat.
  • Experience with other statistical software packages, such as N-Query, S-Plus.
  • Ability to work creatively and independently to carry out assignments of a complex nature.
  • Must be skilled in effective time management.
  • Ability to work effectively and cooperatively with other professional staff members.
  • Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with all levels of staff and with the public.

MINIMUM RECRUITMENT STANDARDS:

  • Masters-level degree in Statistics, Biostatistics or related field with eight years relevant CRO industry or biotech experience; or

  • Doctorate-level degree in Statistics, Biostatistics or related field with six years relevant CRO industry or biotech experience.

  • Data handling and analysis experience.

  • Excellent interpersonal and organization skills.

This role is not eligible for UK visa sponsorship

We are seeking a skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will bring a builder’s instinct to a team working at the intersection of data science, infrastructure, and AI. You will help us build new capabilities and features in our product suite, including things we haven’t yet imagined possible, and you will drive those changes forward into our customers’ hands.

About you

You are an enthusiastic generalist who thrives in the face of ambiguous requirements—an engineer who is just as good at starting things as you are at finishing them. Some qualities we value most:

High agency

You are driven. When something important feels daunting or underspecified, your first instinct is to prototype to clarify the value you can deliver, rather than wait for someone to give you the answers.

Boldness in learning

You are genuinely unafraid to tackle unfamiliar subjects. You know that nobody is an expert in everything, and you don't let unfamiliarity be a reason for not trying. You're not afraid to ask questions and make mistakes, because learning new techniques feels like an adventure and we share what we learn as a team. Proficiency in either Go or Typescript as well as in either Python or R, and experience with backend systems, data tooling, and data science frameworks are helpful for this role. Eagerness and boldness to learn is essential.

User empathy and product sense

You make judgment calls on behalf of users with minimal up front guidance and are willing to be wrong, because you will learn. Prior domain expertise with data science as a practice may help, but it is not the only way. Regardless, you lead with empathy: you optimize for solving a real customer problem, not for technical purity.

Collaborative curiosity

You are generous. When you learn something useful, your first instinct is to share it. You teach as readily as you learn, ask questions without ego, admit what you don't know, and lend a hand when someone's stuck.

Interest in AI

You are interested not just in using AI in your work, but building tools for customers to use AI in their own work. You also are curious, and you question when AI is not the right answer for a particular problem. You lean on your user empathy when building: knowing that some of our customers use and love AI in data science and others don’t or are restricted from using it.

Results-driven

Within one month, you will…

jobs.description:
Experienced Sales Executive — Fraud Intelligence

Full Cycle Outbound · OEM & Complex Deals · Individual Contributor · US Market

About IPInfo

IPinfo is the market leader in delivering comprehensive and precise IP data, empowering businesses with well-defined data that enables actionable insights. Every day, we process more than 1 billion IP data points, offering an unparalleled big-picture view of the internet.

Our unique approach combines ground truth data with data from ProbeNet, our internet measurement platform, to create a detailed, real-time profile of every IP address. By contextualizing each IP with enriched metadata—covering its origin, connections, and circumstances—we provide businesses with the clarity and intelligence needed to make smarter, faster decisions.

Our data enriches applications and services with accurate IP data that can help manage security risks, improve user experiences, optimize content delivery and ensure regulatory compliance. Join a fast-paced, innovative team that’s passionate about data, technology, and customer success.

Role Overview

We are looking for a talented full-cycle hunter who identifies and pursues high-value targets in fintech and ad tech fraud detection, and owns the complete deal cycle including complex OEM agreements.

Key Responsibilities

Full cycle outbound sales

  • Own the complete sales cycle from cold outreach to close at named target accounts across fintech fraud and ad tech fraud.
  • Build and manage a list of 50+ high-value market targets with discipline — research, prioritise, sequence, and drive activity.
  • Generate pipeline at key industry conferences — MRC, Money20/20, TAG, ad:tech — through structured pre-show research, on-floor engagement, and disciplined follow-through.
  • This is a pure outbound role — backed by full marketing, product positioning, and direct management support, but you are the one driving pipeline and opening strategic accounts.

OEM & complex deal structuring

  • Structure and negotiate complex OEM commercial frameworks and embedded data agreements within fraud platforms, fintech companies, and ad tech players.
  • For each OEM opportunity, map where the customer sits in the ecosystem, how IPinfo data propagates through their platform, and what the downstream market opportunity unlocks — stay commercially ambitious while managing deal complexity with precision.

Market & ecosystem intelligence

  • Map competitive dynamics in your target verticals — who integrates with whom, who competes, where IPinfo displaces or augments the existing stack.
  • Track emerging fraud vectors and how IP intelligence signals map to them, staying ahead of buyer priorities.

Team & strategy

  • Collaborate with the Manager of Strategic Markets on account prioritisation and conference planning.
  • Collaborate with team members on account strategy and share market intelligence accross the team.

Key Qualifications

Experience

  • 4+ years of full cycle outbound sales — independently opened and closed deals without BDR support.
  • Closed $100K–$500K ACV deals; OEM or embedded data deal experience strongly preferred.
  • Consistent quota attainment across multiple years.
  • US-based or US-focused market coverage.
  • Proven conference-led pipeline generation.

Skills

  • Can structure complex OEM deals independently — comfortable with multi-stakeholder commercial negotiations.
  • Comfortable engaging technical buyers (heads of data, data engineering) and commercial buyers (heads of product, VP Fraud) in the same deal.
  • CRM proficiency and disciplined pipeline management — accurate forecasting is expected.
  • Data, API, or intelligence product background preferred; SaaS experience is acceptable.

Personality

  • Hungry and commercially ambitious — not satisfied with a managed book, wants to build something.
  • Intellectually curious: genuinely interested in how fraud ecosystems, data stacks, and market dynamics work.
  • Builds relationships over time, not just transactions — thinks in accounts and multi-year revenue.
  • Strategic — targets and wins accounts that open new revenue generating verticals as much as the ACV.
  • Dynamic — drawn to markets at an inflection point, where a better product arriving at the right moment can genuinely shift the competitive order.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary and uncapped commission structure.
  • Flexible remote working.
  • Travel budget for key industry conferences.

How to Apply

If you are a proven hunter with the commercial instinct to build in a new market and the intellectual curiosity to master it, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and a brief note on the most complex deal you have generated, structured, and closed to

About Our Culture

IPinfo, we move fast, operate with high autonomy, and reward people who take ownership. We are a lean team working at the intersection of data intelligence, fraud prevention, and cybersecurity — a space that is growing fast and where the right data product can make a fundamental difference to how platforms detect and stop fraud. If you want to have a real commercial impact and build something from scratch, this is the right environment.

A note from Augustin, Manager Strategic Markets


Hi, I’m Augustin, Manager Strategic Markets at IPinfo.

IP intelligence is foundational to how fintech and ad tech companies detect and stop fraud. It is also a market that is in the process of reconsidering its legacy data sources in favour of higher data quality. That creates a significant commercial window for IPinfo, and this team exists to move through it fast.

We will be account-focused, conference-heavy, and commercially relentless. Our mandate is to win the logos that open market verticals, build the case studies that accelerate the next wave of revenue, and influence the overall GTM strategy. It is a challenging role with high visibility and direct commercial impact on IPinfo’s market strategy.

As a senior member of the team, you will own the full cycle and be expected to operate with autonomy. The deals that matter here are complex: mapping ecosystem position, understanding data flow, and assessing downstream market reach. We need someone who manages that complexity without losing commercial momentum.

We are not prioritising industry experience. Commercial instinct and the ability to hunt are what we are hiring for. The market knowledge comes quickly for the right person. We are looking for someone who wants to compete hard, build something meaningful, and win accounts that define the trajectory.

Salary Range

[TBD] base + uncapped commission, depending on experience.

jobs.description:
After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving upmarket, and this is one of the key sales roles that proves the commercial motion as we pursue increasingly complex retail accounts.

Role Overview

As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not fully exist at Toast Retail yet. You will help build it, one deal at a time.

This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a finished playbook. Some proof points exist from our SMB business, leadership is investing, and there is a set of open questions that closers in the field have to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner? Which SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form hypotheses, test them in live deals, and feed what works back so the next AEs can run it.

You will report to the Manager, Mid Market Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations of 30% or more, including store walks and on site visits.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

  • Pipeline and prospecting: Build a qualified pipeline of multi-location grocery, liquor, and convenience operators through category research, cold calling, networking, and close partnership with our SMB Retail teams to identify accounts ready to move upmarket.
  • Retail centric discovery: Run disciplined discovery against buying committees rather than single owners. Learn the operational realities that move a category buyer, from inventory depth and scan data to shrink, margin, and compliance, and turn them into a compelling case for Toast Retail.
  • Value based selling: Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast Retail value proposition through demonstrations and tailored business cases. Sell on platform value and outcomes over price, and help operators understand which products actually fit their scale.
  • Full lifecycle ownership: Own the entire journey, from lead development and financial structuring to contract negotiation and close. Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation to ensure a seamless handoff on retail installs that are meaningfully harder than a single site.
  • Complex deal navigation: Manage lengthy sales cycles with real ambiguity. Multithread across operations, finance, IT, and merchandising, and develop champions inside layered retail organizations.
  • Internal collaboration: Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Biz Ops, and Finance to structure deals, and hold your ground in negotiations so terms align with Toast's goals. Work with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close the gaps between us and a repeatable Mid Market Retail motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself.
  • Build as you close: Convert what works in your live deals into discovery notes, demo flows, and business case models the next AEs can run. Distinguish a repeatable process from a one off hero deal, and help codify the former.
  • Voice of the retailer: Bring the Mid Market retailer's needs back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes.
  • Revenue mindset: Optimize for long term realized revenue, not just bookings. Evaluate the full financial impact of every deal, ask what it will actually cost us, and make thoughtful trade offs on pricing, discounts, and terms while protecting Toast's bottom line.
  • Operational excellence: Maintain high standards of execution, prioritization, and follow through in Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack, and help establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

  • 5+ years of successful technology or professional services sales experience, ideally within SaaS, payments, or retail or restaurant industry technology.
  • A track record sourcing and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally multi-location or upmarket.
  • Proven skills in complex deal development, financial structuring, negotiation, and closing with both new and existing customers, with a focus on selling on value rather than deep discounting.
  • Proficiency with MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification methodology, plus disciplined pipeline management and forecasting.
  • A builder's instinct. You are energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity, and when a process is missing your instinct is to write it rather than wait for it.
  • Exceptional customer engagement and active listening. You do not just pitch, you solve problems for operators.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to hold the room with executive stakeholders.
  • Comfort educating customers on the fundamentals of US credit card processing, including surcharging and processing nuances.
  • Strong organizational skills and a disciplined, process driven approach to selling, reporting, and tracking.
  • Ability to travel 30% or more.

What will help you stand out

  • Experience selling into or operating within grocery, convenience, liquor, or specialty retail.
  • Fluency in the operational realities of retail: inventory depth and SKU management, scan data, shrink, category management, age verification and compliance, fuel and foodservice.
  • Experience selling into franchised organizations, navigating both franchisor and franchisee requirements, buying processes, and stakeholder management
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to complete complex RFPs, bonus if you’ve helped write a RFP for a prospect just starting their evaluation process
  • Experience helping stand up a new segment, vertical, or motion inside an existing company, especially taking an SMB product upmarket.
  • Experience in a fast paced, high growth technology environment.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it's a core part of our culture.

About Pair Team

Pair Team is a public benefit company reimagining care for the safety net. As an AI-enabled medical group for Medicaid and Medicare, we deliver medical, behavioral, and social care by integrating shelters, pantries and other community-based organizations into our whole-person model. As California’s largest complex care provider, we’ve proven our impact to reduce avoidable emergency care, including a 52% and 26% reduction in ER visits and hospitalizations respectively. Once scaled nationally, our approach would save tax payers $150B per year.

With our years of experience and vast data collected, we are now building an AI platform that embeds social work agents across the safety net to truly unify our fragmented healthcare and welfare system. By scaling our country’s frontline medical and social services workforce, we aim to bring high-touch care to everyone.

At Pair Team, we’re not just delivering care—we’re transforming it. We’re building a future where high-touch, community-driven care is accessible to everyone, especially the most underserved.

  • Forbes: For Pair Team, Accessibility Is About Delivering Healthcare To Those Who Need It The Most
  • TechCrunch: Building for Medicaid’s regulatory moment with Neil Batlivala from Pair Team
  • Journal of General Internal Medicine: A Novel Intervention for Medicaid Beneficiaries with Complex Needs

About the Opportunity

As Director of Product Marketing, you will own how Pair Team connects its product to the people we serve. You sit at the intersection of product, growth, and the patient across our service lines and programs within Medicaid and Medicare and you own the work that turns a powerful care platform into patients who enroll, engage, and stay. You are the voice of the patient inside the company and the voice of the product in the market.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves both the craft and the evidence behind it. You will build a deep, research-backed understanding of who our patients are and what they need, translate it into sharp positioning and messaging, and turn that into the welcome, onboarding, and lifecycle experiences that drive activation and retention. You will own the message architecture that our paid media, brand, care teams, and AI care advocate all draw from, and you will raise the bar on every patient-facing touchpoint.

You will be the two-way bridge between product and patient, translating what we build into language that resonates, and carrying patient insight and friction back into the roadmap so that we build the right things. You will partner closely with Product and Growth on go-to-market for new features and service lines, with Performance Marketing and Brand & Creative on the positioning and creative that lift conversion and lower acquisition cost, and with Clinical and Operations on patient experience and satisfaction. You will protect compliance and patient trust at every step.

This is a fully remote position reporting to the SVP of Growth & Marketing.

What You’ll Do

Patient & Market Insight

  • Build a deep, continuously refreshed understanding of our patients and members across Medicaid and Medicare — who they are, what they need, and what moves them to enroll, engage, and stay.
  • Own audience segmentation and voice-of-patient research, both qualitative and quantitative, and synthesize it into clear, actionable insight the whole company can use.
  • Track the competitive and category landscape and translate it into how we position and differentiate.

Positioning, Messaging & Narrative

  • Own Pair Team’s patient-facing positioning and value propositions across service lines, and the message architecture that paid media, brand, the care team, and our AI care advocate all draw from as a single source of truth.
  • Craft messaging that resonates with real people — clear, human, and tested — and the narratives that make Pair Team easy to choose and easy to trust.
  • Develop messaging and packaging for new audiences, programs, and markets as we expand.

Patient Experience & Lifecycle Marketing

  • Own and elevate the patient journey end to end — welcome kits, onboarding, after-visit communications, and re-engagement — so more patients activate and stay engaged.
  • Design lifecycle and member-communication programs across channels, partnering with Care and Operations to make every touchpoint feel personal and supportive.
  • Treat activation and retention as products to be improved, not one-off campaigns to be run.

Product Partnership & Go-to-Market

  • Serve as the two-way bridge between product and patient: translate Flora (our AI care advocate), Arc, and patient-facing experiences into clear patient language and assets.
  • Carry patient insight, objections, and friction back into the product roadmap so we build what patients actually need.
  • Lead go-to-market for new patient-facing features and service-line launches, end to end.
  • Partner with Performance Marketing and Brand & Creative to lift conversion across the funnel — landing pages, intake flows, creative, social proof, and bilingual experiences.
  • Run message and creative testing with statistical discipline, and define how product marketing’s impact is measured across conversion, activation, retention, and message performance.
  • Build the feedback loops that turn results into sharper messaging, better experiences, and clearer roadmap signal.

What You’ll Need

  • 6+ years in product or lifecycle marketing, including direct ownership of positioning, messaging, and go-to-market for a product or service.
  • A proven track record of turning customer or audience insight into positioning and messaging that measurably moved conversion, activation, or retention.
  • Strong qualitative and quantitative research skills — audience research, segmentation, and message testing — and the ability to synthesize them into a clear narrative.
  • Excellent writing and storytelling; you can make complex things simple and write for real people, not just buyers.
  • Experience partnering closely with product and design to shape a roadmap and launch new features or experiences.
  • Comfort with data and measurement — funnel metrics, A/B testing, and cohort and retention thinking — and fluency partnering with analytics.
  • Experience operating in early-stage, high-growth environments with high ambiguity, minimal process, and direct accountability for outcomes.
  • A systems mindset — you improve outcomes with better research, messaging, and repeatable workflows, not just more output.
  • Deep alignment with Pair Team’s mission and a commitment to advancing equitable care for underserved communities.

    • Experience marketing AI or technology products, especially to non-technical audiences.
    • Bilingual (English/Spanish) or experience marketing to bilingual and multicultural audiences.

Embrace challenges: We leave our egos at the door and step forward into discomfort instead of back into safety. We help each other to learn and provide feedback using candor and kindness.

Care comes first: We hold ourselves to the highest standards for our patients. We are relentless in the pursuit of our mission, and ensure that we are taking care of ourselves in order to care for others.

Our purpose and passion are to empower patients, their families, and our communities by helping individuals achieve recovery and optimal wellness of the mind, body, and spirit.

Responsibilities

Job Summary:

The Insurance Operations Specialist supports AAC’s insurance and claims operations, including professional liability, general liability, workers’ compensation, employment-related matters, and other insured or potentially insured claims. This position serves as a central point of coordination for claim intake, documentation, reporting, tracking, follow-up, and communication throughout the lifecycle of a claim.

The position is responsible for the day-to-day administrative coordination of AAC’s insurance claims and serves as a central resource for maintaining accurate claim information, driving follow-up, and ensuring matters are appropriately routed and escalated.

The Insurance Operations Specialist works closely with facility leadership, Legal, Human Resources, insurance carriers, third-party administrators (TPAs), brokers, claims adjusters, and outside counsel to ensure claims are reported timely, documentation is complete, significant dates and events are tracked, outstanding requests are actively followed through to completion, and claim information remains accurate and current.

This role requires exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, persistence, sound judgment, and the ability to proactively manage a high volume of matters with competing priorities while maintaining confidentiality and appropriately escalating significant issues.

Duties, Responsibilities and Core Competencies:

Claims Intake & Administration

  • Receive and triage notices of incidents, claims, demands, lawsuits, administrative charges, and other matters that may result in an insurance claim.
  • Gather initial incident reports, supporting documentation, correspondence, and other information necessary to establish and maintain complete claim files.
  • Enter new claims and maintain accurate and current claim information within applicable claims management and internal tracking systems.
  • Review incoming matters, gather potentially applicable insurance information, and coordinate timely reporting and tender to appropriate carriers, TPAs, and brokers, with escalation as needed.
  • Maintain organized claim files and ensure appropriate documentation and correspondence are retained throughout the lifecycle of each matter.
  • Maintain a centralized tracking mechanism for open claims, significant dates, requested follow-ups, mediations, hearings, settlement payment dates, reporting deadlines, and other key milestones.
  • Maintain a regular follow-up cadence on open claims and outstanding requests, including unacknowledged tenders, pending coverage determinations, adjuster assignments, requested documentation, counsel updates, and other unresolved action items. Escalate matters that remain outstanding or require management attention.
  • Perform periodic review of open claims to identify stale matters, incomplete records, missing status updates, unresolved action items, and claims that may be appropriate for closure.

Carrier, TPA & Counsel Coordination

  • Maintain communication and actively follow up with insurance carriers, TPAs, brokers, adjusters, and outside counsel regarding claim acknowledgments, claim numbers, adjuster assignments, coverage determinations, counsel assignments, claim status, and outstanding requests.
  • Coordinate with facility leadership and internal departments to obtain medical records, personnel information, incident documentation, and other materials requested in connection with claims.
  • Track outstanding requests for information or documentation and follow through with responsible parties until completed or appropriately escalated.
  • Assist with coordination and communication among internal stakeholders and external insurance and legal partners to support timely and effective claim administration.
  • Identify matters requiring additional review or escalation and promptly bring significant developments, delays, or unresolved issues to Legal and/or Company leadership.

Claim & Litigation Tracking

  • Track service of process, attorney correspondence, administrative filings, mediations, settlements, and other significant claim events, including deadlines and dates communicated by Legal or outside counsel.
  • Maintain current records of claim status, reported reserves, legal spend, settlements, and final disposition based on information provided by carriers, TPAs, Legal, Finance, and outside counsel.
  • Monitor known deadlines, significant dates, and outstanding action items and proactively communicate with appropriate internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely follow-up.
  • Support the tracking and administration of professional liability, general liability, workers’ compensation, employment-related, and other insured or potentially insured matters throughout the claim lifecycle.
  • Confirm claim closure and maintain complete final claim records when matters are resolved.

Reporting, Data & Insurance Operations

  • Assist with preparation of claim summaries, litigation reports, insurance reports, and other claim-related information requested by Legal, Company leadership, the Board, auditors, or other authorized stakeholders.
  • Support insurance and claims information requests related to audits, due diligence, transactions, renewals, and other organizational initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable claims data to support reporting and analysis by Legal, Finance, and Company leadership.
  • Assist with reconciliation and validation of claim information across internal tracking systems, carrier and TPA reports, and other insurance records as needed.
  • Identify recurring administrative issues, documentation gaps, and process inefficiencies and recommend practical improvements to claim intake, tracking, documentation, and follow-up processes.

Collaboration & Confidentiality

  • Partner collaboratively with Legal, Human Resources, facility leadership, Finance, and other corporate departments to support effective insurance and claims administration.
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive claim, employee, patient, legal, and business information and exercise appropriate discretion when handling privileged or confidential matters.
  • Communicate professionally and effectively with stakeholders at all organizational levels and with external insurance and legal partners.
  • Demonstrate accountability, responsiveness, persistence, and a service-oriented approach when supporting facilities and corporate departments.

Other

  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Insurance, Healthcare Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field preferred. Relevant professional experience may substitute for formal education.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in claims administration, insurance operations, workers’ compensation administration, insured litigation support, or a related function required.
  • Experience communicating and coordinating with insurance carriers, TPAs, brokers, claims adjusters, and/or outside counsel strongly preferred.
  • Commercial insurance claims experience, including professional liability, general liability, employment practices, workers’ compensation, or similar claims, preferred.
  • Healthcare, behavioral health, or multi-state claims experience is a plus.
  • Experience using a claims management system, RMIS, matter-management system, or similar tracking platform preferred.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace and the ability to maintain accurate trackers, reports, electronic files, and claim documentation.

Personal Attributes

  • Demonstrates exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail with the ability to manage a high volume of claims, deadlines, follow-ups, and competing priorities.
  • Demonstrates initiative and follows through on outstanding matters without requiring significant day-to-day direction.
  • Comfortable working with limited supervision in a high-volume environment and persistent in obtaining responses, information, and documentation from multiple stakeholders.
  • Understands that sending an initial request does not complete an action item and consistently follows matters through to response, resolution, or appropriate escalation.
  • Exercises discretion and sound judgment when managing sensitive, confidential, and potentially privileged information.
  • Possesses strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify missing information, inconsistencies, outstanding requests, known deadlines, and matters requiring escalation.
  • Demonstrates the ability to review and understand claim-related documentation, including incident reports, demand letters, legal correspondence, lawsuits, administrative filings, insurance information, and settlement documentation.
  • Communicates clearly, professionally, and appropriately with internal stakeholders and external insurance and legal partners.

  • Demonstrates professionalism, accountability, responsiveness, persistence, and a strong sense of ownership over assigned administrative responsibilities.
  • Works effectively in a collaborative environment and is willing to support claims-related projects and responsibilities across Legal, Human Resources, Finance, and other functional areas.

jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, the fastest-growing company in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Groups & Events to lead our Groups Contracts and Groups Bookings teams. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives in the details as much as in the strategy — someone who doesn't just oversee the work but genuinely understands it, can step into it, and uses that proximity to make the team and the customer experience meaningfully better every day.

You'll own the end-to-end support experience for group travel, from contract management through booking execution, and you'll bring the rare combination of operational depth, people leadership, and strategic clarity that this function requires. You know the workflows. You know where the friction lives. And you build the systems, the culture, and the team capability to eliminate it.

At Engine, we don't aim to meet industry benchmarks — we aim to make the industry benchmark against us. This role is for someone who holds themselves and their team to that standard.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop the Groups Contracts and Groups Bookings teams. You own performance, culture, and day-to-day operations across both teams. You develop your managers and leads with directness and intention — giving real feedback, building real capability, and creating the conditions for people to do the best work of their careers. The leaders who come up under you go on to run their own functions.

Be a player/coach and power user. You don't manage from a distance. You maintain deep, current working knowledge of end-to-end group handling — from initial inquiry and contract execution through booking confirmation and post-travel support. You can pull up a contract, work a complex case, navigate the systems your team uses every day, and identify exactly where the experience breaks down. Your proximity to the work is not occasional — it's how you lead. When a high-stakes situation arises, you're in it, not watching from the sidelines.

Drive continuous improvement relentlessly. You use data and direct observation to find problems before customers report them. You build feedback loops — from QA audits to coaching sessions to SOP rewrites to retraining cycles — and you close them. You don't flag issues and wait for someone else to fix them. You identify the root cause, build the solution, and measure whether it worked. Process improvement isn't a project for you — it's an operating mode.

Own the operational metrics. Establish baselines, track performance, and hold the team accountable to clear and measurable outcomes — booking conversion rate, L90 median timing, QA scores, SLA performance, and client satisfaction. You know which numbers matter, what's driving them, and what it takes to move them.

Manage BPO vendor performance. You have experience running BPO partnerships and you bring that discipline to the Groups function. You hold external partners to Engine's quality standards — not theirs — and you know the difference between a vendor that needs coaching and a vendor that needs accountability. You manage performance cadences, escalate when the bar isn't being met, and work with the OpEx Vendor Manager on contracts and transitions. You've been on the ground with a BPO partner and you know what good looks like at the agent level, not just the reporting level.

Be the senior escalation point. For complex group contracts, high-stakes client situations, and cross-functional issues that require experienced judgment — you're the person who gets the call. You resolve with speed and confidence, you document what happened and why, and you use every escalation as an input into making the system better.

Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with Sales, Account Management, and Finance to ensure group programs are set up for success and clients are supported throughout the lifecycle. You're not a handoff point — you're a genuine partner who brings operational insight into commercial conversations and vice versa.

Contribute to the broader Member Support strategy. Bring a groups-specific lens to decisions that affect the wider organization. You're a peer on the leadership team, not just a functional operator — and you use that seat to make Client Ops better across the board.

What We're Looking For

You are customer obsessed — operationally, not rhetorically. You read case transcripts. You sit with agents. You've called a hotel on behalf of a client to understand what the experience actually feels like on the other end. You treat friction in the customer journey as a personal problem to solve, and you build teams that feel the same way. For you, customer obsession isn't a value on a wall — it's visible in every process decision you make.

You are a true player/coach. You lead by modeling. You're not above rolling up your sleeves, working a complex group contract, or jumping on a call with a client when it matters. You set the standard by demonstrating it — and your team follows because they've seen you do the work, not just talk about it. At the same time, you know when to zoom out, when to delegate, and how to build the management layer that scales without you.

You have deep contact center and BPO management experience. You've run operations with BPO partners at meaningful scale — vendor selection, performance management, commercial negotiations, quality calibration, and transitions. You know how to get the best out of a BPO relationship and when to escalate. Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

Key Responsibilities

Offboarding

  • Manage and resolve end-to-end employee exits across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and their employees.
  • Provide sound guidance and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.
  • Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, balancing multiple stakeholders with competing interests.
  • Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.
  • Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.
  • Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, amongst other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.

  • Navigate clients through Remote's Employee Relations resources and guides, helping them understand applicable policies and processes.
  • Conduct preliminary assessment of workplace concerns, identifying key facts and applicable local regulations.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate handling of employee relations matters.
  • Support clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches and documentation requirements.
  • Monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Actively identify opportunities for and contribute to process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.

Key Requirements and Charactristics

  • Experience as a HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.
  • Proven experience with a strong background in managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR support and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues, undertake research, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.
  • Basic understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to confidently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.
  • Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.
  • Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for automation and championing best practices.
  • Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment with multiple priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

Benefits

Join the Movement

WeVote’s partner VoteUSA has an open volunteering position for a Communications Manager (~5 hours per week) who wants to use their existing skills, grow new ones, and help strengthen American democracy.

About VoteUSA

Vote-USA.org informs and educates voters by producing comprehensive, nonpartisan election information for national, state, and many local elections. Founded in 2003 by Ron Kahlow, VoteUSA has researched 20,000+ candidates and 500+ issues, helping voters understand who and what they are voting for. The organization continues to close the voter‑information gap through accessible, factual election data.

About WeVote

A longtime partner of VoteUSA, WeVote is a nonpartisan, volunteer-powered civic‑tech nonprofit and a Fast Forward nonprofit technology grantee. With 150+ active volunteers, WeVote builds open‑source mobile tools that help voters make informed decisions in about eight minutes — including downloading the WeVote Ballot Guide app. Learn more at or @WeVote. We are a 100% remote organization.

What You’ll Do

As Communications Manager, you will lead VoteUSA’s communications operations, manage a small team, and oversee nationwide outreach campaigns.

  • Team Leadership — Manage VoteUSA’s Communications Team and coordinate with WeVote leadership.

  • Email Campaign Oversight — Oversee regular email campaigns to candidates, election officials, and voters (candidate outreach, election official verification, voter education/GOTV, volunteer communications).

  • Communications Calendar — Develop a communications calendar and metrics to assess campaign effectiveness (engagement, response rates, etc.).

  • Workflow Improvement — Build communication processes, improve workflows, and document best practices for consistency and efficiency.

  • Agile Team Management — Run weekly agile meetings, mentor volunteers, and onboard new team members.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager of Integrations
jobs.excerpt: KarmaCheck is the leader in modern background checks and screenings for the staffing industry, pushing the boundaries of workflow automation.
jobs.description:
KarmaCheck is the leader in modern background checks and screenings for the staffing industry, pushing the boundaries of workflow automation. Our customers work in ATS, VMS, and HRIS platforms which utilize our integrations and API to run screening, verification, and credentialing workflows without switching systems.
We are building an AI workforce: agents that automate the compliance workflows our customers run. Those products reach their full value when they show up inside the systems our customers already use. Building an agent in our own dashboard is the first half of the work. Getting it into Bullhorn, Symplr CTM, Workday, or a customer's proprietary system is the unlock.
This role owns that unlock, alongside additional workflow automation development, and the day-to-day integration products our customers depend on. The ideal hire can commit to working Eastern Time (EST).

The surface you would own

  • Pre-built ATS, HRIS, and HCM integrations: Bullhorn, where KarmaCheck selects required checks based on job placement specifications and writes completed screenings back to the candidate record. KarmaCheck is the only background check integration in Bullhorn's investment portfolio. Symplr CTM, where teams order screenings, sync candidate data, and download completed documents directly from the candidate profile. Workday, delivering background check history, status updates, and results into the candidate's Workday record. WIth additional integrations existing and to come.
  • Service and technology partners: An ecosystem spanning VMS and direct sourcing providers, currently including Conexis, Simpliant, Bridge, Shiftrx, Livehire, Renhead, and Opus Match, supported by revenue-share and referral programs.
  • Public API: An API-first architecture where customers have access to the same calls we use thousands of times a day, with a deliberately broad endpoint surface, customer-mapped data fields, automated consumer report delivery, and support for most ATS, HRIS, HCM, and VMS platforms as well as homegrown systems.

What you will own

  • Taking what we build to market, technically. This is the part of the job that makes it more than integration creation and maintenance. As we release AI agents and new screening products, you own how they reach customers inside their own systems: what the integration story is for each one, which partner surfaces it needs to land on, what has to change in the API or the partner integration to support it, and how a customer actually turns it on. You will work in tandem with the product managers driving AI and new product development.
  • Integration product and partnerships. Ongoing ownership of the Bullhorn, Symplr CTM, and Workday integrations, the partner ecosystem, and whatever we take on next. You will define what integrating with KarmaCheck means: which data flows, how statuses map, how errors surface, what we standardize and where we accommodate a partner's model. You will work directly with partner product and engineering teams and own the roadmap for each integration rather than treating it as a one-time build.
  • Customer-facing implementation and scoping. You will be in front of customers regularly: integration discovery and solutions on new deals, scoping sessions during implementation, and the calls where a customer describes a workflow we do not yet support. Enterprise deals in healthcare staffing almost always hinge on an integration, and you will be the product voice in those conversations.
  • API and developer experience. Our public API and documentation are part of the product and often the first thing a technical buyer evaluates. You will own how they evolve in partnership with engineering: endpoint and webhook design, versioning and deprecation, error semantics, sandbox and testing experience, and documentation quality.
  • Support for Implementation and Support teams. Configuration and tooling that let Implementation stand up an integration without engineering involvement, clear enablement for Support, and a discipline of turning recurring issues into roadmap items rather than repeat manual fixes. The goal is that each launch requires less of Product and Engineering than the one before it.

The requirements we're looking for

  • 5+ years in product management, with meaningful time owning integrations, APIs, or platform products
  • Integration experience across multiple different systems. We care more about the breadth of patterns you have seen than about any one platform. If you arrive with strong instincts about how integrations should be built, mapped, versioned, and supported, you will be useful on day one
  • Direct experience owning partner or API integrations as an ongoing product rather than a project. You have made standardize-versus-accommodate calls and lived with the consequences
  • Genuine comfort in front of customers, including when the goal is to sell. You will demo products, communicate value, and position our capability from a place of strength with technical buyers and operations leaders, then stay with that customer through discovery, scoping, and implementation. Much of what moves deals in this business is carried by product people, and you will be one of them.
  • Technical fluency to work directly with engineers on APIs, webhooks, data models, and error handling. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should never need a translator
  • Ability to turn input from customers, partners, and internal teams into clear, written, prioritized requirements
  • Comfort working with external partner teams, including the diplomacy of influencing a roadmap you do not control

Helpful, and learnable here

  • Healthcare staffing, background screening, credentialing, or compliance. Domain depth matters in this business, but we would rather hire strong integration instincts and ramp the domain than the reverse
  • Credentialing or verification experience, particularly locum tenens/physicians, which is a direction we are moving
  • Familiarity with ATS, VMS, HCM, or HRIS ecosystems such as Bullhorn, Symplr, or Workday
  • Developer experience or API product work
  • Experience bringing AI or automation features into third-party systems

jobs.description:
About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn't just a job, it's an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients. Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior SDET / Test Automation Engineer for a project based assignment to build the automated testing and release systems that ensure our products remain reliable as traffic, data volume, integrations, partners, and release velocity increase. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on test automation, API and integration testing, performance and scalability testing, and CI/CD quality gates within an AWS-based environment.
This is not a manual QA position. You will design and build reusable test infrastructure, automate critical product and partner workflows, create realistic performance scenarios, and provide engineering teams with clear evidence of whether a release is ready for production.
You will work closely with engineering teams and the Performance & Reliability Engineering Lead to ensure quality and scalability are built into the development lifecycle rather than treated as a final release checkpoint.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and evolve the automated testing architecture across products and engineering teams
  • Build and maintain automated API, integration, contract, end-to-end, regression, and UI tests where appropriate
  • Develop reusable test frameworks, fixtures, synthetic data, mocks, and environment strategies
  • Build automated testing for distributed services and integrations running within AWS environments
  • Design and execute load, stress, spike, soak, scalability, degradation, and recovery tests
  • Translate performance and capacity scenarios into repeatable automated test suites with measurable pass/fail thresholds
  • Model realistic workloads, concurrency levels, traffic patterns, data volumes, and dependency behavior
  • Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and establish enforceable quality and release gates
  • Create automated release checks tied to quality, latency, reliability, and performance thresholds
  • Establish practices for identifying, quarantining, diagnosing, and eliminating flaky tests
  • Improve test observability and failure reporting so engineers can quickly understand and diagnose issues
  • Build and maintain reliable test data and test environment strategies
  • Debug failures across APIs, services, databases, infrastructure, and external integrations
  • Partner with Performance & Reliability Engineering to validate scalability assumptions and production readiness
  • Partner with Security Engineering on permissions, isolation, negative-path, and abuse-related test scenarios
  • Track testing trends and help reduce escaped defects, flaky tests, manual release effort, and regression risk
  • Coach engineers on testability, automation, quality ownership, and defect-prevention practices

Required Skills:

  • Strong experience as an SDET, Software Engineer in Test, Test Automation Engineer, Quality Engineer, or similar engineering-focused testing role
  • Strong software development and test automation skills
  • Experience testing APIs, distributed services, integrations, and cloud-based applications
  • Hands-on experience working within AWS environments
  • Strong experience building automated API and integration test frameworks
  • Hands-on performance and scalability testing experience using tools such as k6, Gatling, Locust, JMeter, or equivalent
  • Experience designing realistic performance workloads rather than simply executing predefined load tests
  • Experience with load, stress, spike, soak, and scalability testing
  • Strong experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience establishing automated quality gates and release criteria
  • Experience with contract testing and testing across service boundaries
  • Strong understanding of test-data management, synthetic data, fixtures, mocks, and environment reliability
  • Experience using logs, metrics, traces, and other observability tools to diagnose test and system failures
  • Strong debugging skills across applications, APIs, infrastructure, databases, and integrations
  • Experience identifying and reducing flaky or unreliable automated tests
  • Ability to influence engineering teams and promote shared ownership of quality without becoming a centralized testing bottleneck

Nice to have:

  • Experience testing high-scale SaaS or distributed platforms
  • Experience with AWS services supporting highly available or distributed applications
  • Experience testing systems with significant traffic, concurrency, or availability requirements
  • Experience with resilience, failure injection, dependency degradation, or recovery testing
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and ephemeral or automated test environments
  • Experience with security-adjacent testing, including permissions, authentication, authorization, isolation, and negative-path scenarios
  • Identity, DNS, registry, or security domain experience
  • Experience building quality or test platforms used across multiple engineering teams

What Success Looks Like
Within your first several months, you will have:

  • Established a clear risk-based automation strategy across critical product and partner workflows
  • Built reliable automated regression, API, integration, and contract test coverage
  • Created repeatable performance and scalability tests for the platform's highest-risk journeys
  • Established realistic test-data and environment strategies
  • Integrated critical test suites directly into CI/CD pipelines
  • Implemented measurable release gates tied to quality, latency, reliability, and performance thresholds
  • Reduced flaky tests and improved the clarity and actionability of automated test failures
  • Established performance trend reporting and repeatable load, soak, and failure-testing capabilities
  • Reduced manual release validation and increased confidence in production readiness
  • Helped establish shared quality ownership across engineering teams

Employment type:

  • Contract

jobs.description:
The Paid Media Strategist serves as the subject matter expert and strategic owner of paid media

performance across a portfolio of clients. This role is primarily focused on Paid Search and Paid Social

Advertising and may also involve Programmatic Display and other third-party platforms.

The Strategist is responsible for translating client business objectives into paid media strategy,

independently diagnosing performance, developing and optimizing campaigns, establishing testing

roadmaps, and identifying opportunities for growth both within and across channels.

Successful candidates will combine deep hands-on platform expertise with broader strategic

thinking. We are looking for someone who can determine what the strategy should be, not simply execute

a strategy developed by someone else.

Requirements

Client Strategy, Ownership and Communication

-Serve as the paid media subject matter expert and strategic owner for an assigned portfolio of clients.

-Develop a deep understanding of each client's business model, goals, customers, competitive

environment, and economics.

-Translate business objectives into clear paid media strategies, KPIs, channel roles, budgets, and testing

priorities.

-Independently audit new and existing accounts, diagnose performance issues, and develop prioritized

recommendations.

-Clearly articulate what is happening, why it is happening, and what we should do next.

-Identify growth opportunities beyond individual platforms, including opportunities involving creative,

landing pages, measurement, SEO, CRM, and other marketing channels.

-Effectively present strategy, performance, and recommendations to clients and internal teams.

-Create clear documentation and reporting that connects campaign performance to client business

objectives.

-Proactively identify risks and opportunities rather than waiting for client or account-management

direction.

Paid Media Strategy & Execution

-Develop, implement, and continuously optimize Paid Search and Paid Social strategies across a variety

of client types and business models.

-Demonstrate deep hands-on expertise in Google Ads and competency in at least one major Paid Social

platform, preferably Meta.

-Build appropriate campaign and account structures across Search, Shopping, Performance Max,

-Demand Gen, and other relevant campaign types.

-Understand when automated campaign types, bidding strategies, and audience expansion should or

should not be used.

-Develop cross-channel media plans that define the specific role of Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, and

other relevant platforms within the customer journey.

-Recommend and continuously manage budget allocation based on business objectives, marginal

performance, customer acquisition economics, and channel opportunity.

-Evaluate platform-reported performance critically and understand the relationship between attribution,

incrementality, and actual business outcomes.

-Stay current on changes to advertising platforms, automation, and AI, and translate those developments

into actionable recommendations for clients.

Data Analysis, Measurement & Optimization

-Extract insights from campaign and business data, identify meaningful trends, diagnose performance

changes, and develop proactive recommendations.

-Understand the fundamentals of conversion tracking, GA4, Google Tag Manager, attribution, and offline

conversion measurement.

-Evaluate performance using appropriate business metrics such as ROAS, CAC/CPA, LTV, conversion

rate, revenue, qualified leads, and pipeline.

-Distinguish between platform performance and overall business performance when evaluating

campaign success.

-Develop structured optimization plans rather than relying solely on individual platform recommendations.

-Collaborate with analytics and measurement specialists when deeper technical implementation or

analysis is required.

Testing & Creative Strategy

-Develop structured testing roadmaps based on clear hypotheses and business objectives.

-Partner with creative teams to translate campaign performance into actionable creative

recommendations.

-Establish appropriate KPIs, budgets, and evaluation criteria for campaign, audience, messaging, and

creative tests.

-Use test results to generate actionable learnings and determine subsequent iterations.

-Understand the role creative plays across different platforms and stages of the customer journey.

Cross-Functional Leadership

-Collaborate with specialists across SEO, Creative, Analytics/Measurement, CRM, and other disciplines

to improve overall client outcomes.

-Recognize when a paid media performance issue originates outside the advertising platform and

proactively engage the appropriate specialists.

-Share platform knowledge, emerging best practices, and successful testing approaches with other

members of the Paid Media team.

-Contribute to agency-wide paid media methodologies, standards, and SOPs.

-Help establish repeatable frameworks for turning account audits and campaign data into comprehensive

client strategies.

Requirements

-Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

-3+ years of hands-on paid media experience at a digital marketing agency or similarly complex multi-

client environment.

-Demonstrated experience independently owning paid media strategy, not solely executing campaigns or

recommendations developed by others.

-Deep working knowledge of Google Ads, including Search, Shopping, and Performance Max.

-Hands-on experience with at least one major Paid Social platform, preferably Meta.

-Experience managing meaningful paid media budgets and making independent budget-allocation

decisions.

-Demonstrated ability to diagnose account performance and explain the underlying causes of

performance changes.

-Strong understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, and digital measurement.

-Experience developing structured campaign, creative, or audience testing programs.

-Ability to translate platform data into clear business recommendations.

-Strong written and verbal communication skills and comfort presenting strategic recommendations to

clients.

-Ability to independently manage multiple clients, priorities, and deadlines.

Benefits

Logical Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Short-Term Disability, and Life insurance
  • 401(k) plus match, to help plan for your future
  • Paid time off (starting at 15 days), plus paid holidays, paid sick days, and paid personal days.
  • Flexible Fridays
  • Option to work completely remote
  • Access to senior management and mentoring opportunities
  • Optional COVID safe company gatherings

Logical is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strongly encourage candidates of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. Each new hire is an opportunity for us to bring in a different perspective, and we are always eager to further diversify our company

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Support Network Engineer to support and maintain ISP and fixed wireless network infrastructure while delivering exceptional technical support to U.S.-based B2B customers.

This is a customer-facing role requiring strong networking expertise, excellent communication skills, and hands-on experience with wireless networking technologies, routing, switching, and network troubleshooting. You’ll play a key role in maintaining high network availability, resolving technical issues, and supporting mission-critical connectivity solutions.

What You’ll Do

Network Operations & Support

  • Provide technical support to U.S.-based B2B customers.
  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot MikroTik and Cisco routers and switches across core and edge ISP networks.
  • Monitor network performance, resolve outages, and ensure high network availability.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex network issues in a timely manner.

Fixed Wireless Infrastructure

  • Plan, deploy, and troubleshoot Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) infrastructure.
  • Support Point-to-Point (PTP) and Point-to-Multipoint (PTMP) wireless links.
  • Work with wireless platforms including:
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti / UniFi
    • Aviat
    • Siklu / Ceragon
  • Support fixed wireless, managed Wi-Fi, Starlink, and wireless mesh/backhaul solutions.

Routing & Network Management

  • Implement and maintain dynamic routing protocols, including:
    • OSPF
    • BGP
  • Maintain reliable routing across ISP network infrastructure.
  • Support network performance optimization and stability.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Flawless written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Previous experience in customer-facing technical support roles.
  • Hands-on experience with fixed wireless/WISP technologies, including:
    • Starlink
    • Managed Wi-Fi
    • Cambium
    • Ubiquiti / UniFi
    • Siklu / Ceragon
  • Strong experience configuring and troubleshooting MikroTik and Cisco networking equipment.
  • Experience implementing and supporting OSPF and BGP.
  • Experience deploying and troubleshooting PTP and PTMP wireless networks.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud networking in AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar platforms.
  • ITSM experience, preferably with Salesforce.
  • Experience with:
    • Starlink
    • 4G/5G networking
    • Peplink SD-WAN
  • Network certifications such as:
    • CCNA
    • Network+
    • Equivalent certifications

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Monitor network health and respond to customer support requests.
  • Troubleshoot routing, switching, and wireless connectivity issues.
  • Configure and maintain MikroTik and Cisco network devices.
  • Support fixed wireless infrastructure and resolve outages.
  • Work directly with customers to diagnose and resolve technical issues.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to maintain reliable network operations.

In short: You’ll support, troubleshoot, and optimize ISP and fixed wireless network infrastructure while delivering exceptional technical support to B2B customers.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Technical Interview
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your networking experience, and highlight your expertise with fixed wireless technologies, MikroTik, Cisco, routing protocols, and customer support. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward in the interview process.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about networking, wireless infrastructure, and delivering outstanding customer support, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join a team dedicated to building and maintaining reliable network solutions.
