jobs.excerpt: Full-Time | Fully Remote | Some Evening and Weekend Working Required | Fixed-Term Contract We're looking for a Psychological Wellbeing Practitioner (PWP) to join our growing psychology team at one of the UK's most exciting health-tech companies.
jobs.description:
Full-Time | Fully Remote | Some Evening and Weekend Working Required | Fixed-Term Contract

We're looking for a Psychological Wellbeing Practitioner (PWP) to join our growing psychology team at one of the UK's most exciting health-tech companies.

In this role, you'll support people living with obesity to make sustainable lifestyle and behaviour changes, working as part of a multidisciplinary team within our Specialist Weight Management Service (SWMS).

This is a fully remote role: all delivery is via video consultation and in-app messaging, and you can be based anywhere in the UK. Flexibility is required to support some early evenings and Saturdays as and when needed to support our NHS contracts.

The Challenge

More than 1 in 4 adults in the UK are living with obesity; a chronic condition that often negatively impacts their physical and mental health, and therefore quality of life. Access to specialist weight management services for the treatment of obesity remains limited and varies geographically due to a lack of funding. Existing services face long waiting lists, resulting in treatment delays which can adversely affect patient outcomes.

Enter Second Nature...

By bringing together the latest behavioural science, psychology, technology, and the talents of our incredible team, our mission is to eradicate obesity and type 2 diabetes for all, and as part of that mission, we are aiming to increase access to effective treatment for people living with obesity. Second Nature provides specialist weight management services to support people living with obesity.

About us:

  • We've positively changed the lives of 300,000+ people through accessible, evidence-based healthcare.
  • We're rated 'Excellent' on Trustpilot by over 8,000 of our members.
  • We're the UK’s largest digital health provider to the NHS
  • We're a leading B2C provider of GLP-1 medication-assisted weight loss programmes, and 1 of 5 NICE-approved providers to deliver these services within the NHS in the future
  • Our team members stay with us for an average of 4.3 years

The Role

We're looking for a dynamic Psychological Wellbeing Practitioner (PWP) who is passionate about making a positive difference to those living with obesity to grow our current psychology team. You will be part of an innovative Specialist Weight Management Service (SWMS) that uses a multi-disciplinary team (MDT) approach to obesity treatment and technology to optimise patient engagement and outcomes. Our MDT includes doctors, dietitians, psychologists and physical activity specialists, all with special interests in obesity.

You will provide psychological therapy to people living with obesity to support them to make sustainable lifestyle and dietary changes, in collaboration with the MDT. You'll be using a range of theoretical approaches, such as CBT and DBT. Whilst it is important to be able to work autonomously, you will receive comprehensive training. You will also have access to clinical supervision and support from a Practitioner Psychologist.

This post is full-time (40 hours/week) and fixed-term, with flexible hours. You'll work fully remotely, connecting with patients through video consultations and in-app messaging. The role requires working some evenings per week and Saturdays as and when needed to support our NHS contracts.

What you'll do:

  • Independently implement appropriate initial assessment methods to allocate patients to the most suitable treatment
  • Deliver group-based and one-to-one psychological interventions remotely via video calls, to support changes in eating behaviours and physical activity behaviours
  • Attend regular MDT meetings to monitor the care of our patients
  • Attend clinical supervision with a Practitioner Psychologist to discuss complex cases
  • Appropriately manage clinical risk (e.g. safeguarding concerns) when it arises during clinical practice
  • Maintain adequate CPD, receive regular clinical supervision in accordance with good practice guidelines and continue to meet registration requirements
  • Maintain confidentiality of information in line with the requirements of the Data Protection Act and ensuring that participant confidentiality is protected at all times

Requirements

You have experience working in a weight management/bariatric/eating disorder setting

  • A qualified Psychological Wellbeing Practitioner (PWP) with experience of weight management and/or bariatric experience within a mental health setting, or working with patients in an eating disorder setting
  • Proven experience delivering group-based programmes, with the confidence to facilitate sessions effectively in a digital setting
  • A solid understanding of obesity as a condition and the issues many people living with obesity face, including weight stigma
  • Experience related to offering weight management support
  • Able to provide supportive, empathetic patient-centred care to patients who may have complex physical and mental health needs

You're comfortable working fully remotely

  • You enjoy remote working and can stay motivated and organised without an office around you
  • You have a suitable home working setup, including a private space for confidential consultations and a reliable internet connection

You can work autonomously and collaboratively with a doctor-led multidisciplinary team (MDT) to oversee patient care

  • You'll confidently and independently manage a caseload of patients, delivering psychological interventions via video calls and in-app messaging, and working collaboratively with our MDT

You have experience in supporting the coordination of a healthcare service

  • You have experience in monitoring and supporting patients' journeys through a service in line with an organisation's protocols, including scheduling assessments and appointments, monitoring attendance rates and following up with patients, writing GP letters, and revising protocols
  • You have experience using Excel or Google Sheets (or other similar programmes) to monitor patients' journeys

You are dynamic and have a strong drive to work in healthcare tech

  • You have experience thriving in fast-paced environments and are energised by the dynamic nature of start-up life, where being hands-on and adaptable to the evolving needs of the service is essential
  • You're confident in using technology to provide patient care, including recording and reviewing patient notes
  • Excited by digital initiatives that increase access to healthcare

Education/Qualifications:

  • BABCP/BPS registration
  • Postgraduate Diploma as a Psychological Wellbeing Practitioner

To apply

Please submit your CV and cover letter via this application page, and include your BABCP or BPS registration number. Unfortunately, we're unable to progress applications without appropriate registration. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to respond to everyone individually. If we don't have a chance to get back to you, we're not intentionally being rude, but please assume it's a no for now!

Benefits

  • Work from home with flexible hours
  • Joining a culture of intelligent, friendly, and highly-motivated individuals who are passionate about what they do
  • A competitive market salary
  • 25 days of holiday plus national holidays

jobs.description:
Job Title: Consultant, Change Management
Location: Remote; Northeast US required

Description

Founded in 2004, BME Strategies is a Massachusetts-based consulting firm specializing in the design, implementation, and evaluation of public health programs for local, regional, and state government partners. Our work supports evidence-based, community-driven solutions that strengthen public health systems and advance equity across the communities we serve. At BME, our clients are on the front lines of Public Health. Priorities may shift but our commitment to supporting our partners does not. We take pride in having multi-year, multi-project engagements, often working closely as an extension of their staff. Our success comes from our shared values: a bias toward action; optimistically collaborative; willingness to navigate ambiguity; minimal ego - no job is too small or big; pursuing the equitable solution; always learning, and; committed to quality at every stage.

Position Overview

BME Strategies is seeking a Consultant, Change Management to lead our clients through the “people side” of organizational transformation. The person in this role will be a strategic partner to public health departments and nonprofits, moving beyond checklist-style project management to ensure that new policies, technologies (including AI), and protocols are deeply embedded and sustained by the workforce.

A key focus of this role is guiding local health partners through the adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows, translating technical capability into practical, trusted practice on the ground. As an example, someone in this role may focus on why a deadline is missed, investigate human constraints like burnout or capacity gaps, and build the inclusive communication loops necessary to maintain organizational resilience.

Key Responsibilities

BME Org-Wide Responsibilities for Consultants:

  • Consultant roles at BME consist of approximately 85% project work, 5% administrative work, and 10% business development.
  • Leads or co-leads larger projects, technical and advisory, and contributes to project design.
  • Independently driving work with minimal day-to-day/project oversight.
  • May supervise Associates and Senior Associates.
  • Manages projects to exemplary client satisfaction.
  • Contributes to and/or leads proposals.

Role-Specific Responsibilities:

  • Transformation Leadership & Strategy: Lead the “People Side” of large-scale initiatives, ensuring that digital, operational, and AI-driven transitions are met with high adoption and minimal resistance.
  • Human-Centered Journey Mapping: Design and facilitate journey mapping sessions to identify friction points for frontline staff and stakeholders, ensuring implementation plans are grounded in the practitioner’s reality.
  • Strategic Stakeholder Engagement: Identify exactly who needs buy-in and partner with our Strategic Communications team to craft data-driven narratives that foster trust and alignment.
  • Workforce Development & Coaching: In partnership with our Workforce Development Team, provide hands-on coaching and upskilling to local leaders and staff, fostering long-term autonomy rather than temporary support.
  • Change Impact & Readiness Assessments: Conduct qualitative and quantitative assessments to evaluate organizational readiness and the magnitude of change, specifically within rural and urban health settings.
  • AI Change Management & Local Partner Support: Serve as a trusted advisor to local health departments, community health centers, and other local health partners as they adopt AI-enabled tools and workflows, translating technical AI capabilities into practical, human-centered guidance, addressing staff concerns about trust, data privacy, and job impact, and ensuring responsible, equity-centered adoption at the point of care and service delivery.
  • Embedded Liaison Services: Act as a primary point of contact for diverse coalitions, resolving operational issues by addressing the underlying human capacity needs.

Experience, Qualification, & Skills

  • Master’s degree in Public Health or a related field.
  • Minimum of 4-6 years of relevant experience required, including 2 or more years in a consulting firm environment
    • Experience in organizational change management or public health leadership and consulting.
    • Experience with health systems in Massachusetts or other Northeastern states (Maine, New Hampshire, Connecticut, Rhode Island, New York or New Jersey) is highly preferred.
    • Minimum 1-4 years of client-facing experience.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced consulting environment.
  • Core Competencies: Mastery of change management frameworks (e.g., Prosci ADKAR, Kotter) and experience applying them to people-powered systems.
  • “Generalist” Agility: Ability to “zoom out” for big-picture visioning and “dive in” to execute critical details during peak workloads.
  • Technical Literacy: Proficiency in data visualization tools (Smartsheet, Tableau) to build “readiness” dashboards that track employee sentiment and adoption metrics.
  • AI & Emerging Technology Literacy: Working knowledge of AI-enabled tools and processes relevant to public health operations, with the ability to translate technical AI concepts into accessible, actionable guidance for frontline staff and local partners with varying levels of technical comfort.
  • Certification: Prosci or equivalent Change Management certification is preferred.
  • Mission Alignment: A deep commitment to health equity and a desire to build sustainable, inclusive public health infrastructure.
  • And an alignment with BME’s shared values.

Work Environment

  • This is a full-time position based in a home office environment within the U.S.
  • BME Strategies in a remote-first organization. This role may require occasional travel to client sites, conferences, or meetings as required.

Compensation & Benefits

  • BME Strategies offers a competitive compensation package that includes:
    • 6+ weeks total leave, including paid vacation, sick time, personal leave, and floating holidays;
    • Health, dental, and vision insurance, with 80% employer-paid coverage for the employee & 70% employer-paid coverage for dependents;
    • Health FSA and dependent care FSA;
    • 401(k) with employer match;
    • Employer-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance;
    • One-time technology stipend;
    • And opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • The salary range for this position is $87,360 - $120,640 annually.

Please note: New employees are typically brought into the organization at a salary between the range minimum and the salary range midpoint, dependent upon internal equity and the budgeted amount for the position.  

How to Apply

  • Important Notice on Recruitment Fraud: BME Strategies communicates with applicants only through email addresses ending @bmestrategies.com. We do not use third-party domains for recruitment outreach. If you receive communication from a different email address, please do not respond and report it to us at
  • Please note that BME Strategies is unable to sponsor work-related visas.
  • BME Strategies is made up of individuals with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. These varied points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. BME Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, creed, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military status, prior record of arrest or conviction, or current employment status.

jobs.description:
Description

Defined.ai is a leading provider of high-quality, ethically sourced data for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) model training. We host the world's largest AI marketplace and offer end-to-end services to help companies accelerate their AI solutions. Backed by significant funding and recognized globally for our commitment to ethical AI, we operate in a fast-paced, innovative environment with offices in Seattle and Lisbon.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a Data Solutions Specialist to help customers and internal teams navigate our growing data marketplace and identify the right datasets to meet customer requirements. The Data Solutions Specialist will serve as a subject-matter expert on Defined.ai's off-the-shelf and partner dataset portfolio. You will work closely with Presales, Partnerships, Operations, and other internal teams to understand customer requirements, identify relevant datasets, gather additional information from data partners, and support opportunities from initial discovery through delivery.
This is a highly cross-functional individual contributor role that combines data research, solution development, partner communication, and project coordination.
The ideal candidate is naturally curious about data, highly organized, comfortable communicating with external partners, and able to translate customer requirements into practical dataset recommendations.

Department: Presales / Procurement

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in data, technology, operations, solutions, research, business analysis, partnerships, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to evaluate information from multiple sources.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Comfortable communicating with external partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into actionable dataset recommendations.
  • Experience working with CRM systems and maintaining accurate records.
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities, requests, and priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

Nice-to-have:
  • Experience working with AI, machine learning, data marketplaces, datasets, data licensing, or data services.
  • Familiarity with data modalities such as audio, speech, image, video, text, or multimodal datasets.
  • Experience in a presales, solutions, data operations, partnerships, or data product environment.
  • Experience working with data suppliers, vendors, or external partners.
  • Familiarity with data specifications, metadata, licensing requirements, or data quality concepts.
  • Experience supporting RFPs, RFIs, proposals, or customer solution development.

What you'll do:

Data Marketplace & Dataset Expertise

  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of Defined.ai's off-the-shelf and partner dataset marketplace.
  • Research and identify datasets that align with customer requirements, including considerations such as modality, language, geography, volume, quality, metadata, licensing, and other technical specifications.
  • Make recommendations to Presales and other internal stakeholders regarding the most appropriate datasets for customer opportunities.
  • Evaluate and compare datasets based on customer requirements and identify potential gaps or limitations.
  • Maintain familiarity with new datasets as they become available and ensure relevant information is captured internally.
  • Help identify opportunities to expand or improve the available dataset portfolio based on recurring customer requirements.

Partner Communication & Data Qualification
  • Communicate directly with data partners as needed to obtain additional information about existing datasets.
  • Follow up with partners regarding dataset specifications, availability, licensing, pricing, quality, geographic coverage, and other requirements.
  • Support the qualification and evaluation of new datasets and partner data offerings.
  • Document partner responses and ensure important dataset information is available to internal stakeholders.
  • Build effective working relationships with partners while coordinating closely with the Partnerships team.

Presales & Customer Opportunity Support
  • Partner with Presales/Solutions teams to understand customer data requirements and identify appropriate datasets.
  • Support RFPs, RFIs, proposals, and customer opportunities by providing accurate dataset information and recommendations.
  • Help translate customer requirements into specific dataset searches and recommendations.
  • Work with Presales teams to identify alternative datasets when an initial option does not fully meet customer requirements.
  • Support internal teams in responding to customer questions regarding available data.

Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Coordinate with Presales, Partnerships, Operations, and other stakeholders during presales and post-sales activities involving partner datasets.
  • Help ensure that relevant dataset information is communicated accurately from opportunity development through project execution.
  • Support handoffs between commercial, solutions, partnership, and operational teams.
  • Track outstanding questions, actions, and dependencies related to partner datasets and customer opportunities.

CRM & Data Management
  • Maintain accurate records of partner communications and dataset information within the company's CRM and other internal systems.
  • Document partner responses, dataset updates, availability, and other relevant information.
  • Ensure information gathered during customer opportunities and partner discussions is captured for future use.
  • Help maintain accurate and up-to-date marketplace information so internal teams can efficiently identify available data.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means becoming a trusted internal resource for understanding what data we have, what data our partners can provide, and which datasets best match a customer's requirements.
You will help make our marketplace easier to navigate, improve the quality and completeness of our dataset information, accelerate presales opportunities, and ensure smooth coordination between our commercial, partnership, and operational teams.


Skills & Competencies
  • Data Curiosity: Enjoys learning about datasets, their characteristics, and potential applications.
  • Analytical Thinking: Can assess customer requirements and determine which data options are most relevant.
  • Communication: Can clearly communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Partner Management: Comfortable asking the right questions and following up with external partners.
  • Organization: Able to track multiple requests, conversations, and dependencies without losing details.
  • Problem Solving: Can identify gaps and develop alternative approaches when an available dataset does not fully meet requirements.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively across Presales, Partnerships, Operations, and other teams.
  • Ownership: Takes responsibility for keeping information accurate and ensuring requests move forward.

Benefits
You spend a lot of your time at work, so it should be challenging, fun and interesting. At Defined.ai it will be all of those things and more. Here’s what we offer:

  • Flexible working schedule and hybrid model. We know comfort can boost creativity and performance, so you can manage your schedule and work both from one of our modern office spaces or home.

  • Excellent career development opportunities in a high growth company. With us, you can accomplish your career goals and follow a well-described career path with the support of your supervisor.

  • Culture of feedback and continuous improvement. AI is a fast-paced area, so we keep track of tech trends, and we always ask for feedback.

  • An international and diverse team. We have more than 23 nationalities at our 3 locations,

    and we provide language classes.

  • Continuous training opportunities. You can choose from many options: leveraging hand-on workshops, unlimited access to Coursera and formal development opportunities.

  • We love to foster a great office vibe. We believe that a comfortable environment makes
    a difference, so we provide daily breakfast and lunch, weekly happy hours to unwind,
    extra time-off, and even in-office massages to keep you relaxed and energized.

As one of the organization's senior security architects, this role will lead complex security architecture engagements across cloud, infrastructure, applications, data, and emerging technologies. The Staff Security Architect will influence enterprise technology strategy, establish security architecture standards and reusable design patterns, drive improvements to architecture review and threat modeling processes, and provide technical leadership across the Security Architecture function.

This position requires deep technical expertise, strong business acumen, and exceptional communication skills. The successful candidate will regularly engage with senior technology leaders, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to balance security, risk, innovation, and operational effectiveness while helping mature Versant's overall cybersecurity architecture program.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The successful candidate will be responsible for the following activities:

  • Lead security architecture engagements for complex enterprise initiatives, strategic programs, and high-impact technology implementations.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to engineering, infrastructure, cloud, data, and product teams throughout solution design and delivery.
  • Develop security architecture strategies, reference architectures, design patterns, standards, and technical guidance that enable secure-by-design development across the enterprise.
  • Lead and facilitate advanced threat modeling exercises, architectural risk assessments, and security design reviews for critical business initiatives, translating identified risks into clear control requirements and actionable remediation outcomes.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, platforms, and vendor solutions to determine security risks, architectural fit, and alignment with enterprise security strategy.

  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and technology leadership to integrate cybersecurity requirements into enterprise technology roadmaps and architectural governance.

  • Mentor other security architects and cybersecurity professionals by providing technical guidance, architecture reviews, and knowledge sharing, while serving as a technical reviewer for complex engagements.
  • Develop reusable documentation, security patterns, architecture decision records, and implementation guidance to improve engineering efficiency and consistency.
  • Stay current on evolving threat landscapes, industry trends, emerging technologies, and security best practices, translating them into actionable recommendations for Versant.
  • Present security architecture recommendations, technology risks, and strategic initiatives to technical leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Build strong relationships across business and technology organizations to foster collaboration, trust, and adoption of cybersecurity initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum 5-8 years of progressive experience across cybersecurity disciplines, including security architecture, application security, cloud security, infrastructure security, governance, risk management, or security engineering.
  • Minimum 3 years designing enterprise security architectures for complex cloud-native, hybrid, or distributed environments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing enterprise security architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and security design patterns.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks and security architecture methodologies.
  • Extensive experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform), including cloud-native security services and modern application architectures.
  • Experience conducting threat modeling using industry frameworks such as STRIDE, PASTA, MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP Threat Modeling, or similar methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), DevSecOps practices, CI/CD security, and application security testing methodologies including SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and penetration testing.
  • Experience designing security controls for modern architectures including APIs, containers, Kubernetes, microservices, serverless, identity platforms, and zero trust networks.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise security technologies including IAM, PAM, EDR, SIEM, network security, encryption, secrets management, PKI, and data protection technologies.
  • Experience interpreting and applying security and regulatory frameworks including NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, SOX, and CIS Controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence architectural decisions without direct authority across multiple technology organizations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and systems-thinking skills with the ability to evaluate business risk and recommend practical security solutions.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting technical concepts and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and executive audiences.
  • Experience simultaneously leading multiple strategic initiatives while effectively managing competing priorities.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. Advanced degrees are a plus.

DESIRED CHARACTERISTICS

  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, GIAC, TOGAF, or equivalent.
  • Experience establishing or maturing enterprise security architecture programs.
  • Experience supporting digital media, streaming platforms, content production, broadcast operations, or other media and entertainment technologies.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence organizational change through technical leadership, collaboration, and consensus building.

jobs.description:
Highlights:

Location: Remote (CET hours preferred)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

Our backend is powered by Node.js (Koa, NestJS) and MongoDB. The frontend stack includes Webpack, Vue.js, and React, with nearly all code written in TypeScript. For high-throughput messaging and background processing, we use Kafka (for millions of events) and Bull (Redis). Analytics data is stored in ClickHouse, and we use Elasticsearch for search.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals, including 80+ engineers. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus. Many of our developers bring 5 - 10+ years of experience, and we foster a culture of deep technical curiosity and knowledge sharing.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About the Role

As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will be a key contributor to our core product, building and scaling features that are central to the donation experience for millions of users. You'll leverage your expertise in Node.js, React, and TypeScript to develop complex components—from dynamic donation widgets to data-driven admin dashboards—with a relentless focus on code quality, scalability, and user experience.

This is an ideal opportunity if you love solving real-world problems at scale and want to grow within a mission-driven, high-impact engineering culture.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain resilient frontend and backend features using React and Node.js.
  • Develop our core products, including donation checkouts, embeddable widgets, and donor/partner portals.
  • Architect and develop system components that scale across millions of monthly transactions.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and thoroughly testable code.
  • Drive architecture and technical design discussions to find elegant solutions to complex problems.
  • Mentor peers by conducting thoughtful code reviews and providing constructive feedback.
  • Partner with product managers and designers to clarify requirements and shape the roadmap.
  • Proactively identify and resolve bugs, performance bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve. You should already be using AI meaningfully in your work and understand where it adds value and how it can improve the way you operate.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional fullstack development experience.
  • Deep understanding of modern JavaScript (event loop, closures, promises, prototypes).
  • Expert-level proficiency with React and its ecosystem (familiarity with Vue is a plus).
  • Strong backend expertise with Node.js (experience with Koa or NestJS is highly preferred).
  • Experience with Webpack configuration, performance optimization, and profiling.
  • A keen eye for detail and a high sense of ownership and accountability for your work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MongoDB, ClickHouse, or Elasticsearch.
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or a strong personal portfolio.

Bonus points

  • Curiosity and a hypothesis-driven mindset.
  • Ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Comfort working in fast-paced, data-rich environments.

Why work with us

  • A strong, collaborative product team that owns what it builds.
  • Clear product vision and access to real customer feedback from global nonprofit leaders.
  • Flat structure: no politics, just great work with great people.
  • Transparent company culture-we share how we’re growing, where revenue comes from, and what’s next.
  • Long-term focus: we offer equity options and value sustained, meaningful contribution.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is: $3,800 - $5,100 gross per month.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and alignment with the role's requirements.

Benefits

  • 31 days off.
  • 100% paid telemedicine plan.
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • English learning courses.

  • Gym or swimming pool.

jobs.description:
About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

Trusted Engineering That Matters

Engineering at VGS

VGS is building the platform powering agentic commerce and global payments infrastructure. VGS Engineering is the pillar that supports that vision. We create a platform that is an indispensable, ubiquitous component of our partners' payments and security infrastructure. We build and operate high-scale, reliable, and resilient systems that manage mission-critical payment data across the globe. We don't just participate in the payments ecosystem; we power it.

Our Environment & Culture

  • Modern Tooling as Leverage: We value speed and impact. To ensure nothing slows you down, we arm you with a highly consistent modern stack (e.g. AWS, Kubernetes, Java, TypeScript, Python) and world-class AI-augmented SDLC tooling. We strip away the friction so you can focus on the problems that demand creativity and judgment.

  • Ownership of Outcomes: Scaling global payments infrastructure requires individuals who take personal ownership of outcomes from day one. We look for builders who combine high agency with deep strategic alignment; channeling their urgency and relentless iteration into what matters most.

  • Mission-Critical Accountability: We power payments infrastructure for global market leaders, making system trust and integrity our core deliverable. We don't treat compliance (PCI, SOC2, ISO27001), security patching, and platform maintenance as administrative overhead—we engineer them with first-class product discipline. In payments infrastructure, reliability is not background work, it’s part of what customers buy.

Learn More: See how our engineering practices drive trust and innovation in ourofficial blog and ourreliability practices.

About the Role

As a Sr. Infrastructure Engineer (DevOps), you will serve as a key technical practitioner on our Platform Engineering team, taking personal ownership of our cloud platform, CI/CD pipelines, and internal developer platforms. In this role, you will help build, scale, and fortify global cloud infrastructure designed to handle mission-critical, high-throughput payment applications with zero downtime.


You will lead initiatives that strip away friction for engineering teams, architecting golden paths, automating deployment pipelines, and building self-healing infrastructure. Rather than executing against rigid task lists or managing manual deployments, you will bring high agency to your daily work, pioneering automated CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and AI-augmented developer tooling across the entire SDLC. We are looking for hands-on builders who refuse to settle for the status quo, hate manual toil, and take immense pride in elevating developer velocity, platform reliability, and cloud security.

What You'll Do

  • Build Immutable, Self-Healing Platform Foundations: Design, build, and optimize high-availability AWS infrastructure. Drive our evolution toward standardized, globally scalable platform infrastructure managed entirely through code (IaC).

  • Accelerate CI/CD & Developer Velocity: Own, modernize, and scale our continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. Build self-service platforms and "Golden Paths" that empower feature developers to ship code to production safely, autonomously, and rapidly.

  • Drive Resiliency & GitOps Automation: Replace manual toil with self-healing, automated infrastructure using GitOps methodologies (Flux/ArgoCD), modern automation scripts, and reproducible environment templates.

  • Deep Observability & Operational Rigor: Configure and maintain comprehensive telemetry tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to proactively spot system bottlenecks. Participate in on-call rotations and lead blameless post-mortems to continuously harden system resilience.

  • Security & Network Engineering: Embed security guardrails and compliance practices directly into deployment workflows, ensuring cloud security, API gateways, and network isolation are enforced continuously as code.

  • Platform Enablement & Mentorship: Partner strategically with product and engineering teams to drive platform adoption. Mentor mid-level and junior engineers on modern SRE, DevOps, and cloud-native practices.

What You Bring

  • Ownership at Scale: 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure roles, taking personal ownership of complex, large-scale distributed systems within mission-critical environments.

  • Containerization & GitOps Orchestration: Advanced experience with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, and modern GitOps deployment workflows (ArgoCD, Flux, GitHub Actions).

  • CI/CD Pipeline Mastery: Proven track record building, optimizing, and securing automated CI/CD deployment pipelines that support high-frequency engineering releases.

  • Automation & Scripting: Strong coding/scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash for platform tooling, custom operators, and operational automation.

  • Observability & SRE Practice: Hands-on experience implementing end-to-end telemetry and monitoring stacks using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar modern toolchains.

  • Growth Mindset & High Agency: An innate drive to eliminate manual friction, automate repetitive tasks, and acquire whatever missing context is needed to solve complex platform challenges end-to-end.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Experience managing distributed data streaming platforms like Kafka (MSK) or high-concurrency database platforms under heavy load.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI developer tools, agentic workflows, or automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Practical understanding of operating within regulated security frameworks such as PCI-DSS, SOC2, or ISO27001.

Equal Opportunity

We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, marital status, physical or mental disability, or other protected classes under all applicable local, state, and federal laws and ordinances (AA/EOE/W/M/Vet/Disabled).
